descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The goal of the Senior Technical Product Manager for the QVAC SDK is to define, guide, and scale the developer-facing product strategy for QVAC’s local and distributed AI platform. This role bridges deep software engineering understanding, developer experience design, market insight, and product execution. The QVAC SDK enables developers, enterprises, and ecosystem partners to build privacy-preserving, on-device, and peer-to-peer AI applications that run efficiently across devices. The person in this role will own the SDK product vision, roadmap, developer workflows, technical requirements, and adoption strategy, working closely with engineering to turn complex AI infrastructure into clear, usable, well-documented developer tools. This is a highly technical product role requiring hands-on coding ability, strong judgment around APIs and SDK design, and the ability to prototype, test, and critique developer experience flows directly. The ideal candidate has built or managed developer tools, SDKs, APIs, AI platforms, or infrastructure products, and can operate credibly with senior engineers while also communicating product value to executives, partners, enterprise buyers, and external developers. The goal of a Technical Product Manager is to bridge the gap between technical capabilities and business objectives, focusing on the technical aspects of product development. They work closely with engineering teams to define product roadmaps, prioritize features based on market research and customer needs, and ensure the successful delivery of technical products and services. In doing so, they manage the product vision, identify and mitigate potential risks, and maintain alignment with overall business requirements. Responsibilities
• Product Vision & Strategy: Define and champion the product vision for the QVAC SDK, aligning technical capabilities with Tether’s broader objectives around local AI, privacy, decentralization, and P2P infrastructure. Identify where the SDK should win across consumer app developers, enterprise AI teams, independent builders, and ecosystem partners.
• SDK Ownership: Own the roadmap for SDK capabilities, APIs, developer workflows, integrations, documentation, examples, templates, and tooling. Prioritize features that make it easier for developers to build, test, deploy, and scale Local AI applications using QVAC.
• Developer Experience: Curate the end-to-end developer experience, from first install to production integration. Design, mock up, and validate DevX flows including onboarding, SDK setup, API usage, CLI behavior, debugging workflows, sample apps, documentation journeys, and error states.
• Technical Product Definition: Translate product goals into precise technical requirements for engineering teams. Define SDK behavior, API surfaces, platform support, model/runtime constraints, performance expectations, privacy requirements, and integration patterns.
• Hands-On Prototyping: Use coding ability to explore SDK workflows, build proof-of-concept integrations, test APIs, review examples, evaluate documentation, and create credible technical prototypes or mockups using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub, local scripts, notebooks, or lightweight apps.
• Engineering Partnership: Work closely with engineering leads to make informed product decisions around SDK architecture, model execution, edge inference, performance, packaging, platform compatibility, P2P networking, and developer ergonomics. Challenge assumptions constructively and help the team balance speed, usability, reliability, and technical debt.
• Market and Customer Understanding: Develop a strong understanding of the developer tools, AI infrastructure, Local AI, edge computing, and enterprise AI markets. Identify the needs of consumer application developers, enterprise customers, AI researchers, and platform partners, and convert those insights into roadmap priorities.
• Feature Prioritization: Prioritize SDK capabilities based on developer demand, technical feasibility, strategic value, adoption potential, and measurable business impact. Use data, user research, competitive analysis, and direct developer feedback to guide trade-offs.
• Documentation and Enablement: Partner with engineering, developer relations, and marketing to ensure the SDK has excellent documentation, examples, tutorials, migration guides, release notes, and launch materials. Ensure technical content is accurate, usable, and aligned with real developer workflows.
• Go-To-Market: Build and own SDK launch plans in partnership with marketing, developer relations, ecosystem, and business teams. Define positioning, target developer segments, adoption motions, enterprise use cases, and partner opportunities.
• Performance and Adoption Metrics: Define and track SDK success metrics, including activation, time-to-first-success, API usage, integration completion, retention, developer satisfaction, documentation quality, issue resolution time, performance benchmarks, and enterprise adoption.
• Stakeholder Communication: Communicate clearly with executives, engineers, partners, enterprise customers, and developers. Explain complex AI, SDK, and infrastructure concepts in ways that support decision-making, alignment, and adoption. Mandatory:
• 8+ years of product management, technical product management, software engineering, developer tools, platform, SDK, API, AI infrastructure, or related experience.
• Strong software development background with hands-on coding ability. The candidate does not need to be a full-time engineer today, but must be able to read code, write prototypes, test SDK flows, understand API design, and engage deeply with engineering trade-offs.
• Experience with Local AI frameworks or runtimes such as llama.cpp, TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, ONNX Runtime, MLX, WebGPU, WebNN, or similar technologies.
• Prior experience building, managing, or launching developer-facing products such as SDKs, APIs, CLIs, frameworks, platforms, infrastructure tools, AI tooling, or technical integrations.
• Strong understanding of developer experience principles, including onboarding, documentation, API ergonomics, error handling, debugging workflows, examples, templates, and integration paths.
• Technical understanding of AI/ML systems, especially local inference, model optimization, runtime constraints, edge computing, privacy-preserving AI, and performance trade-offs.
• Ability to translate market needs and developer feedback into clear product requirements, roadmap priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Experience working closely with engineering teams on complex technical products, including architecture discussions, release planning, trade-off analysis, and technical debt management.
• Ability to create mockups, wireframes, prototypes, technical diagrams, sample workflows, or code-based proofs of concept to align stakeholders and clarify product direction.
• Strong understanding of consumer and enterprise software markets, including how developers evaluate, adopt, and scale SDKs or platforms.
• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and business implications to technical teams.
• Proven track record of shipping technical products with measurable adoption, developer satisfaction, or business impact.
• Strong product judgment, prioritization skills, and bias for execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
• Familiarity with agile development, product analytics, developer research, competitive analysis, and technical documentation processes.
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred:
• Experience with blockchain, P2P networking, decentralized systems, distributed computing, or privacy-preserving infrastructure.
• Experience with SDKs across mobile, desktop, web, backend, or embedded environments.
• Familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Swift, Kotlin, C/C++, Rust, Go, or similar languages.
• Experience with enterprise developer platforms, B2B SaaS infrastructure, AI platforms, or developer-led growth motions.
• Experience with API design, semantic versioning, package management, release channels, compatibility guarantees, and migration planning.
• Experience conducting developer interviews, usability testing, technical workshops, hackathons, or enterprise customer discovery.
• Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA as they relate to AI products and developer platforms. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

• Product Vision & Strategy: Define and champion the product vision for the QVAC SDK, aligning technical capabilities with Tether’s broader objectives around local AI, privacy, decentralization, and P2P infrastructure. • SDK Ownership: Own the roadmap for SDK capabilities, APIs, developer workflows, integrations, documentation, examples, templates, and tooling. Prioritize features that make it easier for developers to build, test, deploy, and scale Local AI applications using QVAC.

About the job We’re hiring an Economic Policy Analyst to shape stablecoin regulation through data. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of blockchain, data science, and regulating the economy of the future. As an Economic Policy Analyst, you'll combine deep knowledge of stablecoin policy with unparalleled access to data to partner with our Regulatory Affairs and Licensing team in shaping global regulation. You will produce original economic analysis, synthesize emerging research, and translate complex data into clear arguments for regulators and policymakers. You will work within the Economics team, where our mission is to quantify and communicate the impact of Tether’s technologies, primarily our stablecoin, USDt. We are a lean, fully remote, team that leverages thoughtful decision-making, experiments, technology, and vendor partnerships to scale. Our work is impactful, opinionated, and precise. We thrive on collaboration, autonomy, and delivering meaningful outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. You’ll work on new and complex policy issues with agility, curiosity to learn about the domain, and a willingness to stretch yourself. Responsibilities You’ll be responsible for:
• Original analysis: you will leverage data to answer questions such as the macroeconomic impact of stablecoins within countries, the performance of stability mechanisms, or the role of self-hosted wallets in the ecosystem.
• Emerging research: you will monitor and synthesize output from institutions such as the IMF, BIS, and FSB to anticipate and respond to emerging policy concerns.
• Stakeholder communication: you will produce the briefs, submissions, and presentations that bring data and economic evidence into global stablecoin regulation. You’ll be successful if you focus on:
• Creativity: You develop novel, rigorous methods to put numbers to hard-to-quantify issues, leading to analysis that shifts policy debates.
• Communication: Stakeholders easily understand your findings and your research influences the development of better stablecoin regulation.
• Growth: Your approach reflects the scale and speed of the business: you build frameworks, prioritise ruthlessly, and develop a body of work that compounds over time. You're an experienced and self-motivated economist who is opinionated yet collaborative. You know the techniques and language of economic policy analysis, and are comfortable applying them to problems that don't yet have established answers. Autonomy and remote work brings out the best in you. You have the courage to challenge consensus views and the rigour to back your positions with evidence. You typically work in or to the west of the Central European timezone. Required skills and experience:
• Deep experience in economic policy analysis and knowledge of econometric techniques for policy evaluation.
• Knowledge of regulatory issues in the stablecoin and digital asset industry.
• Expertise in quantitative analysis using languages such as SQL, R, or Python.
• Proven ability to author policy briefs, public submissions, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
• Proven ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment. Preferred skills and experience:
• A PhD or Masters degree in Economics or a related field.
• Experience in statistical analysis of macroeconomic and financial data.
• An existing network within regulatory bodies or central banks. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

About the job: The Data & Payments Analyst supports the Compliance and Data & Payments functions by assisting with operational, administrative, and analytical activities related to transaction monitoring, KYT, Travel Rule processes, and payment operations. This role focuses on execution, accuracy, learning, and development, providing foundational support to ensure processes are completed efficiently, consistently, and in line with internal procedures and regulatory expectations. The role also supports Acquire and Redeem payment processes, internal reviews, alert handling, and case management, while progressively developing AML, blockchain, and investigative competencies under supervision. Responsibilities:
• Support Data & Payments and Compliance teams with operational and analytical tasks.
• Assist in Transaction Monitoring (TM), KYT, and Travel Rule processes.
• Support Acquire & Redeem payment processing activities.
• Perform basic case reviews and data validation.
• Maintain accurate case files and documentation.
• Support alert triage and escalation processes.
• Assist in internal data requests and reporting.
• Support client and banking partner communications.
• Follow documented procedures and workflows.
• Contribute to internal projects and process improvement initiatives.
• Develop AML, blockchain, and investigative knowledge.
• Escalate issues, risks, and anomalies to senior team members.
• Maintain data accuracy and operational integrity.
• Other duties as assigned by senior team members In addition to the skill set preferred requirements listed below the incumbent must be able to work independently with minimum supervision, (seeking guidance as required), flexible as to working arrangement and hours and confident in making decisions as delegated by the Data and Payments Lead and Head of AML.
• Secondary education (University or College Preferred).
• Experience in an analytical or investigative function.
• Introductory level AML experience including customer and enhanced due diligence(CDD/EDD), and AML/CTF/Sanctions Investigations.

titleByLocale.fr: Operations Associate / Senior Associate-Finance (US hours)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Be part of our Finance team: The Operations Associate/Senior associate will support the day-to-day operations of a multi-asset investment and treasury platform , with responsibilities spanning trade operations, reconciliations, digital asset workflows, and process automation. The role requires a highly detail-oriented individual with strong technical capability and experience operating in fast-paced financial markets environments. Responsibilities ● Manage trade confirmations, settlements, and lifecycle events across multiple asset classes. ● Oversee wallet, custodian, and digital asset operational processes. ● Perform daily booking and reconciliation of securities positions, cash balances, and P&L across internal systems. ● Investigate and resolve trade breaks, settlement issues, and operational discrepancies with counterparties and custodians. ● Support operational controls relating to treasury, trading, and digital asset activities. ● Assist with audit requests, confirmations, and supporting documentation. ● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reporting. ● Build, enhance, and maintain operational workflows, internal tooling, and automation processes. ● Identify opportunities for process optimisation and operational scalability. ● Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and user guides. ● Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. Preferred qualifications/Requirements: ● Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field. ● 7+ years of operations experience preferably at a credit hedge fund. ● experience in digital assets or blockchain ecosystem(good to have but not mandatory) ● Proficiency in Enfusion portfolio management system. ● Proficiency in Excel + VBA / Python is mandatory. ● Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. ● Excellent attention to detail and communication skills. ● Strong understanding of trade lifecycles and settlement processes. ● Being able to work New York time: between (13H00 PM UK time -22H00 UK time) ● Being based in London (mandatory) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. About the job Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. The role oversees the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple interrelated mining projects: spanning exploration, development, operations readiness, stakeholder engagement, and institutional relations and also ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, regulatory requirements, and local community expectations. Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.
• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.
• Manage relationships with government authorities, regulators, and local institutions to advance permits, concessions, and policy engagement.
• Drive community and stakeholder engagement programs aligned with social license and ESG commitments.
• Monitor program risks, dependencies, and critical path; implement mitigation plans and escalate issues to the steering committee.
• Establish governance, reporting cadences, and KPIs across projects; produce executive-level updates.
• Oversee program budgets, capital expenditure tracking, and vendor/contract management.
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, international mining standards, and HSE requirements. Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification in Project/Program Management, Business, or related field preferred.
• Solid understanding of the mining lifecycle: exploration, feasibility, permitting, construction, and operations.
• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.
• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.
• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.
• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.
• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.
• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.
• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments. Preferred / Advantageous
• Prior experience operating in Central America.
• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.
• Experience interacting with public-sector counterparts and multilateral institutions. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Descrizione Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly in strutture geo-diverse all'avanguardia. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una centrale di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro The AI & Optimization Lead — Bitcoin Mining Operations giocherà un ruolo cruciale nella definizione e nell'esecuzione della visione AI per MOS (Mining Operating System) e MDK (Mining Development Kit) — le principali piattaforme FOSS che alimentano le operazioni di Bitcoin-mining di Tether in tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo è responsabile della progettazione dei modelli di base dati e AI che guidano l'efficienza operativa nel mondo reale attraverso i siti minerari, con un focus sull'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, le intuizioni predittive e l'automazione intelligente. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con team di ingegneria, dati e operazioni per definire una base di dati strutturata, garantire la modellazione di dati di alta qualità e sviluppare soluzioni basate su AI completamente integrate in MOS/MDK. La vostra missione è semplice e ambiziosa: trasformare i dati in intelligenza - e l'intelligenza in efficienza di livello del sito. Un forte background nell'architettura dei dati, nella modellazione, nei sistemi ML/AI e nell'ottimizzazione matematica è essenziale. L'esposizione precedente agli ambienti minerari o industriali/IoT di Bitcoin è altamente preziosa, ma non obbligatoria. ## Responsabilità ## AI Vision & Strategy - Definire e guidare la strategia AI per MOS & MDK con un focus sull'efficienza operativa e sui risultati aziendali misurabili. - Tradurre sfide operative nei dati e problemi di ottimizzazione che i modelli AI possono risolvere. - Stabilire strutture best practice per sistemi AI scalabili, pronti alla produzione. ### Data Foundation & Modelling - Progettare una base dati standardizzata / schema per tutte le telemetrie e gli eventi del cantiere minerario. - Assicurare che i dati siano strutturati, normalizzati, etichettati e accessibili per casi di utilizzo AI/ML. - Lavorare con gli ingegneri backend per evolvere gli standard di data pipeline e integrazione. ### Model Development & Optimization - Costruire e distribuire modelli ML/AI e di ottimizzazione come: - ottimizzazione delle prestazioni - rilevamento di anomalia - guasto predittivo & manutenzione - insight di efficienza energetica - raccomandazioni di automazione operativa - Valutare costantemente e migliorare le prestazioni del modello nella produzione. ### Integration & Delivery - Lavora con i team di ingegneria MOS & MDK per incorporare i modelli AI nei flussi di lavoro delle piattaforme e API. - Assicurare i modelli sono efficienti, affidabili, spiegabili e manutenbili. ### Cross-Team Collaboration - Collabora con i team di site-operation per convalidare i risultati e raccogliere feedback. - Allineare con la leadership sulla mappa stradale AI, priorità, monitoraggio degli impatti e KPI. - Sistemi di documentazione, architettura e presupposti di modellazione chiaramente. #### Culture & Mindset - Promuovere una cultura data-driven, efficiente-first all'interno del team di Mining Software. - Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze AI, ottimizzazione e analisi industriale. ##
• Requisiti - Laurea o Master in Informatica, Scienza dei dati, Matematica applicata, Ingegneria, Statistica, o simili. - 3+ anni di esperienza in AI/ML, scienza dei dati, o ruoli di ottimizzazione applicati. - Prove esperienze progettando modelli di dati / schemi / linee di base per set di dati su larga scala, serie temporali-pesanti. - Forte competenza in Python e moderni framework ML (per esempio PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn). - Forte competenza JavaScript / TypeScript (ecosistema Node.js) - Familiarità con carichi di lavoro containerizzati (Docker) - Esperienza di sviluppo e distribuzione di serie temporali, rilevamento di anomalia, classificazione e modelli predittivi per apparecchiature/sistemi meccanici, elettromeccanici o hardware-intensivi in ambienti di produzione. - Solida comprensione dell'elaborazione del segnale e dell'estrazione delle caratteristiche per i dati del sensore (ad esempio, segnali elettrici, termici, vibrazioni o telemetria). - Solida comprensione delle tecniche di ottimizzazione (programmazione lineare/non lineare, simulazione, sistemi decisionali, ecc.). - Esperienza di distribuzione, monitoraggio, mantenimento dei modelli AI nei sistemi di produzione, tra cui gestione del modello deriva e condizioni operative in evoluzione. - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese e capacità di collaborare in team distribuiti. ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli: - Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento, a meno che non sia chiaro. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina di carriera ufficiale: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Verificare l’identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. - No. Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali. - Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether.to o @ tether. io - Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. - No. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT , sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais ce n'est que le début : Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance mondiale et des opportunités. L'évolution de l'approche : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos de l'emploi L'IA & Optimization Lead — Bitcoin Mining Operations jouera un rôle crucial dans la définition et l'exécution de la vision AI pour MOS (Mining Operating System) et MDK (Mining Development Kit) — le noyau des plates-formes FOSS d'alimentation de Tether. Ce rôle est responsable de la conception de la base de données et des modèles d'IA qui stimulent l'efficacité opérationnelle dans le monde réel à travers les sites miniers, en mettant l'accent sur l'optimisation des performances, les prévisions et l'automatisation intelligente. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de données et d'opérations afin de définir une base de données structurée, d'assurer une modélisation de données de haute qualité et de développer des solutions basées sur l'IA qui sont pleinement intégrées dans MOS/MDK.
• Votre mission est simple et ambitieuse: transformer les données en intelligence — et le renseignement en efficacité au niveau du site. Une solide expérience en architecture de données, en modélisation, en systèmes ML/AI et en optimisation mathématique est essentielle. Avant l'exposition à l'exploitation minière Bitcoin ou des environnements industriels/IoT est très précieux, mais pas obligatoire. ## Responsabilités ### Vision et stratégie d'IA - Définir et diriger la stratégie d'IA pour les MOS et les MDC en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité opérationnelle et les résultats opérationnels mesurables. - Traduire les défis opérationnels en données et les problèmes d'optimisation que les modèles d'IA peuvent résoudre. - Établir des cadres de meilleures pratiques pour les systèmes d'IA évolutifs et prêts à produire. ### Base de données et modélisation - Concevoir une base de données normalisée / schéma pour toutes les télémétries et les événements dans les sites miniers. - S'assurer que les données sont structurées, normalisées, étiquetées et accessibles pour les cas d'utilisation d'IA/ML. - Collaborer avec les ingénieurs de backend pour développer le pipeline de données et les normes d'intégration. ### Développement et optimisation des modèles - Construisez et déployez des modèles ML/AI et d'optimisation tels que: - optimisation des performances - détection d'anomalies - défaillance prédictive et maintenance - éclairages sur l'efficacité énergétique - recommandations d'automatisation opérationnelle - Évaluer et améliorer continuellement les performances des modèles dans la production. ### Intégration et livraison - Travaillez avec les équipes d'ingénierie MOS & MDK pour intégrer les modèles d'IA dans les workflows de plate-forme et les API. - S'assurer que les modèles sont efficaces, fiables, explicables et durables. ### Collaboration entre les équipes - Collaborer avec les équipes d'opérations sur place pour valider les résultats et recueillir des commentaires. - S'aligner avec le leadership sur la feuille de route, les priorités, le suivi de l'impact et les ICR. - Systèmes de documentation, architecture et hypothèses de modélisation clairement. ### Culture & Mindset - Promouvoir une culture axée sur les données et l'efficacité en premier au sein de l'équipe du logiciel minier. - Restez informé des tendances de l'IA, de l'optimisation et de l'analyse industrielle. ##
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou Master en Informatique, Data Science, Mathématiques appliquées, Ingénierie, Statistiques, ou similaire. - 3+ ans d'expérience en AI/ML, Data Science, ou les rôles d'optimisation appliquée. - Expérience éprouvée en matière de conception de modèles de données / schémas / lignes de base pour des ensembles de données à grande échelle, séries chronologiques et lourdes. - Forte maîtrise du Python et des cadres ML modernes (p. ex. PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn). - Forte compétence JavaScript / TypeScript (écosystème Node.js) - Familiarité avec les charges de travail conteneurisées (Docker) - Expérience de développement et de déploiement de séries chronologiques, de détection d'anomalies, de classification et de modèles prédictifs pour les équipements/systèmes mécaniques, électromécaniques ou à forte intensité matérielle dans les environnements de production. - Compréhension solide du traitement des signaux et extraction des caractéristiques pour les données des capteurs (p. ex. signaux électriques, thermiques, vibratoires ou télémétriques). - Une bonne compréhension des techniques d'optimisation (programmation linéaire/non linéaire, simulation, systèmes de décision, etc.). - Expérience du déploiement, de la surveillance, de la maintenance des modèles d'IA dans les systèmes de production, y compris la dérive des modèles de manutention et l'évolution des conditions d'exploitation. - Excellente capacité de communication et de collaboration en anglais dans les équipes distribuées. ## Information importantei per i candidati Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lorsque vous postulez pour des rôles : - Appliquer uniquement par le biais de nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement à moins d'indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont listés sur notre page de carrière officielle : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Oui. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ sether. io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. - Oui. descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses — from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs — to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re hiring a Research Analyst to identify and communicate the trends that will drive the next wave of stablecoin adoption. The title is negotiable, ranging from analyst to lead analyst. What matters is the experience you bring and the insight you can deliver. This is a rare opportunity to work at the intersection of blockchain, data science, and measuring the economy of the future. As a Research Analyst, you’ll combine industry knowledge with unparalleled access to data to understand what drives adoption of stablecoins today and in the future. You will develop new ways to understand the ecosystem and validate them with data. You’ll share insights, via reports, presentations, and data visualizations, with internal teams and for external communication. For the deepest insights, you’ll help put them in production for continuous monitoring and dashboarding. You will work within the Economics team, where our mission is to quantify and communicate the impact of Tether’s technologies, primarily our stablecoin, USDt. We are a lean, fully remote, team that leverages thoughtful decision-making, experiments, technology, and vendor partnerships to scale. Our work is impactful, opinionated, and precise. We thrive on collaboration, autonomy, and delivering meaningful outcomes without unnecessary bureaucracy. You’ll work on new and complex data analysis with agility, curiosity to learn about the domain, and a willingness to stretch yourself. Responsibilities You’ll be responsible for researching the stablecoin industry, covering:
• Use cases and users: current and emerging use cases for stablecoins, and the user journey and adoption of these use cases.
• Market structure: current and emerging venues for stablecoin usage, and their competitive dynamics.
• Opportunities: future channels for stablecoin adoption and their timing and venues. You’ll be successful if you focus on:
• Curiosity: You develop and test hypotheses that lead to novel insights, which change how the business thinks and acts.
• Communication: Stakeholders easily understand your findings and act on them; your external research is cited and shared across the industry.
• Growth: Your approach to research reflects the scale and speed of the business: you build context, prioritise ruthlessly, and automate wherever possible. You’re an experienced and self-motivated researcher who is opinionated yet collaborative. You’re an expert in your domain yet willing to work on new problems and support the team. Autonomy and remote work brings out the best in you. You have the courage to be wrong in your analysis and the pride to learn why because, above all else, you care about the impact your work has. You typically work in or to the west of the Central European timezone, which may include American timezones. Required skills and experience:
• Deep knowledge of the stablecoin and digital asset industry.
• Deep expertise in quantitative analysis using languages such as SQL, R, or Python, and expertise in version control (e.g. GitHub).
• Proven ability to present findings to senior internal stakeholders and author external-facing research.
• Proven ability to work independently and communicate effectively in a remote environment. Preferred skills and experience:
• An existing network within the stablecoin and digital asset industry.
• Experience working with blockchain data.
• Hands-on experience with data warehouses (e.g. Databricks) and dbt.
• Experience with JavaScript for dashboard development. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

You’ll share insights, via reports, presentations, and data visualizations, with internal teams and for external communication. About the job Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain. Responsibilities
• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.
• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.
• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.
• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.
• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.
• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.
• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.
• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.
• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk. Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.
• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.
• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).
• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).
• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.
• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.
• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement. Preferred / Advantageous
• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).
• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.

About the job Senior Business Analysts specializing in the mining sector to support M&A advisory and investment banking activities focused on mining-related opportunities. The role bridges technical geological expertise with commercial and financial analysis, evaluating mining assets, transactions, and investment opportunities across the resources value chain. Responsibilities
• Conduct due diligence on mining assets and companies, integrating geological, technical, and commercial assessments.
• Build and maintain financial models (DCF, NAV, comparable transactions and companies) for mining projects and corporate transactions.
• Analyze mineral resource and reserve statements (JORC, NI 43-101, or equivalent) and assess their commercial implications.
• Evaluate mining project economics, including capex/opex profiles, production schedules, commodity price assumptions, and risk factors.
• Prepare investment memoranda, pitch books, valuation summaries, and board-level presentations.
• Monitor commodity markets, mining sector trends, M&A activity, and the competitive landscape.
• Support deal execution, including coordination with technical consultants, legal teams, and counterparties.
• Assess geopolitical, permitting, environmental, and ESG risks affecting mining investments.
• Structure and evaluate alternative and structured financing schemes for mining operations, including metal prepays, royalties, streaming agreements, offtake and marketing arrangements, and debt/equity hybrids, and assess their impact on project economics and counterparty risk. Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Geological Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Earth Sciences.
• 5+ years of relevant experience in mining, investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, or technical/financial advisory within the resources sector.
• Exposure to M&A transactions, project finance, or asset valuation in mining is highly desirable.
• Formal business education or training is a plus (MBA, finance/business degree, CFA progress, or equivalent practical commercial experience).
• Demonstrated understanding of mineral resource classification codes (JORC, NI 43-101, SAMREC, or similar).
• Working knowledge of structured financing instruments used in the mining sector, including prepays, royalties, streams, and offtake agreements.
• Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
• Ability to translate technical geological data into commercial and financial insight.
• Advanced proficiency in Excel; familiarity with mining technical software (e.g., resource and mine-planning tools) is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, including report and presentation preparation.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure.
• Attention to detail and sound commercial judgement. Preferred / Advantageous
• Experience across multiple commodities (e.g., base metals, precious metals, bulk commodities, battery metals).
• Knowledge of ESG frameworks relevant to mining.
• Additional languages and willingness to travel to project sites. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices. Native module development
• Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests
• Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript
• Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list Cross-platform builds and CI
• Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode)
• Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform
• Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms
• Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues Bare Runtime contributions
• Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads)
• Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface
• Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry Debugging and quality
• Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile
• Write and maintain tests for all modules Collaboration and communication
• Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public.
• Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing .
• Participate in a weekly status call.
• Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials.
• Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet).
• Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms.
• Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of Node.js internals and the module ecosystem.
• Experience building native addons for Node.js or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent).
• Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks.
• Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains.
• Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem).
• Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases.
• Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills.

About the job Program Manager with a solid background in the mining industry to lead and coordinate strategic initiatives in Central America. • Lead end-to-end program management for mining initiatives in Central America, integrating exploration, technical studies, permitting, and operational readiness workstreams.
• Define program scope, objectives, milestones, budgets, and resource plans, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams (geology, engineering, environmental, legal, finance, community relations) and external consultants.

• 6+ years of progressive experience in the mining industry, with at least 3-5 years managing complex programs or multi-project portfolios.
• Program/project management certification (PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated experience working with government authorities, regulators, and local communities, ideally in Latin America.
• Track record managing budgets, schedules, and multidisciplinary teams in greenfield or brownfield mining environments.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural communication skills.
• Excellent planning, organizational, and risk-management capabilities.
• Proficiency in program management tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and reporting platforms.
• Strong written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.
• Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and resilience in complex, high-visibility environments. Preferred / Advantageous
• Prior experience operating in Central America.
• Familiarity with ESG frameworks, social performance standards (IFC PS, ICMM), and community development programs.

• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job The Engagement Manager will lead the implementation journey of tokenization projects based on Hadron for institutional clients, acting as the primary technical and business point of contact throughout onboarding and early operations. This role is pivotal in ensuring a seamless transition from contract signature through the first production token issuance and continuous monitoring of the initiative, maintaining alignment across stakeholders, and coordinating execution across internal teams, client counterparts, and external partners. As Engagement Manager, you can expect to work with global institutional clients across multiple geographies and asset classes on complex tokenization initiatives involving digital asset issuance, custody frameworks, and integration into existing financial infrastructures within a regulated and rapidly evolving environment. This role offers the opportunity to actively shape how institutions adopt tokenized assets, operating in a fully remote setup with flexible global collaboration. As the scope and volume of implementations grow, there is a clear path to evolve into broader technical strategy or client success leadership roles. Responsibilities Before the engagement (pre-sales)
• Assist Expansion Managers in preparing and conducting demos
• As consultant, propose solutions during pre-sales phase of the engagement
• Assist in defining the engagement scope, ensuring it’s correctly reflected in the Client agreement Onboarding & Integration
• Lead project kickoffs and define the integration roadmap with clients
• Guide clients through API documentation, sandbox testing, and UAT
• Diagnose and troubleshoot client integration issues
• Coordinate between clients, engineering teams, and external infrastructure partners during integrations
• Track onboarding progress, milestones, and dependencies to ensure clients reach production within expected timelines
• Prepare clients for production launch and conduct monitoring and hyper-care after launch
• Maintain an enterprise-grade, consulting-like knowledge base around implementation use cases
• Create integration documentation and operational runbooks and adapt them as needed to tailor each client implementation Client Communication & Problem-Solving
• Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the execution of the engagement
• Translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders
• Identify integration pain points and escalate product feedback
• Proactively communicate timelines, blockers, and dependencies
• Support transition clients to self-service with comprehensive documentation
• Proactively identify up- and cross-sell opportunities, to be passed on to Expansion Managers What You Won’t Do
• Write or audit smart contracts (clients own their tokenomics)
• Perform regulatory or legal structuring
• Build custom features or bespoke integrations Core skills
• 3–6 years of experience in technical account management , solutions engineering, technical consulting, project management of technical implementations or integrations, or client success management
• Strong understanding of APIs and system integrations
• Comfort diagnosing and resolving integration issues
• Excellent communication skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders
• Experience coordinating across multiple teams and external partners
• Ability to track and manage technical project timelines
• English proficiency is mandatory Nice to Have
• Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure or digital assets
• Experience with fintech or institutional financial infrastructure
• Familiarity with token standards (ERC-20, ERC-1400) or Ethereum basics
• Background in fin-tech, supporting financial institutions or complex B2B integrations
• Basic programming knowledge ( Python, JavaScript ) or API tools Who You Are
• Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, global environment
• Self-directed and able to own integration workflows end-to-end
• Detail-oriented, documenting decisions and learnings as you go
• Collaborative, able to work effectively with engineering teams and demanding clients
• Interested in the intersection of financial infrastructure and blockchain technology Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

About the job As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking a Vendor & Procurement Manager to oversee all aspects of procurement, contracting, and relationship management related to development outsourcing — including software development partners, technology service providers, and specialized consultants in the field of app development, blockchain, AI engineering, P2P technologies, and digital assets. The ideal candidate will combine strong commercial acumen with a technical understanding of development processes, ensuring that external resources are aligned with internal delivery, quality, and cost objectives. Responsibilities
• Vendor & Supplier Management
• Coordinate assessment and onboard new development and technology outsourcing partners.
• Maintain a structured vendor registry and performance database.
• Ensure proper monitoring of supplier performance across stakeholders (technical architects, product and project managers)
• Lead regular reviews and ensure continuous improvement from suppliers. 2. Procurement & Contracting
• Drive end-to-end procurement processes for outsourced development initiatives, from collection of requirements from internal stakeholders to contract negotiation and award.
• Collaborate with Legal to define contract terms, SLAs, NDAs, and master service agreements.
• Ensure compliance with company procurement policies (e.g., data protection, IP ownership, open-source software, coding standards). 3. Financial & Commercial Oversight
• Control vendor budgets, purchase orders, and invoicing workflows.
• Support forecasting and cost optimization across multi-vendor environments.
• Identify opportunities for consolidation, cost efficiencies, and strategic partnerships. 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Project Management teams to translate technical requirements into vendor scopes.
• Support project managers in vendor selection, resource allocation, and escalation management.
• Anticipate vendor-related issues, disputes, or performance shortcomings and escalate as appropriate. 5. Strategic Development Sourcing
• Map capabilities of external development partners (AI, blockchain, backend, frontend, QA, DevOps, etc.).
• Lead vendor evaluation and due diligence processes for new technologies or geographies.
• Contribute to make-vs-buy decisions and outsourcing strategy evolution.
• 3+ years of experience at the intersection of technology, innovation, and strategic sourcing, procurement and vendor management .
• Demonstrated ability of shaping the company’s outsourcing and supplier ecosystem in a high-growth environment.
• Collaborate with world-class technical and business teams across multiple regions.

• Coordinate assessment and onboard new development and technology outsourcing partners.
• Maintain a structured vendor registry and performance database.
• Ensure proper monitoring of supplier performance across stakeholders (technical architects, product and project managers)

• Support project managers in vendor selection, resource allocation, and escalation management.
• Anticipate vendor-related issues, disputes, or performance shortcomings and escalate as appropriate. 5. Strategic Development Sourcing
• Map capabilities of external development partners (AI, blockchain, backend, frontend, QA, DevOps, etc.).
• Lead vendor evaluation and due diligence processes for new technologies or geographies.
• Contribute to make-vs-buy decisions and outsourcing strategy evolution.
• 3+ years of experience at the intersection of technology, innovation, and strategic sourcing, procurement and vendor management .
• Demonstrated ability of shaping the company’s outsourcing and supplier ecosystem in a high-growth environment.

About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features . You will also contribute to backend components when needed to support mobile features and unblock mobile delivery. You will also provide technical leadership , guide mobile engineering best practices, and support other engineers through reviews and mentoring. Responsibilities
• Leadership: Lead a small group of React Native engineers. Drive architectural decisions, enforce coding standards, and ensure timely high quality delivery.
• Development: Design and build advanced cross platform applications for the iOS and Android platforms using React Native, review work from other engineers to ensure quality and architectural alignment, and contribute to backend services or APIs when required to support mobile functionality.
• Integration: Work closely with backend developers, integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications, and extend backend logic when needed to complete end-to-end features.
• Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions.
• Architecture: Own and define patterns for state management, navigation, performance, modularization, and security across mobile applications. Mandatory
• Thoroughly experienced with React, React-Native (mainly around Expo), Redux and the core principles surrounding these.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools .
• Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
• Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation.
• Proven experience leading or mentoring mobile engineers .
• Demonstrated ability to own architecture for large scale React Native applications .
• Strong decision making skills in evaluating frameworks, tooling, and mobile development patterns.
• Experience with b ackend development using Node or similar environments , with the ability to implement or adjust APIs and services that power mobile features.

But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features . You will also contribute to backend components when needed to support mobile features and unblock mobile delivery. • Architecture: Own and define patterns for state management, navigation, performance, modularization, and security across mobile applications. Mandatory

• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ .
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
