descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, we are seeking a highly organized and strategically minded Account Manager to oversee complex, cross-functional initiatives involving digital wallets and payments, asset tokenization, P2P technologies, and decentralized AI. The role combines client engagement, project governance, and multi-stakeholder coordination across external companies, government entities, and internal teams. This position is pivotal in ensuring timely delivery of strategic programs, maintaining alignment between stakeholders, and supporting the deployment of transformational technologies in a fast-paced, regulated environment. Responsibilities Client & Partner Engagement
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients and institutional partners, ensuring consistent communication, expectation management, and long-term relationship building.
• Coordinate with external companies providing payment and exchange services, government institutions, and technology vendors.
• Liaise with Expansion team to support the definition of collaboration opportunities across sectors.
• Identify cross-initiative opportunities to introduce and leverage multiple Tether technologies Project Governance & Delivery Oversight
• Oversee implementation progress led by Product Managers and ensure alignment with contractual terms, expectations, and delivery timelines.
• Maintain governance frameworks including meeting notes, action logs, risk registers, and decision records.
• Drive accountability by ensuring tasks, responsibilities, and milestones are clearly tracked and documented.
• Support escalation management to Head of Technology Distribution and ensure timely resolution of operational or strategic issues. Cross-Team and Stakeholders Coordination
• Facilitate information flow between internal product, engineering, legal/compliance, marketing and operations teams.
• Maintain dashboards and executive reports summarizing status, risks, and next steps.
• Engage and maintain relationships with external companies involved in the initiative at all levels
• 5+ years of experience in account management, program coordination, or project governance within technology, fintech, or consulting environments.
• Experience in overseeing implementation of advanced tech solutions
• Skilled at leading complex, preferably international, projects
• Proven ability to engage with corporate and government stakeholders at multiple levels.
• Understanding of digital assets, blockchain, or financial technology ecosystems will be an asset
• Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills.
• Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• English is a must, any other language a plus
• Crypto/blockchain/AI sourcing and vendor management expertise is an advantage Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

titleByLocale.fr: AI Recherche Ingénieur - Pre training

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in architecture development for cutting-edge models of various scales, including small, large, and multi-modal systems. Your work will enhance intelligence, improve efficiency, and introduce new capabilities to advance the field. You will have a deep expertise in LLM architectures, a strong grasp of pre-training optimization with a hands-on, research-driven approach. Your mission is to explore and implement novel techniques and algorithms that lead to groundbreaking advancements: data curation, strengthening baselines, identifying and resolving existing pre-training bottlenecks to push the limits of AI performance. Responsibilities :
• Conduct pre-training AI models on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs.
• Design, prototype, and scale innovative architectures to enhance model intelligence.
• Independently and collaboratively execute experiments, analyze results, and refine methodologies for optimal performance.
• Investigate, debug, and improve both model efficiency and computational performance.
• Contribute to the advancement of training systems to ensure seamless scalability and efficiency on target platforms.
• A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).
• Hands-on experience contributing to large-scale LLM training runs on large, distributed servers equipped with thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, ensuring scalability and impactful advancements in model performance.
• Familiarity and practical experience with large-scale, distributed training frameworks, libraries and tools.
• Deep knowledge of state-of-the-art transformer and non-transformer modifications aimed at enhancing intelligence, efficiency and scalability.
• Strong expertise in PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries with practical experience in model development, continual pretraining, and deployment.

About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
• Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
• Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
• Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
• Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.
• With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
• Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
• Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
• Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
• Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
• Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
• Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
• Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
• Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives. Responsibilities
• Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance : Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.
• Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership : Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.
• Regulatory Strategy Development : As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.
• Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.
• Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.
• Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.
• Extensive Hands-on experience in AI regulation is essential (non negotiable)
• Expertise on AI Governance & AI policy not only in Europe but in different jurisdictions ( This is a must since this is a global role)
• Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.
• Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.
• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.
• Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.
• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.
• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.
• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. - Oui. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. - Oui. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? - À propos du travail - Tether cherche un chef expérimenté et visionnaire des affaires réglementaires pour concevoir et exécuter des stratégies de réglementation mondiale pour notre entreprise Tether Data verticale. Chez Tether Data, nous nous engageons à faire des progrès pionniers dans les technologies d'IA et de pair à pair (P2P). Notre mission est d'innover et de diriger la création de solutions technologiques qui permettent aux personnes, aux communautés, aux villes et aux pays de devenir plus indépendants et souverains. Dans un monde en constante évolution et de plus en plus imprévisible, la technologie doit être utilisée pour garantir la liberté et le respect des droits de l'homme, plutôt que de capter la vie privée numérique. ## Responsabilità - Promotion des politiques, surveillance, analyse et orientation : Surveiller, analyser et communiquer les changements dans les politiques réglementaires mondiales, et conseiller les dirigeants sur les risques et les possibilités potentiels en matière de réglementation, tout en stimulant les initiatives visant à influencer les cadres réglementaires ainsi que la surveillance des changements dans l'ensemble des règlements afin d'assurer la conformité proactive au besoin. - Plaidoyer en matière de réglementation et leadership de la pensée : Diriger ou participer aux interactions des organismes de réglementation et aux activités de plaidoyer concernant la législation pertinente dans ce domaine. Collaborer avec les autorités réglementaires compétentes, les organismes de l'industrie, les communautés de collaboration et les décideurs pour façonner le paysage réglementaire de l'IA et du P2P. - Élaboration d'une stratégie de réglementation : Le cas échéant, diriger l'élaboration et l'exécution de stratégies de réglementation, identifier les marchés/s à partir desquels il est préférable de fonctionner, et veiller à ce que l'entreprise soit prête à se conformer aux réglementations nationales et internationales pertinentes. - Leadership interfonctionnel et développement de produits : Collaborer avec des équipes internes (p. ex., R-D, juridique, conformité) à la fois à Tether et avec nos partenaires afin d'intégrer des considérations réglementaires à la conception et au déploiement de modèles et de technologies d'IA, selon le cas. - Leadership de la pensée : agir en tant que leader de la pensée à l'extérieur et au sein de l'organisation, éduquer les équipes internes sur les questions réglementaires, les tendances et les meilleures pratiques dans l'espace AI et P2P. ##
• Requisiti - Expérience éprouvée dans un rôle de réglementation senior, idéalement dans les industries de la technologie, de l'IA ou du numérique. - Une vaste expérience pratique en matière de réglementation de l'IA est essentielle (non négociable) - Expertise en matière de gouvernance de l'IA et de politique de l'IA non seulement en Europe, mais aussi dans différentes juridictions (il s'agit là d'un impératif puisqu'il s'agit d'un rôle mondial) - Forte connaissance de la réglementation mondiale de l'IA, des lois sur la protection des données (p. ex. RGPD) et des tendances émergentes en matière de gouvernance de l'IA et de P2P. Le contexte juridique, de conformité ou de politique avec une compréhension approfondie des principes éthiques de l'IA est un atout. - Compréhension démontrée des architectures d'IA/P2P décentralisées, autosuffisantes et exécutées localement — et des implications réglementaires de ces modèles — distincte des approches traditionnelles centralisées des plates-formes. - Expérience démontrée en collaboration avec les organismes de réglementation et les organismes gouvernementaux qui préconisent et conseillent en matière de réglementation, avec des réalisations démontrées garantissant des positions politiques favorables au nom d'une autre organisation. - Expertise dans la préparation de documents réglementaires complexes et d'autres présentations réglementaires importantes, y compris la préparation et l'exécution d'interactions avec les autorités réglementaires. - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en droit, politique, informatique ou domaines connexes. - Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité de synthétiser des sujets réglementaires complexes pour les publics non techniques. - Capacité éprouvée de gérer plusieurs parties prenantes au-delà des frontières et des fuseaux horaires. - Communication : Compétences exceptionnelles en communication, tant écrite qu'orale, avec une expérience de la parole publique et de la représentation des entreprises dans les discussions réglementaires. - Doit être un acteur fort de l'équipe, et prêt à être pleinement engagé avec les parties prenantes clés à la fois dans notre entreprise mais aussi avec nos partenaires. Doit être un professionnel pratique capable de travailler en collaboration et de manière indépendante. ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati - Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit lorsque vous postulez pour des rôles : - Appliquer uniquement par le biais de nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement à moins d'indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont listés sur notre page de carrière officielle : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Oui. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses électroniques. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ sether. io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. - En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Tether is seeking an experienced and visionary Head of Regulatory Affairs to design and execute global regulatory affairs strategies for our Tether Data business vertical. At Tether Data, we are committed to pioneering advancements in AI and peer-to-peer (P2P) technologies. Our mission is to innovate and lead in the creation of technological solutions that empower people, communities, cities and countries to become more independent and sovereign. In a world constantly changing and becoming more unpredictable, technology should be used to ensure freedom and respect of human rights, rather than capturing people’s private digital lives. Responsibilities
• Policy Advocacy, Monitoring, Analysis and Guidance : Monitor, analyse and communicate changes in global regulatory policies, and advise executive leadership on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance where required.
• Regulatory Advocacy and Thought Leadership : Leading or participating in regulatory agency interactions and advocacy work regarding legislation relevant to this field. Engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, collaborative communities, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for AI and P2P.
• Regulatory Strategy Development : As appropriate, leading the development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable market/s from which to operate, and to ensure the company’s readiness for compliance with relevant national and international regulations.
• Cross-functional Leadership and Product Development : Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., R&D, legal, compliance) in both Tether and with our partners to to integrate regulatory considerations into the design and deployment of AI models and technologies, as applicable.
• Thought Leadership: Act as a thought leader both externally and within the organization, educating internal teams on regulatory issues, trends, and best practices in the AI and P2P space.
• Proven experience in a senior regulatory role, ideally within the technology, AI, or digital industries.
• Strong knowledge of global AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and emerging trends in AI and P2P governance. Legal, compliance, or policy background with a deep understanding of ethical AI principles is a plus.
• Demonstrated understanding of decentralised, self-sovereign and locally executed AI/P2P architectures—and the regulatory implications of these models—distinct from traditional centralised platform approaches.
• Demonstrated experience working with regulators and government bodies advocating and advising in a regulatory capacity, with demonstrated achievements securing favourable policy positions on behalf of another organisation.
• Expertise in preparing complex regulatory documents and other major regulatory submissions, including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Policy, Computer Science, or related fields.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex regulatory topics for non-technical audiences.
• Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across borders and time zones.
• Communication: Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.
• Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must be a hands-on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The primary goal of a Developer Relations is to engage, educate, and inspire the developer community - building trust, driving adoption of our technology, and ensuring developers have an exceptional experience with our products. This involves creating technical content, presenting at events, gathering feedback, and serving as the voice of the developer both externally and internally. The role is focused on bridging the gap between developers and our product teams, ensuring our solutions are accessible, well-understood, and developer-friendly, while fostering community growth, promoting best practices, and driving continuous improvement in how developers discover, learn, and build with our technology. Pear is a combined Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Runtime, Development & Deployment tool. Pear makes it possible to build, share and extend P2P applications using common Web and Mobile technology. Herein is everything needed to create unstoppable, zero-infrastructure P2P applications for Desktop, Terminal & Mobile. Responsibilities Developer Advocacy & Community Building
• Build and nurture relationships with developers, partners, and open-source communities.
• Engage and interact with the developer ecosystem — hosting AMAs, office hours, webinars, and play a part in online communities.
• Collect and synthesize developer feedback to inform product and engineering teams.
• Identify influential developers, projects, and communities to establish collaboration opportunities. Technical Content & Enablement
• Create and maintain high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, sample apps, videos, documentation, SDK guides, etc.) directly targeted to developers.
• Develop demos, prototypes, and reference implementations that showcase real-world use cases.
• Contribute to improving developer experience through documentation feedback, onboarding flows, and API design suggestions.
• Support developer onboarding through workshops, hackathons, and training sessions. Product Evangelism
• Advocate for the company’s technology stack at industry events, developer meetups, and online communities.
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, relatable value propositions.
• Collaborate with marketing to align technical storytelling with broader brand messaging.
• Track and report community sentiment and adoption metrics to measure evangelism impact. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with engineering, product management, and marketing to align developer needs with product strategy.
• Provide structured feedback loops between external developers and internal teams to improve product usability.
• Support launch strategies for new developer-facing features, APIs, and SDKs.
• Contribute to roadmap discussions to ensure developer experience remains a strategic priority.
• Support initial technical discussions with potential customers and partners Thought Leadership
• Represent the company as a credible technical voice in the ecosystem through public speaking, open-source contributions, and community engagement.
• Stay ahead of industry trends, tools, and frameworks relevant to the developer community.
• Mentor internal teams on effective developer communication and community engagement practices.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field - or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of professional software development experience.
• Previous experience as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations, or Technical Community Manager.
• Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js - able to write production-level code and explain it clearly to other developers.
• Demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining applications or APIs.
• Proven ability to create technical content (tutorials, sample projects, blog posts, videos, or documentation) that educates and inspires developers.
• Experience presenting at public events, such as developer conferences, meetups, webinars, or internal company talks.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into simple, engaging messages.
• Experience engaging with developer communities through events, GitHub, forums, or social media.
• Strong understanding of developer experience principles and best practices.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and marketing teams.
• Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love)
• Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems
• English fluency — outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required for public-facing content and developer engagement. Preferred
• Experience designing, documenting, or promoting SDKs or developer tools.
• Experience developing or integrating apps (web, mobile, or desktop).
• 4–6 years of experience in software development or developer relations.
• Experience leveraging AI tools (such as Cursor, Codex, or similar AI-assisted development workflows) to enhance productivity and problem-solving efficiency
• Contributions to open-source projects or maintaining public GitHub repositories.
• Understanding of DevRel success metrics - content reach, community engagement, and product adoption.
• Experience in technical writing, developer education, or public speaking.
• Passion for community building, mentoring, and empowering developers through content and collaboration. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e Forma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly in strutture geo-diverse all'avanguardia. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? The Senior Manager, Asset Management Reporting è un ruolo senior all’interno della funzione di gestione patrimoniale di Tether, responsabile delle principali analisi di report e performance a livello di portafoglio in un portafoglio di investimenti multi-milioni e multi-attivo. La posizione garantisce una visibilità costante e di alta qualità nelle prestazioni del portafoglio per la leadership senior. About the job The Senior Manager, Asset Management Reporting is a senior role within Tether’s asset management function, responsible for leading portfolio-level reporting and performance analytics across a global, multi-billion, multi asset investment portfolio. The position ensures consistent, high-quality visibility into portfolio performance for senior leadership. The role serves as a central coordination point for asset management reporting, working closely with investment and finance teams to consolidate information, produce structured insights, and maintain disciplined reporting standards across the portfolio. Responsibilities ● Oversee portfolio-wide asset management reporting, including recurring performance updates and board-level materials. ● Oversee reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance metrics in alignment with asset management standards. ● Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of portfolio data across reporting outputs. ● Consolidate financial and operational information from investment teams into structured reporting formats. ● Provide performance analysis, variance commentary, and trend insights for senior leadership. ● Support governance and committee processes through preparation of reporting and analytics materials. ● 7-12+ years of experience in asset management, portfolio reporting, performance analytics, or a related role within investment-driven organizations. ● Strong experience producing board-level reporting, dashboards, and recurring performance materials. ● Excellent analytical skills and high attention to detail, with comfort managing complex data sets and recurring reporting cycles. ● High proficiency in Excel and presentation tools; experience with reporting systems or BI tools is a plus. ● Structured, process-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and execution discipline. ● Ability to work effectively across teams and engage confidently with senior stakeholders. ● Experience operating in global, fast-scaling, and predominantly remote organizations is a plus. Informazioni sul lavoro Il Senior Technical Product Manager sarà responsabile della leadership complessiva di prodotto di Hadron, inclusa la visione del prodotto, la definizione della roadmap e l'esecuzione della consegna. Il ruolo rappresenta il punto unico di responsabilità per la piattaforma nel soddisfare le esigenze istituzionali dei clienti, l'erogazione ingegneristica e i requisiti normativi/di conformità. A differenza di un ruolo tradizionale di Product Manager, questa posizione richiede un'autorità decisionale chiara per:
• Stabilire e far rispettare le priorità della roadmap, incluso il contrasto su richieste non essenziali.
• Coordinarsi con partner ingegneristici esterni e mantenere la disciplina di ambito.
• Risolvere i conflitti tra richieste del cliente, fattibilità tecnica e vincoli di conformità.
• Prendere decisioni su integrazioni, funzionalità di prodotto e rilascio.
• Garantire che lo sviluppo del prodotto sia allineato all'architettura a lungo termine e alla scalabilità della piattaforma Hadron. Contesto critico Hadron serve clienti istituzionali a livello globale con requisiti di tokenizzazione diversi e spesso contrastanti, inclusi diverse classi di asset, reti blockchain, framework di conformità e modelli di distribuzione. Il Product Manager deve gestire questa complessità mantenendo una strategia di prodotto chiara, dando priorità senza pietà e prevenendo l'espansione dell'ambito. Il ruolo richiede una forte responsabilità e la capacità di prendere decisioni difficili di priorità in un ambiente istituzionale in rapida evoluzione. Reportistica e Collaborazione Riporta a: VP Prodotto Il Product Manager lavora in stretta collaborazione con il Head of Expansion & Product Advisor di Hadron per garantire un forte allineamento tra la domanda istituzionale dei clienti, le opportunità di mercato e la roadmap del prodotto Hadron. Il Responsabile dell'Espansione e del Consulente di Prodotto fornisce feedback di mercato continuo basato su coinvolgimenti istituzionali con i clienti e partnership strategiche, assicurando che lo sviluppo del prodotto rifletta la reale domanda del mercato. Il Product Manager è responsabile di tradurre questi input in priorità di prodotto, decisioni sulla roadmap ed esecuzione ingegneristica. Iniziative principali di roadmap, richieste di funzionalità guidate dai clienti e nuove integrazioni dovrebbero essere allineate tra il Product Manager e il Head of Expansion & Product Advisor prima dell'implementazione. Il candidato ideale Stiamo cercando specificamente candidati che abbiano operato a livello senior e che possano dimostrare una profonda e pratica esperienza alla tokenizzazione e all'infrastruttura finanziaria tradizionale. Dovresti essere in grado di riconoscerti nella maggior parte dei seguenti aspetti: Tokenizzazione, end-to-end
• Hai personalmente costruito, spedito o posseduto un prodotto di tokenizzazione — dall'onboarding degli asset e specifiche degli smart contract fino all'integrazione della custodia, alla gestione della tabelle di capitalizzazione degli investitori e ai meccanismi di trasferimento secondari.
• Puoi percorrere l'intero ciclo di vita del token (emissione, trasferimento, riscatto, azioni societarie, bruciatura) senza dover cercare nulla e comprendere i compromessi tra i diversi approcci di implementazione.
• Comprendi i modelli di custodia: la differenza tra autocustodia, modelli di custodia qualificati, strutture omnibus vs. portafogli segregati, e cosa significa ciascuno per il rischio di conformità e operativo.
• Hai conoscenze pratiche delle meccaniche di insediamento on-chain e di come interagiscono con i binari tradizionali T+1/T+2 (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT).
• Sei fluente negli standard dei token su più catene e sai quando ricorrere a ERC-20, ERC-1400 o strutture proprietarie, e perché. Profondità TradFi
• Hai una solida comprensione di come funziona l'infrastruttura finanziaria istituzionale: come sono strutturati e amministrati i fondi, come i broker-dealer liquidano e liquidano, come le banche gestiscono i rapporti di trust e affidamento e come opera il prime brokerage.
• Comprendi gli strumenti tokenizzati: fondi del mercato monetario, obbligazioni, credito strutturato, azioni, immobili, materie prime, incluso come ciascuno viene prezzato, trasferito e gestito nel mondo tradizionale.
• Sei a tuo agio con i quadri normativi rilevanti per asset tokenizzati come MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA e puoi identificare i vincoli di conformità che devono essere codificati nel design del prodotto.
• Puoi leggere e interpretare rapidamente documenti istituzionali: RFP, term sheet, accordi di affidamento e questionari di due diligence, e tradurli in requisiti di prodotto senza un'ampia supervisione. Domanda istituzionale, traduzione rapida
• Hai lavorato direttamente con clienti istituzionali come gestori di asset, banche, fondi sovrani, family office come product owner primario, e sai come gestire le loro aspettative ed estrarre segnali dal rumore.
• Puoi ascoltare un nuovo caso d'uso istituzionale o un requisito di integrazione complesso e valutare rapidamente fattibilità, portata e priorità, senza bisogno di giorni per ricercare le basi.
• Hai esperienza nel distinguere tra richieste che rivelano vere lacune di prodotto e quelle che sono personalizzazioni personalizzate per il cliente e sai come gestire entrambe senza compromettere la roadmap. Responsabilità Chiave Strategia di Prodotto e Roadmap
• Definire e mantenere la roadmap del prodotto Adron.
• Dare priorità alle iniziative di prodotto in base alla domanda di mercato, alla fattibilità tecnica e all'impatto sul business.
• Mantenere una visione chiara del prodotto per Hadron su molteplici classi di asset e reti blockchain.
• Garantire la scalabilità a lungo termine della piattaforma e la coerenza del prodotto. Sviluppo e Consegna del Prodotto
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali e di mercato in requisiti chiari del prodotto.
• Mantenere l'arretrato del prodotto e le priorità di sviluppo.
• Coordinare i cicli di sviluppo e il rilascio delle funzionalità.
• Garantire la consegna tempestiva delle tappe della roadmap. Coordinamento ingegneristico
• Agiscono come interfaccia primaria tra prodotto e ingegneria.
• Coordinare il lavoro di sviluppo con ingegneri interni e partner tecnologici esterni.
• Mantenere una documentazione chiara delle funzionalità del prodotto, delle API e delle capacità della piattaforma.
• Monitorare le prestazioni della piattaforma, i bug e i miglioramenti tecnici. Feedback Cliente e Integrazione
• Raccogliere e strutturare feedback da clienti istituzionali e team interni.
• Identificare le sfide ricorrenti di integrazione e tradurle in miglioramenti del prodotto.
• Migliorare i flussi di lavoro di onboarding e l'esperienza degli sviluppatori. Requisiti
• 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di prodotto o nella proprietà del prodotto, con almeno 3 anni in asset digitali, tokenizzazione o infrastrutture finanziarie.
• Esperienza pratica dimostrata nella spedizione di un prodotto di tokenizzazione o RWA, con responsabilità per l'intero ciclo di vita del token.
• Profonda conoscenza operativa dell'infrastruttura dei mercati dei capitali TradFi, inclusi regolamenti di liquidazione, custodia, compensazione e strutture dei fondi.
• Comprovata capacità di analizzare rapidamente i requisiti istituzionali e tradurli in decisioni di prodotto concrete.
• Esperienza nella gestione di partner ingegneristici esterni e nell'applicazione della disciplina di ambito in programmi complessi e multi-stakeholder.
• Alfabetizzazione normativa in almeno due principali quadri di tokenizzazione (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA o equivalente).
• Eccellente inglese scritto e parlato. È in grado di redigere specifiche di prodotto precise, documentazione rivolta al cliente e riassunti esecutivi. È utile avere:
• Esperienza precedente in banca, gestore di beni, custodia o fintech regolamentata in un ruolo di prodotto, tecnologia o mercato.
• Esperienza pratica con molteplici standard di token e reti blockchain in un contesto di produzione.
• Esperienza nella progettazione o integrazione con API di custodia, sistemi di transfer agent o piattaforme di amministrazione dei fondi.
• Comprendere i meccanismi di conformità on-chain: whitelisting, restrizioni di trasferimento, ganci KYC/AML a livello di smart contract.
• Esposizione a strategie di deployment multi-chain e ai compromessi tra ambienti L1, L2 e a catena autorizzata.
• Esperienza con i flussi di lavoro di onboarding dei clienti istituzionali in un contesto regolamentato. Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tieni presente quanto segue quando ti candidi per ruoli:
• Candidati solo tramite i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento a meno che non sia chiaramente indicato. Tutte le posizioni aperte sono elencate nella nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verifica l'identità del recruiter. Tutti i nostri recruiter hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web.
• Fai attenzione ai metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non effettuiamo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite email e piattaforme ufficiali aziendali.
• Ricontrollare gli indirizzi email. Tutte le comunicazioni da parte nostra arriveranno da email che terminano con @ tether.to o @ tether.io
• Non richiederemo mai dettagli di pagamento o finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o pagamenti in qualsiasi momento del processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Per favore, segnalalo immediatamente.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The Senior Technical Product Manager will be responsible for the overall product leadership of Hadron, including product vision, roadmap definition, and delivery execution. The role serves as the single point of accountability for the platform to serve institutional client needs, engineering delivery, and regulatory/compliance requirements. Unlike a traditional Product Manager role, this position requires clear decision-making authority to:
• Set and enforce roadmap priorities, including pushing back on non-essential requests.
• Coordinate with external engineering partners and maintain scope discipline.
• Resolve conflicts between client requests, technical feasibility, and compliance constraints.
• Make go/no-go decisions on integrations, product features, and releases.
• Ensure product development aligns with the long-term architecture and scalability of the Hadron platform. Critical Context Hadron serves institutional clients globally with diverse and often conflicting tokenization requirements, including different asset classes, blockchain networks, compliance frameworks, and distribution models. The Product Manager must manage this complexity by maintaining a clear product strategy, prioritizing ruthlessly, and preventing scope creep. The role requires strong ownership and the ability to make difficult prioritization decisions in a fast-moving institutional environment. Reporting & Collaboration Reports to: VP Product The Product Manager works in close partnership with the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron to ensure strong alignment between institutional client demand, market opportunities, and the Hadron product roadmap. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor provides continuous market feedback based on institutional client engagements and strategic partnerships, ensuring that product development reflects real market demand. The Product Manager is responsible for translating these inputs into product priorities, roadmap decisions, and engineering execution. Major roadmap initiatives, client-driven feature requests, and new integrations are expected to be aligned between the Product Manager and the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor before implementation. The Ideal Candidate We are specifically looking for candidates who have operated at a senior level and can demonstrate deep, hands-on exposure to tokenization and traditional financial infrastructure. You should be able to recognise yourself in most of the following: Tokenization, end-to-end
• You have personally built, shipped, or owned a tokenization product — from asset onboarding and smart contract specification through to custody integration, investor cap table management, and secondary transfer mechanics.
• You can walk through the full token lifecycle (issuance, transfer, redemption, corporate actions, burn) without needing to look anything up, and you understand the tradeoffs between different implementation approaches.
• You understand custody models: the difference between self-custody, qualified custodian models, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures, and what each means for compliance and operational risk.
• You have practical knowledge of on-chain settlement mechanics and how they interact with traditional T+1/T+2 settlement rails (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT).
• You are fluent in token standards across multiple chains and understand when to reach for ERC-20, ERC-1400, or proprietary structures, and why. TradFi depth
• You have a strong grasp of how institutional financial infrastructure works: how funds are structured and administered, how broker-dealers clear and settle, how banks manage trust and custody relationships, and how prime brokerage operates.
• You understand the instruments being tokenized: money market funds, bonds, structured credit, equities, real estate, commodities including how each is priced, transferred, and serviced in the traditional world.
• You are comfortable with regulatory frameworks relevant to tokenized assets such as MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA and can identify the compliance constraints that must be encoded into product design.
• You can read and rapidly interpret institutional documents: RFPs, term sheets, custody agreements, and due diligence questionnaires, and translate them into product requirements without extensive hand-holding. Institutional demand, rapid translation
• You have worked directly with institutional clients such as asset managers, banks, sovereign funds, family offices as the primary product owner, and you know how to manage their expectations and extract signals from noise.
• You can hear a new institutional use case or a complex integration requirement and rapidly assess feasibility, scope, and priority, without needing days to research the basics.
• You have experience distinguishing between requests that reveal genuine product gaps and those that are bespoke client customisations and you know how to handle both without derailing the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and maintain the Hadron product roadmap.
• Prioritize product initiatives based on market demand, technical feasibility, and business impact.
• Maintain a clear product vision for Hadron across multiple asset classes and blockchain networks.
• Ensure long-term platform scalability and product coherence. Product Development & Delivery
• Translate business and market needs into clear product requirements.
• Maintain the product backlog and development priorities.
• Coordinate development cycles and feature releases.
• Ensure timely delivery of roadmap milestones. Engineering Coordination
• Act as the primary interface between product and engineering.
• Coordinate development work with internal engineers and external technology partners.
• Maintain clear documentation of product features, APIs, and platform capabilities.
• Track platform performance, bugs, and technical improvements. Client & Integration Feedback
• Collect and structure feedback from institutional clients and internal teams.
• Identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into product improvements.
• Improve onboarding workflows and developer experience.
• 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with at least 3 years in digital assets, tokenization, or financial infrastructure.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with accountability for the full token lifecycle.
• Deep, working knowledge of TradFi capital markets infrastructure including settlement, custody, clearing, fund structures.
• Proven ability to rapidly parse institutional requirements and translate them into actionable product decisions.
• Experience managing external engineering partners and enforcing scope discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder programmes.
• Regulatory literacy across at least two major tokenization frameworks (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, or equivalent).
• Excellent written and spoken English. Able to author crisp product specs, client-facing documentation, and executive summaries. Nice to have:
• Prior experience at a bank, asset manager, custodian, or regulated fintech in a product, technology, or markets role.
• Hands-on experience with multiple token standards and blockchain networks in a production context.
• Experience designing or integrating with custody APIs, transfer agent systems, or fund administration platforms.
• Understanding of on-chain compliance mechanisms: whitelisting, transfer restrictions, KYC/AML hooks at the smart contract level.
• Exposure to multi-chain deployment strategies and the tradeoffs between L1, L2, and permissioned chain environments.
• Experience with institutional client onboarding workflows in a regulated context. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
• Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
• Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
• Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
• We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Descrizione Tritt Tether bei und präge die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, sondern sind Pioniere einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere modernsten Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen – von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten – nahtlos reservierte Tokens über Blockchains hinweg zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether Ihnen, digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen. Transparenz ist das Fundament von allem, was wir tun, und gewährleistet Vertrauen in jeder Transaktion. Innovieren Sie mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktpalette umfasst den weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin, USDT, auf den Hunderte Millionen weltweit vertrauen, sowie bahnbrechende Tokenisierungsdienste für digitale Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssige Energie für das Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in modernsten, geodiversen Einrichtungen. Tether Data: Indem wir Durchbrüche in KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie vorantreiben, senken wir die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalem Lernen befähigen wir Einzelpersonen, in der digitalen und Gig-Ökonomie zu gedeihen und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum trittst du uns an? Unser Team ist eine globale Talentkraft und arbeitet remote aus allen Ecken der Welt. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, im Fintech-Bereich Fuß zu fassen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu verschieben und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, sind schlank geblieben und haben uns als führende Persönlichkeit in der Branche gesichert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten verfügen und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Zum Job: Der Senior Technical Product Manager wird für die Gesamtproduktführung von Hadron verantwortlich sein, einschließlich Produktvision, Roadmap-Definition und Umsetzung der Lieferung. Die Rolle dient als zentraler Verantwortlichkeitspunkt für die Plattform, um institutionelle Kundenbedürfnisse, technische Bereitstellung und regulatorische/Compliance-Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Im Gegensatz zu einer traditionellen Produktmanagerrolle erfordert diese Position klare Entscheidungsbefugnisse, um:
• Roadmap-Prioritäten festzulegen und durchzusetzen, einschließlich des Widerstands gegen nicht notwendige Anfragen.
• Koordination mit externen Ingenieurpartnern und Aufrechterhaltung der Disziplin im Umfang.
• Konflikte zwischen Kundenanfragen, technischer Machbarkeit und Compliance-Einschränkungen zu lösen.
• Treffen Sie Go/No-Go-Entscheidungen zu Integrationen, Produktfunktionen und Releases.
• Sicherstellen, dass die Produktentwicklung mit der langfristigen Architektur und Skalierbarkeit der Hadron-Plattform übereinstimmt. Critical Context Hadron bedient institutionelle Kunden weltweit mit vielfältigen und oft widersprüchlichen Tokenisierungsanforderungen, darunter verschiedene Anlageklassen, Blockchain-Netzwerke, Compliance-Rahmenwerke und Vertriebsmodelle. Der Product Manager muss diese Komplexität managen, indem er eine klare Produktstrategie verfolgt und rücksichtslos priorisiert und Scope Crep verhindert. Die Rolle erfordert starke Eigenverantwortung und die Fähigkeit, schwierige Priorisierungsentscheidungen in einem sich schnell verändernden institutionellen Umfeld zu treffen. Reporting & Collaboration Bericht an: VP Product Der Product Manager arbeitet eng mit dem Head of Expansion und Product Advisor von Hadron zusammen, um eine starke Abstimmung zwischen institutioneller Kundennachfrage, Marktchancen und der Hadron-Produktroadmap sicherzustellen. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor liefert kontinuierliches Marktfeedback basierend auf institutionellen Kundenkontakten und strategischen Partnerschaften und stellt sicher, dass die Produktentwicklung die reale Marktnachfrage widerspiegelt. Der Product Manager ist dafür verantwortlich, diese Eingaben in Produktprioritäten, Roadmap-Entscheidungen und technische Umsetzung umzusetzen. Große Roadmap-Initiativen, kundenorientierte Feature-Anfragen und neue Integrationen werden voraussichtlich zwischen dem Produktmanager und dem Head of Expansion und Product Advisor vor der Implementierung abgestimmt. Der ideale Kandidat Wir suchen speziell Kandidaten, die auf einer höheren Ebene tätig sind und eine tiefe, praxisnahe Erfahrung in Tokenisierung und traditioneller Finanzinfrastruktur nachweisen können. Sie sollten sich in den meisten folgenden Bereichen wiedererkennen können: Tokenisierung, End-to-End-• Sie haben persönlich ein Tokenisierungsprodukt gebaut, ausgeliefert oder besessen – von der Asset-Onboarding und Smart-Contract-Spezifikation bis hin zur Verwahrungsintegration, Investoren-Cap Table Management und sekundären Transfermechaniken.
• Man kann den gesamten Token-Lebenszyklus (Ausgabe, Übertragung, Einlösung, Unternehmensmaßnahmen, Verbrennung) durchlaufen, ohne etwas nachschlagen zu müssen, und man versteht die Abwägungen zwischen verschiedenen Implementierungsansätzen.
• Sie verstehen Verwahrungsmodelle: den Unterschied zwischen Selbstverwahrung, qualifizierten Verwahrermodellen, Omnibus- und getrennten Wallet-Strukturen und was jede für Compliance und operative Risiken bedeutet.
• Du hast praktische Kenntnisse über On-Chain-Siedlungsmechaniken und wie sie mit traditionellen T+1/T+2-Siedlungsschienen (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT) interagieren.
• Sie sind fließend in Token-Standards über mehrere Ketten hinweg vertraut und wissen, wann Sie auf ERC-20, ERC-1400 oder proprietäre Strukturen zurückgreifen müssen und warum. TradFi-Tiefe
• Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis davon, wie institutionelle Finanzinfrastruktur funktioniert: wie Fonds strukturiert und verwaltet werden, wie Broker-Dealer clearen und abwickeln, wie Banken Trust- und Verwahrungsverhältnisse verwalten und wie Prime Brokerage funktioniert.
• Sie verstehen die tokenisierten Instrumente: Geldmarktfonds, Anleihen, strukturierte Kredite, Aktien, Immobilien, Rohstoffe, einschließlich der Art und Weise, wie jedes in der traditionellen Welt bepreist, übertragen und betreut wird.
• Sie sind mit regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen für tokenisierte Vermögenswerte wie MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS Notice, VARA vertraut und können die Compliance-Einschränkungen identifizieren, die im Produktdesign kodiert werden müssen.
• Sie können institutionelle Dokumente lesen und schnell interpretieren: RFPs, Term Sheets, Sorgerechtsvereinbarungen und Due-Diligence-Fragebögen und diese ohne umfangreiche Anleitung in Produktanforderungen übersetzen. Institutionelle Nachfrage, schnelle Übersetzung
• Sie haben direkt mit institutionellen Kunden wie Vermögensmanagern, Banken, Staatsfonds und Family Offices als primärer Product Owner zusammengearbeitet und wissen, wie man deren Erwartungen steuert und Signale aus dem Rauschen herausfiltert.
• Sie können einen neuen institutionellen Anwendungsfall oder eine komplexe Integrationsanforderung hören und schnell Machbarkeit, Umfang und Priorität bewerten, ohne tagelang die Grundlagen zu recherchieren.
• Sie haben Erfahrung darin, zwischen Anfragen zu unterscheiden, die echte Produktlücken offenbaren, und solchen, die maßgeschneiderte Kundenanpassungen sind, und wissen, wie Sie beides handhaben, ohne den Fahrplan zu unterbrechen. Zentrale Verantwortlichkeiten Produktstrategie & Roadmap
• Definieren und pflegen Sie die Hadron-Produktroadmap.
• Produktinitiativen basierend auf Marktnachfrage, technischer Machbarkeit und geschäftlichen Auswirkungen priorisieren.
• Eine klare Produktvision für Hadron über mehrere Anlageklassen und Blockchain-Netzwerke hinweg aufrechtzuerhalten.
• Sicherstellung langfristiger Plattformskalierbarkeit und Produktkohärenz. Produktentwicklung & Lieferung
• Umsetzen Sie Geschäfts- und Marktbedürfnisse in klare Produktanforderungen.
• Den Produktrückstand und die Entwicklungsprioritäten aufrechterhalten.
• Koordination von Entwicklungszyklen und Feature-Releases.
• Sicherstellung der pünktlichen Umsetzung von Roadmap-Meilensteinen. Ingenieurskoordination
• Fungiert als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt und Ingenieurwesen.
• Koordination der Entwicklungsarbeit mit internen Ingenieuren und externen Technologiepartnern.
• Klare Dokumentation der Produktfunktionen, APIs und Plattformfähigkeiten zu pflegen.
• Plattformleistung, Fehler und technische Verbesserungen verfolgen. Kunden- und Integrationsfeedback
• Sammeln und strukturieren Sie Feedback von institutionellen Kunden und internen Teams.
• Identifiziere wiederkehrende Integrationsherausforderungen und übersetze sie in Produktverbesserungen.
• Verbesserung der Onboarding-Workflows und des Entwickler-Erlebnisses. Requisiti
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Produkteigentum, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in digitalen Vermögenswerten, Tokenisierung oder Finanzinfrastruktur.
• Demonstrierte praktische Erfahrung beim Versand eines Tokenisierungs- oder RWA-Produkts mit Verantwortung für den gesamten Token-Lebenszyklus.
• Tiefgehendes Wissen über die TradFi-Kapitalmarktinfrastruktur einschließlich Abwicklung, Verwahrung, Clearing und Fondsstrukturen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, institutionelle Anforderungen schnell zu analysieren und in umsetzbare Produktentscheidungen umzusetzen.
• Erfahrung im Management externer Ingenieurpartner und bei der Durchsetzung von Disziplin im Umfang komplexer Multi-Stakeholder-Programme hinweg.
• Regulatorische Kompetenz in mindestens zwei wichtigen Tokenisierungsrahmen (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA oder gleichwertig).
• Ausgezeichnetes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch. In der Lage, präzise Produktspezifikationen, kundenorientierte Dokumentationen und Executive Summary zu erstellen. Schön zu haben:
• Vorherige Erfahrung bei einer Bank, Vermögensverwalter, Verwahrer oder reguliertem Fintech in einer Produkt-, Technologie- oder Marktposition.
• Praktische Erfahrung mit mehreren Token-Standards und Blockchain-Netzwerken im Produktionskontext.
• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung oder Integration von Custody-APIs, Übertragungsagentensystemen oder Fondsverwaltungsplattformen.
• Verständnis von On-Chain-Compliance-Mechanismen: Whitelisting, Übertragungsbeschränkungen, KYC/AML-Hooks auf Smart-Contract-Ebene.
• Exposition gegenüber Multi-Chain-Deployment-Strategien und den Abwägungen zwischen L1-, L2- und permissioned-Chain-Umgebungen.
• Erfahrung mit institutionellen Kunden-Onboarding-Workflows in einem regulierten Kontext. Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten: Rekrutierungsbetrug ist immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes bei der Bewerbung:
• Bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen keine Drittanbieterplattformen oder Agenturen für die Rekrutierung, es sei denn, dies ist ausdrücklich angegeben. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/
• Verifizieren Sie die Identität des Personalvermittlers. Alle unsere Recruiter haben verifizierte LinkedIn-Profile. Wenn Sie unsicher sind, können Sie ihre Identität bestätigen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren.
• Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Alle Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen.
• E-Mail-Adressen doppelt überprüfen. Alle Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die mit @ tether.to oder @ tether.io enden
