descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Unisciti a Tether e dai forma al futuro della finanza digitale In Tether non ci limitiamo a creare prodotti, ma siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare perfettamente token garantiti da riserve attraverso blockchain. Sfruttando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di archiviare, inviare e ricevere token digitali in modo istantaneo, sicuro e globale, il tutto a una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è il fondamento di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innova con Tether Tether Finance: la nostra suite di prodotti innovativa comprende la stablecoin più affidabile al mondo, USDT, su cui fanno affidamento centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi pionieristici di tokenizzazione delle risorse digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: guidando la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l’energia in eccesso per l’estrazione di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture all’avanguardia e geodiversificate. Tether Data: alimentando innovazioni nell'intelligenza artificiale e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi dell'infrastruttura e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione sicura e privata dei dati. Tether Education: democratizzando l’accesso all’apprendimento digitale di alto livello, consentiamo alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig economy, guidando la crescita e le opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: all'intersezione tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza globale di talenti, che lavora in remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se la tua passione è lasciare il segno nel settore fintech, questa è la tua occasione per collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo oltre i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti rapidamente, siamo rimasti snelli e ci siamo assicurati il ​​posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto che fa per te. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Informazioni sul lavoro Come parte del team di distribuzione tecnologica di Tether Data, il Solutions Partner Manager è responsabile della gestione, abilitazione e governo di una rete di società di consulenza, integratori di sistemi e partner di consegna che implementano i prodotti Tether (WDK, QVAC e MOS). Il ruolo garantisce che i partner realizzino progetti di alta qualità, si allineino agli interessi di Tether, soddisfino gli standard di certificazione e promuovano la soddisfazione del cliente. ## Responsabilità 1. Gestione delle relazioni e delle capacità dei partner: agire come principale titolare delle relazioni per tutti i partner di soluzioni. - Coordinare la valutazione delle capacità dei partner, della maturità della consegna e delle risorse. - Garantire che i partner mantengano sufficienti consulenti certificati e capacità tecnica. - Condurre revisioni regolari delle capacità e sviluppare piani di miglioramento dei partner secondo necessità. 2. Onboarding e certificazione dei partner: guidare l'onboarding di nuovi partner di implementazione, comprese la due diligence e l'esecuzione del contratto. - Coordinare i programmi di formazione e certificazione dei partner. - Garantire l'aderenza ai manuali di implementazione, alle migliori pratiche e ai quadri di distribuzione. 3. Governance della consegna: supervisionare le implementazioni guidate dai partner per garantire l'allineamento con la metodologia, gli standard di qualità e le tempistiche. - Partecipare all'avvio dei progetti, alle revisioni delle tappe fondamentali e ai checkpoint di governance. - Convalidare i risultati finali dei partner (ad esempio configurazioni, impostazioni di integrazione, documentazione di test). - Gestire le escalation e coordinare le risoluzioni con i team interni tecnici, di supporto e di prodotto. 4. Monitoraggio del portafoglio progetti: mantieni la visibilità sull'intero portafoglio di progetti guidati dai partner. - Identificare e segnalare opportunità di cross-sell con altri prodotti Tether o con servizi offerti dalle società del portafoglio Tether, ove pertinente. - Tieni traccia dei rischi di consegna, delle carenze di risorse e delle escalation nell'ecosistema dei partner. - Garantire che i partner ricevano il supporto tecnico richiesto durante le loro implementazioni 5. Garanzia di qualità e gestione delle prestazioni - Monitorare i KPI come il tasso di successo del progetto, CSAT e la qualità di consegna dei partner. - Eseguire revisioni trimestrali delle prestazioni dei partner. - Definire piani di azione correttivi o restrizioni temporanee di consegna quando richiesto. - Gestire i cicli di ricertificazione e il livello dei partner. 7. Coordinamento interfunzionale: lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di successo del cliente, consegna, supporto, prodotto e formazione. - Garantire transizioni fluide tra le fasi dalla vendita alla consegna e dalla consegna al supporto. - Fornire feedback dai progetti dei partner ai team interni per migliorare la qualità del prodotto e i processi di implementazione. 8. Gestione del ciclo di vita dei partner: gestisci il rinnovo, la ricertificazione e (se necessario) l'offboarding dei partner. - Conservare i record dei partner, le matrici delle capacità e i registri delle prestazioni del progetto. ## Requisiti - 4-8 anni in ruoli di gestione dei partner, gestione delle consegne, servizi professionali o governance dei progetti. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di implementazione, integratori di sistemi o società di consulenza. - Ottima conoscenza dei processi di implementazione software/IT (integrazione, configurazione, gestione delle modifiche, UAT, go-live). - Collaborare con team tecnici e aziendali di livello mondiale in più regioni. - Esperienza in SaaS, fintech, AI, blockchain, piattaforme di contenuti digitali o software open source aziendale. - Lavoro precedente con modelli di consegna guidati dai partner o programmi di certificazione. - Conoscenza degli strumenti di governance dei partner, dei framework PMO e dei processi di QA. - L'inglese è un must, qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe nel reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tieni presente quanto segue quando fai domanda per un ruolo: - Candidati solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento se non chiaramente indicato. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Verifica l'identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web. - Prestare attenzione ai metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni avvengono tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali dell'azienda. - Ricontrolla gli indirizzi email. Tutte le nostre comunicazioni arriveranno da e-mail che terminano con @ tether.to o @ tether.io - Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o un pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di una truffa. Per favore segnalatelo immediatamente. - In caso di dubbi, non esitate a contattarci tramite il nostro sito Web ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As part of the Technology Distribution team of Tether Data, the Solutions Partner Manager is responsible for managing, enabling, and governing a network of consulting firms, system integrators, and delivery partners who implement Tether products (WDK, QVAC, and MOS). The role ensures partners deliver high-quality projects, align with Tether’s interests, meet certification standards, and drive customer satisfaction. Responsibilities 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management Act as the primary relationship owner for all Solutions Partners. Coordinate the assessment of partner capabilities, delivery maturity, and resources. Ensure partners maintain sufficient certified consultants and technical capacity. Conduct regular capability reviews and develop partner improvement plans as needed. 2. Partner Onboarding & Certification Lead the onboarding of new implementation partners, including due diligence and contract execution. Coordinate partner training and certification programs Ensure adherence to implementation playbooks, best practices, and delivery frameworks. 3. Delivery Governance Oversee partner-led implementations to ensure alignment with methodology, quality standards, and timelines. Participate in project kick-offs, milestone reviews, and governance checkpoints. Validate partner deliverables (e.g., configurations, integration setups, testing documentation). Manage escalations and coordinate resolutions with internal Technical, Support, and Product teams. 4. Project Portfolio Monitoring Maintain visibility over the entire portfolio of partner-led projects. Identify and flag cross-sell opportunities with other Tether products or with services offered by Tether portfolio companies, where relevant. Track delivery risks, resourcing gaps, and escalations across the partner ecosystem. Ensure Partners receive Technical support as required during their implementations 5. Quality Assurance & Performance Management Monitor KPIs such as project success rate, CSAT, and partner delivery quality. Perform quarterly partner performance reviews. Define corrective action plans or temporary delivery restrictions when required. Manage re-certification cycles and partner tiering. 7. Cross-Functional Coordination Work closely with Customer Success, Delivery, Support, Product, and Training teams. Ensure smooth transitions between sales-to-delivery and delivery-to-support phases. Provide feedback from partner projects to internal teams to improve product quality and implementation processes. 8. Partner Lifecycle Management Manage partner renewal, re-certification, and (if necessary) offboarding. Maintain partner records, capability matrices, and project performance logs. 4–8 years in Partner Management, Delivery Management, Professional Services, or Project Governance roles. Experience working with implementation partners, system integrators, or consulting firms. Strong understanding of software/IT implementation processes (integration, configuration, change management, UAT, go-live). Collaborate with world-class technical and business teams across multiple regions. Experience in SaaS, fintech, AI, blockchain, digital content platforms, or enterprise open source software. Previous work with partner-led delivery models or certification programs. Knowledge of partner governance tools, PMO frameworks, and QA processes. English is a must, any other language a plus Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft des digitalen Finanzwesens. Bei Tether entwickeln wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen – von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten –, rücklagegesicherte Token nahtlos über Blockchains hinweg zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Leistungsfähigkeit der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Ihnen Tether das sofortige, sichere und globale Speichern, Senden und Empfangen digitaler Token – und das alles zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten. Transparenz ist die Grundlage unseres Handelns und gewährleistet Vertrauen bei jeder Transaktion. Innovation mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite umfasst den vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin der Welt, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte Millionen Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen, sowie bahnbrechende Dienste zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssigen Strom für das Bitcoin-Mining durch umweltfreundliche Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch vielfältigen Anlagen. Tether Data: Wir treiben Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie voran, senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen ermöglichen wir Einzelpersonen, in der Digital- und Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von überall auf der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn es Ihnen am Herzen liegt, sich im Fintech-Bereich einen Namen zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Branchenführer gesichert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, einen Beitrag zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt zu leisten, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über den Job Als Teil des Technology Distribution-Teams von Tether Data ist der Solutions Partner Manager für die Verwaltung, Aktivierung und Steuerung eines Netzwerks von Beratungsunternehmen, Systemintegratoren und Lieferpartnern verantwortlich, die Tether-Produkte (WDK, QVAC und MOS) implementieren. Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass Partner qualitativ hochwertige Projekte liefern, sich an den Interessen von Tether orientieren, Zertifizierungsstandards erfüllen und die Kundenzufriedenheit steigern. ## Verantwortlichkeiten 1. Partner Relationship & Capability Management – ​​Fungieren Sie als primärer Beziehungseigentümer für alle Lösungspartner. - Koordinieren Sie die Bewertung der Partnerfähigkeiten, der Lieferreife und der Ressourcen. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Partner über ausreichend zertifizierte Berater und technische Kapazitäten verfügen. - Führen Sie regelmäßige Fähigkeitsüberprüfungen durch und entwickeln Sie bei Bedarf Verbesserungspläne für Partner. 2. Partner-Onboarding und -Zertifizierung – Leiten Sie das Onboarding neuer Implementierungspartner, einschließlich Due Diligence und Vertragsabwicklung. - Koordinieren Sie Schulungs- und Zertifizierungsprogramme für Partner. - Stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Implementierungsleitfäden, Best Practices und Bereitstellungsrahmen sicher. 3. Delivery Governance – Überwachung der von Partnern geleiteten Implementierungen, um die Übereinstimmung mit Methodik, Qualitätsstandards und Zeitplänen sicherzustellen. - Nehmen Sie an Projektstarts, Meilensteinüberprüfungen und Governance-Checkpoints teil. - Validieren Sie die Ergebnisse der Partner (z. B. Konfigurationen, Integrationseinstellungen, Testdokumentation). - Verwalten Sie Eskalationen und koordinieren Sie Lösungen mit internen Technik-, Support- und Produktteams. 4. Überwachung des Projektportfolios – Behalten Sie den Überblick über das gesamte Portfolio der von Partnern geleiteten Projekte. - Identifizieren und kennzeichnen Sie Cross-Selling-Möglichkeiten mit anderen Tether-Produkten oder mit Dienstleistungen, die von Tether-Portfoliounternehmen angeboten werden, sofern relevant. - Verfolgen Sie Lieferrisiken, Ressourcenlücken und Eskalationen im gesamten Partner-Ökosystem. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Partner während ihrer Implementierungen bei Bedarf technischen Support erhalten. 5. Qualitätssicherung und Leistungsmanagement - Überwachen Sie KPIs wie Projekterfolgsrate, CSAT und Lieferqualität der Partner. - Führen Sie vierteljährliche Leistungsüberprüfungen der Partner durch. - Definieren Sie bei Bedarf Korrekturmaßnahmenpläne oder vorübergehende Lieferbeschränkungen. - Verwalten Sie Rezertifizierungszyklen und Partnerstufen. 7. Funktionsübergreifende Koordination – Arbeiten Sie eng mit den Teams für Kundenerfolg, Lieferung, Support, Produkt und Schulung zusammen. - Sorgen Sie für reibungslose Übergänge zwischen den Phasen Verkauf bis Lieferung und Lieferung bis Support. - Geben Sie Feedback von Partnerprojekten an interne Teams weiter, um die Produktqualität und Implementierungsprozesse zu verbessern. 8. Partner Lifecycle Management – ​​Verwalten Sie die Erneuerung, Neuzertifizierung und (falls erforderlich) Offboarding von Partnern. - Pflegen Sie Partnerdatensätze, Fähigkeitsmatrizen und Projektleistungsprotokolle. ## Voraussetzungen – 4–8 Jahre in den Rollen Partnermanagement, Liefermanagement, professionelle Dienstleistungen oder Projektsteuerung. - Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Implementierungspartnern, Systemintegratoren oder Beratungsunternehmen. - Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Software-/IT-Implementierungsprozesse (Integration, Konfiguration, Änderungsmanagement, UAT, Go-Live). - Arbeiten Sie mit erstklassigen Technik- und Geschäftsteams in mehreren Regionen zusammen. - Erfahrung in SaaS, Fintech, KI, Blockchain, Plattformen für digitale Inhalte oder Open-Source-Unternehmenssoftware. - Frühere Arbeit mit von Partnern geleiteten Bereitstellungsmodellen oder Zertifizierungsprogrammen. - Kenntnisse über Partner-Governance-Tools, PMO-Frameworks und Qualitätssicherungsprozesse. - Englisch ist ein Muss, jede andere Sprache ein Plus ## Wichtige Informationen für Bewerber Bei der Personalbeschaffung kommt es immer häufiger vor. Um sich selbst zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich auf Stellen bewerben: - Bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen für die Rekrutierung keine Plattformen oder Agenturen Dritter, sofern dies nicht ausdrücklich angegeben ist. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ – Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Personalvermittlers. Alle unsere Personalvermittler verfügen über verifizierte LinkedIn-Profile. Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, können Sie ihre Identität bestätigen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren. - Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle E-Mails und Plattformen des Unternehmens. - Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen noch einmal. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails, die auf @tether.to oder @tether.io enden. Wir werden niemals nach Zahlungs- oder Finanzdaten fragen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, handelt es sich um Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es umgehend. - Im Zweifelsfall können Sie sich gerne über unsere offizielle Website an uns wenden.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste Au sein de l'équipe de distribution technologique de Tether Data, le responsable des partenaires de solutions est responsable de la gestion, de l'activation et de la gouvernance d'un réseau de sociétés de conseil, d'intégrateurs de systèmes et de partenaires de livraison qui mettent en œuvre les produits Tether (WDK, QVAC et MOS). Ce rôle garantit que les partenaires réalisent des projets de haute qualité, s'alignent sur les intérêts de Tether, répondent aux normes de certification et améliorent la satisfaction des clients. ## Responsabilités 1. Relations avec les partenaires et gestion des capacités - Agir en tant que principal responsable des relations pour tous les partenaires de solutions. - Coordonner l'évaluation des capacités des partenaires, de la maturité de la livraison et des ressources. - Veiller à ce que les partenaires maintiennent suffisamment de consultants certifiés et de capacités techniques. - Effectuer des examens réguliers des capacités et élaborer des plans d'amélioration des partenaires si nécessaire. 2. Intégration et certification des partenaires - Diriger l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires de mise en œuvre, y compris la diligence raisonnable et l'exécution des contrats. - Coordonner les programmes de formation et de certification des partenaires. - Assurer le respect des manuels de mise en œuvre, des meilleures pratiques et des cadres de livraison. 3. Gouvernance de la livraison - Superviser les mises en œuvre dirigées par les partenaires pour garantir l'alignement avec la méthodologie, les normes de qualité et les délais. - Participer aux lancements de projets, aux revues d'étapes et aux points de contrôle de gouvernance. - Valider les livrables des partenaires (par exemple, configurations, configurations d'intégration, documentation de test). - Gérer les escalades et coordonner les résolutions avec les équipes techniques, de support et de produit internes. 4. Suivi du portefeuille de projets - Maintenir une visibilité sur l'ensemble du portefeuille de projets dirigés par les partenaires. - Identifier et signaler les opportunités de ventes croisées avec d'autres produits Tether ou avec des services proposés par les sociétés du portefeuille Tether, le cas échéant. - Suivez les risques de livraison, les déficits de ressources et les escalades dans l'écosystème des partenaires. - S'assurer que les partenaires reçoivent le support technique requis lors de leurs mises en œuvre. 5. Assurance qualité et gestion des performances - Surveiller les KPI tels que le taux de réussite du projet, le CSAT et la qualité de livraison des partenaires. - Effectuer des évaluations trimestrielles des performances des partenaires. - Définir des plans d'actions correctives ou des restrictions de livraison temporaires lorsque nécessaire. - Gérer les cycles de recertification et la hiérarchisation des partenaires. 7. Coordination interfonctionnelle – Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de réussite client, de livraison, de support, de produit et de formation. - Assurer des transitions fluides entre les phases de vente à livraison et de livraison à support. - Fournir des retours sur les projets partenaires aux équipes internes pour améliorer la qualité des produits et les processus de mise en œuvre. 8. Gestion du cycle de vie des partenaires - Gérez le renouvellement, la recertification et (si nécessaire) le départ des partenaires. - Tenir à jour les dossiers des partenaires, les matrices de capacités et les journaux de performances du projet. ## Requisiti - 4 à 8 ans dans des rôles de gestion des partenaires, de gestion des livraisons, de services professionnels ou de gouvernance de projet. - Expérience de travail avec des partenaires de mise en œuvre, des intégrateurs de systèmes ou des sociétés de conseil. - Forte compréhension des processus de mise en œuvre logicielle/informatique (intégration, configuration, gestion du changement, UAT, go-live). - Collaborer avec des équipes techniques et commerciales de classe mondiale dans plusieurs régions. - Expérience en SaaS, fintech, IA, blockchain, plateformes de contenu numérique ou logiciels open source d'entreprise. - Travail antérieur avec des modèles de prestation dirigés par des partenaires ou des programmes de certification. - Connaissance des outils de gouvernance des partenaires, des cadres PMO et des processus d'assurance qualité. - L'anglais est indispensable, toute autre langue est un plus ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : - Postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement, sauf indication contraire. Tous les postes ouverts sont répertoriés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ - Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. En cas de doute, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. - Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toutes les communications se font via les e-mails et les plateformes officielles de l'entreprise. - Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toutes les communications de notre part proviendront d'e-mails se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io - Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. - En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta la più affidabile stablecoin del mondo, USDT, basata su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Il ruolo consiste nel lavorare in un ambiente dinamico con un team diversificato di sviluppatori senior backend, product manager e leadership per costruire soluzioni di portafoglio crypto. Le applicazioni sono destinate ad essere ad alte prestazioni, leggero e altamente intuitivo per soddisfare una varietà di pubblico. Si lavorerà sullo sviluppo di applicazioni mobili all'avanguardia che integrano portafogli cripto e funzioni defi. Contribuirai anche a backend componenti quando necessario per supportare le funzionalità mobili e sbloccare la consegna mobile. Potrai anche fornire la leadership tecnica, guidare le best practice di ingegneria mobile, e supportare altri ingegneri attraverso recensioni e mentoring. ## Responsabilità Leadership: Guida un piccolo gruppo di ingegneri React Native. Guidare le decisioni architettoniche, rispettare gli standard di codifica, e garantire la consegna di alta qualità tempestiva. Sviluppo: Progettare e costruire applicazioni avanzate per piattaforme iOS e Android utilizzando React Native, rivedere i lavori di altri ingegneri per garantire qualità e allineamento architettonico, e contribuire a backend servizi o API quando necessario per supportare la funzionalità mobile. Integrazione: Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori backend, integrare Javascript SDKs, librerie e servizi backend in applicazioni mobili, e estendere la logica backend quando necessario per completare le funzionalità end-to-end. Collaborazione: Collabora con product manager, designer e altri sviluppatori per fornire soluzioni innovative. Architettura: Possedere e definire modelli per la gestione dello stato, la navigazione, le prestazioni, la modularizzazione e la sicurezza in applicazioni mobili. ## Mandatory Esperienza con React, React-Native (principalmente intorno a Expo), Redux e i principi fondamentali che circondano questi. Altamente competente in JavaScript e ES6+. Esperienza con i gasdotti CI/CD per lo sviluppo mobile. Familiare con moderni condotti e strumenti di front-end. Esperienza con moduli nativi (C++), WebSockets, API basate su RESTful. Esperienza in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) o Kotlin/Java (Android) per l'implementazione a basso livello. Esperienza comprovata leader o mentoring ingegneri mobili. Dimostrata capacità di possedere architettura per applicazioni React Native su larga scala. Forte capacità decisionali nella valutazione di quadri, strumenti e modelli di sviluppo mobile. Esperienza con lo sviluppo backend utilizzando Node o ambienti simili, con la capacità di implementare o regolare API e servizi che alimentano le funzionalità mobili. Confortevole lavoro attraverso lo stack quando necessario, pur mantenendo forte profondità nello sviluppo mobile. ## Informazioni importanti per i candidati Truppe di reclutamento sono diventati sempre piÃ1 comuni. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni vengono effettuate tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali. Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @tether.to o @tether.io Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . The applications are meant to be high performance, light-weight and highly intuitive to cater to a variety of audiences. You will be working on developing cutting edge mobile applications integrating crypto wallets and defi features . You will also contribute to backend components when needed to support mobile features and unblock mobile delivery. You will also provide technical leadership , guide mobile engineering best practices, and support other engineers through reviews and mentoring. Responsibilities Leadership: Lead a small group of React Native engineers. Drive architectural decisions, enforce coding standards, and ensure timely high quality delivery. Development: Design and build advanced cross platform applications for the iOS and Android platforms using React Native, review work from other engineers to ensure quality and architectural alignment, and contribute to backend services or APIs when required to support mobile functionality. Integration: Work closely with backend developers, integrate Javascript SDKs, libraries, and backend services into mobile applications, and extend backend logic when needed to complete end-to-end features. Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to deliver innovative solutions. Architecture: Own and define patterns for state management, navigation, performance, modularization, and security across mobile applications. Mandatory Thoroughly experienced with React, React-Native (mainly around Expo), Redux and the core principles surrounding these. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ . Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile development. Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools . Experienced with Native modules (C++) , WebSockets, RESTful based APIs. Experience in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) or Kotlin/Java (Android) for low level implementation. Proven experience leading or mentoring mobile engineers . Demonstrated ability to own architecture for large scale React Native applications . Strong decision making skills in evaluating frameworks, tooling, and mobile development patterns. Experience with b ackend development using Node or similar environments , with the ability to implement or adjust APIs and services that power mobile features. Comfortable working across the stack when required, while still maintaining strong depth in mobile development. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreiben Sie Tether und Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Pionier einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen befähigen Unternehmen – von Börsen und Geldbörsen bis zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten –, über Blockchains lückenlos recycelte Token zu integrieren. Tether Data: Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie reduzieren wir die Infrastrukturkosten und erhöhen die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digitales Lernen, wir befähigen Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und gig-Wirtschaften zu leben, das globale Wachstum und die Chance zu treiben. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über den Job Die Rolle beinhaltet die Arbeit in einer dynamischen Umgebung mit einem vielfältigen Team von Senior Backend-Entwicklern, Produktmanagern und Führung, um Krypto Wallet-Lösungen zu bauen. Die Anwendungen sollen eine hohe Leistung, ein geringes Gewicht und eine sehr intuitive Bedienung für eine Vielzahl von Publikum sein. Sie werden an der Entwicklung von Schneiden mobile Anwendungen, die Krypto Geldbörsen und defi-Funktionen integrieren arbeiten. Sie werden auch bei Bedarf zu Backend-Komponenten beitragen, um mobile Funktionen zu unterstützen und mobile Lieferungen zu entsperren. Sie werden auch technische Führung bieten, mobile Engineering Best Practices leiten und andere Ingenieure durch Bewertungen und Mentoring unterstützen. Responsibilities Leadership: Führen Sie eine kleine Gruppe von React Native Ingenieure. Fahren Sie architektonische Entscheidungen, durchsetzen Sie Kodierungsstandards und sorgen Sie für eine zeitnahe qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung. Entwicklung: Entwerfen und bauen fortschrittliche Cross-Plattform-Anwendungen für die iOS- und Android-Plattformen mit React Native, überprüfen Arbeiten von anderen Ingenieuren, um Qualität und architektonische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten, und tragen zu Backend-Services oder APIs bei, wenn erforderlich, um mobile Funktionalität zu unterstützen. Integration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Backend-Entwicklern zusammen, integrieren Sie Javascript SDKs, Bibliotheken und Backend-Dienste in mobile Anwendungen und erweitern Sie die Backend-Logik bei Bedarf, um die End-to-End-Funktionen abzuschließen. Zusammenarbeit: Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagern, Designern und anderen Entwicklern, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern. Architektur: Eigene und definieren Muster für staatliches Management, Navigation, Leistung, Modularisierung und Sicherheit in mobilen Anwendungen. Mit React, React-Native (hauptsächlich rund um die Expo), Redux und den diese umgebenden Kernprinzipien erfahren. Hochprofessionell in JavaScript und ES6+. Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines für mobile Entwicklung. Vertraut mit modernen Frontend-Pipelines und Werkzeugen. Erfahren mit Native-Modulen (C++), WebSockets, RESTful based APIs. Erfahrung in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) oder Kotlin/Java (Android) zur Low-Level-Implementierung. Erfahrene Erfahrung führende oder Mentoring mobile Ingenieure. Demonstrierte Fähigkeit zur eigenen Architektur für großformatige React Native Anwendungen. Starke Entscheidungskompetenzen bei der Bewertung von Frameworks, Tooling und mobilen Entwicklungsmustern. Erfahrung mit der Backend-Entwicklung mit Node oder ähnlichen Umgebungen, mit der Fähigkeit, APIs und Services zu implementieren oder anzupassen, die mobile Funktionen nutzen. Bequeme Arbeiten über den Stapel bei Bedarf, während immer noch starke Tiefe in der mobilen Entwicklung. Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten Recruitment Betrug sind immer häufiger geworden. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. About the job The role involves working in a dynamic environment with a diverse team of senior backend developers, product managers and leadership to build crypto wallet solutions . Responsibilities Leadership: Lead a small group of React Native engineers. Drive architectural decisions, enforce coding standards, and ensure timely high quality delivery. Mandatory Thoroughly experienced with React, React-Native (mainly around Expo), Redux and the core principles surrounding these. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+ . Comfortable working across the stack when required, while still maintaining strong depth in mobile development. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. Erfahrener Experte für native Module (C++), WebSockets, REST-basierte APIs. Erfahrung in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) oder Kotlin/Java (Android) für die Implementierung auf niedrigem Niveau. Erfahrung als Führungskraft oder Mentor für mobile Ingenieure. Gewiesene Fähigkeit, die Architektur für große Skaleneinstellungen von React-Native-Anwendungen zu besitzen. Starke Entscheidungskompetenz bei der Bewertung von Frameworks, Werkzeugen und mobilen Entwicklungsmodellen. Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung mit Node oder ähnlichen Umgebungen, mit der Fähigkeit, APIs und Dienste zu implementieren oder anzupassen, die mobile Funktionen unterstützen. Bequem mit der Arbeit durch den Stack, während eine starke Tiefe in der mobilen Entwicklung erhalten bleibt. ## Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten Rekrutierungs-Scams sind immer häufiger geworden. Sei vorsichtig mit ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Alle Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Unternehmens-E-Mails und -Plattformen. Doppelprüfe die E-Mail-Adressen. Wenn du unsicher bist, fühle dich frei, uns über unsere offizielle Website zu kontaktieren.

Proficient en JavaScript et ES6+. Expérience avec les pipelines CI/CD pour le développement mobile. Familière avec les pipelines front-end modernes et les outils. Expert en modules natifs (C++), WebSockets, API basées sur REST. Expérience en Swift/Objective-C (iOS) ou Kotlin/Java (Android) pour l'implémentation à bas niveau. Expérience en tant que leader ou mentor pour les ingénieurs mobiles. Capacité démontrée à posséder l'architecture pour les applications React Native à grande échelle. Compétence décisionnelle forte pour évaluer les frameworks, les outils et les modèles de développement mobile. Expérience en développement backend avec Node ou environnements similaires, avec la capacité d'implémenter ou d'adapter les API et les services qui alimentent les fonctionnalités mobiles. Si vous êtes incertain, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en contrôlant leur profil ou en nous contactant par notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne conduisons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute la communication se fait par des e-mails officiels et des plateformes. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute la communication de notre part viendra de courriels qui se terminent par @tether.to ou @tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais des paiements ou des informations financières. Si quelqu'un demande des informations financières personnelles ou des paiements à tout moment pendant le processus de recrutement, c'est un escroc. Veuillez signaler immédiatement. Lorsque vous êtes incertain, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par notre site web officiel.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As an AI Filmmaker, you will leverage AI-based photo and video tools to conceptualize, create, and edit short films and videos. These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style. Responsibilities Create short films and videos using AI-driven photo and video generation tools. Edit and refine AI-generated content to produce high-quality, engaging visuals. Collaborate with the marketing team colleagues to develop video concepts for Tether, and other affiliated brands. Ensure all video content aligns with brand guidelines and communicates key messages effectively. Stay updated on the latest AI filmmaking tools and techniques, incorporating innovations into your workflow. Manage multiple projects with tight deadlines, ensuring timely delivery. Experiment with creative formats, styles, and effects to produce unique, memorable content. Proven experience in video production and editing, with a strong portfolio of work. Proficiency in AI video generation tools (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E, or others). Expertise in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). Creative storytelling skills with a keen eye for visual composition and detail. Ability to conceptualize and execute ideas quickly using AI tools. Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines. A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus. What we offer Competitive compensation. Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects. Flexibility to work remotely. Access to advanced AI tools and resources. A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style. Proficiency in AI video generation tools (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E, or others). Expertise in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). Creative storytelling skills with a keen eye for visual composition and detail. Ability to conceptualize and execute ideas quickly using AI tools. Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines. A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus. What we offer Competitive compensation. Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects. Flexibility to work remotely. Access to advanced AI tools and resources. A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines. A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus. What we offer Competitive compensation. Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects. Flexibility to work remotely. Access to advanced AI tools and resources. A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E oder andere) zu erstellen. - Experte in Video-Editingsoftware (z.B. Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). - Fähigkeit, kreative Geschichten zu erzählen, mit einem Auge für visuelle Komposition und Details. - Fähigkeit, Ideen schnell zu konzipieren und umzusetzen, indem man AI-Werkzeuge verwendet. - Vertrautheit mit dem digitalen Marketing und Fähigkeit, Inhalte für soziale Medien anzupassen. - Fähigkeit, Projekte zu verwalten und das Arbeitspensum zu organisieren, mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und Fristen einzuhalten. - Leidenschaft für Technologie, Bitcoin und Innovation (eine Plus). ### Was wir bieten - Gute Bezahlung. - Gelegenheit, mit einem globalen Team an fortschrittlichen Projekten zu arbeiten. - Flexibilität, um von überall aus zu arbeiten. - Zugang zu fortschrittlichen AI-Werkzeugen und -Ressourcen. - Ein kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem deine Kreativität einen direkten Einfluss auf die Markenerzählung hat.

descriptionByLocale.de: Tether und deine zukünftige Karriere ### Beschreibung Bist du bereit, Teil von Tether zu werden und mitzubauen, wie die digitale Finanzwelt der Zukunft aussieht? Assurer que tous les contenus vidéo soient conformes aux lignes directrices de la marque et communiquent les messages clés de manière efficace. - Rester à jour sur les dernières technologies et techniques de création de contenu avec AI, en incorporant des innovations dans votre workflow. - Expérience prouvée dans la production et l'édition de vidéos, avec un portefolio solide. - Compétence dans la génération de vidéos avec des outils AI (par exemple, Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E ou autres). - Capacité à concevoir et exécuter des idées rapidement en utilisant des outils AI. - Connaissance du marketing numérique et capacité à adapter le contenu pour les plateformes de médias sociaux. - Compétence pour gérer des projets et organiser le travail, avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante et de respecter les délais. - Passion pour la technologie, le bitcoin et l'innovation (facultatif). ### Ce que nous offrons - Salaire compétitif. - Opportunité de travailler avec un team mondial sur des projets innovants. - Flexibilité pour travailler à distance. - descriptionByLocale.fr: Tether et ta carrière future ### Description Rejoins Tether et contribue à façonner l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne construisons pas seulement des produits, nous révolutionnons le marché financier mondial. Tether Data: Nos outils de technologie avancée réduisent les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorent les communications mondiales avec des solutions comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit la partage de données sécurisées et privées. Notre équipe est une force globale de talents, qui travaille à distance de tous les coins du monde. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style. Responsibilities Create short films and videos using AI-driven photo and video generation tools. Edit and refine AI-generated content to produce high-quality, engaging visuals. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle bancomat - di integrare in modo fluido token garantiti da riserve su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo inferiore del 10%. L'innovazione è il nostro pilastro, assicurando la trasparenza in ogni transazione. ### Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi comprende la stablecoin più affidata al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per il potenziamento ottimizza l'energia in eccesso per il mining del Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture di ultima generazione e geo-diverse. Tether Data: I nostri strumenti di avanzata tecnologia destinata ai costi di infrastruttura e migliorano le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni come KEET, il nostro app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. Tether Education: La democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello consente alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig, promuovendo la crescita e l'opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: Al confini tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i limiti di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenzi e inediti. Perché unirti a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare il tuo segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo per collaborare con alcuni dei cervelli più brillanti, spingendo i limiti e stabilendo nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, tenuto la nostra struttura snella e deriva il nostro posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo piattaforma del pianeta, Tether è il posto giusto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? #### Informazioni sul lavoro Come Filmmaker AI, addestraerai strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale per concepire, creare e editare cortometraggi e video. Questi video saranno utilizzati per raccontare, presentare prodotti e portare le visioni di Tether e delle società affiliate alla vita. #### Responsabilità - Creare cortometraggi e video utilizzando strumenti di generazione di foto e video basati sull'intelligenza artificiale. - Editare e perfezionare il contenuto generato dall'intelligenza artificiale per produrre visuali di alta qualità e coinvolgenti. - Collaborare con i vantaggi del team di marketing per sviluppare concetti di video per Tether e altre marche affiliate. - Assicurarsi che tutti i contenuti video siano in linea con le linee guida della marca e comunicino i messaggi chiave in modo efficace. - Restare aggiornato sulle ultime tecnologie e tecniche di filmmaking con AI, incorporando innovazioni nel proprio workflow. - Gestire più progetti con scadenze notevoli, assicurando la consegna tempestiva. - Sperimentare con formati, stili e effetti creativi per produrre contenuti unici e memorabili. ### Requisiti - Esperienza provata nella produzione e editing di video, con un portafoglio di lavoro solido. - Abilità nella generazione di video con strumenti AI (ad esempio, Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E o altri). - Esperto in software di editing video (ad esempio, Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). - Abilità di raccontare storie creative con un occhio attento per la composizione visiva e i dettagli. - Capacità di concepire e eseguire idee rapidamente utilizzando strumenti AI. - Familiarità con il marketing digitale e capacità di adattare il contenuto per piattaforme di social media. - Abilità di gestire progetti e organizzare il lavoro, con la capacità di lavorare indipendentemente e rispettare i tempi di consegna. - Passione per la tecnologia, il bitcoin e l'innovazione (un plus). ##### offrendo - Compensazione competitiva. - Opportunità di lavorare con un team globale su progetti all'avanguardia. - Flessibilità di lavorare a distanza. - Accesso a strumenti e risorse di AI perfeziona. Un ambiente collaborativo in cui la tua creatività avrà un impatto diretto sulla narrazione della marca.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job As an AI Filmmaker, you will leverage AI-based photo and video tools to conceptualize, create, and edit short films and videos. These videos will be used to tell stories, showcase products, and bring the visions of Tether and its affiliated companies to life. You’ll work closely within the marketing department to ensure that each video aligns with the brand’s message, tone, and visual style. Responsibilities Create short films and videos using AI-driven photo and video generation tools. Edit and refine AI-generated content to produce high-quality, engaging visuals. Collaborate with the marketing team colleagues to develop video concepts for Tether, and other affiliated brands. Ensure all video content aligns with brand guidelines and communicates key messages effectively. Stay updated on the latest AI filmmaking tools and techniques, incorporating innovations into your workflow. Manage multiple projects with tight deadlines, ensuring timely delivery. Experiment with creative formats, styles, and effects to produce unique, memorable content. Proven experience in video production and editing, with a strong portfolio of work. Proficiency in AI video generation tools (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E, or others). Expertise in video editing software (e.g., Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). Creative storytelling skills with a keen eye for visual composition and detail. Ability to conceptualize and execute ideas quickly using AI tools. Familiarity with digital marketing and the ability to tailor content for social media platforms. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines. A passion for technology, bitcoin, and innovation is a plus. What we offer Competitive compensation. Opportunity to work with a global team on cutting-edge projects. Flexibility to work remotely. Access to advanced AI tools and resources. A collaborative environment where your creativity will have a direct impact on the brand’s narrative.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Tether et votre futur transporteur ### Description Rejoignez Tether et contribuez au plasma de l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas en train de construire des produits, mais nous révolutionnons le panorama financier mondial. Nos solutions d'avant-garde consentent à tous les investisseurs - le portefeuille et les ports des processeurs de paiement et de banque - à intégrer de manière fluide, le jeton garantit la réserve de votre blockchain. Profitez du potentiel de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de mémoriser, d'envoyer et de recevoir un jeton numérique instantanément, de manière sûre et globale, à un coût inférieur à 10 %. L'innovation est notre pilastro, qui assure la transparence dans chaque transaction. ### Innover avec Tether Tether Finance : Notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin plus affilié au monde, USDT, utilisé par des centaines de millions de personnes dans tout le monde, avec des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Ce n'est que le début : Tether Power : Notre solution pour le renforcement du potentiel d'optimisation de l'énergie en circulation pour l'exploitation minière du Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écocompatibles dans la structure de dernière génération et géo-diverse. Tether Data : Nos outils technologiques avancés réduisent les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorent les communications mondiales avec des solutions comme KEET, notre application qui permet de définir les conditions de sécurité et de confidentialité des données. Tether Education : La démocratisation de l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique à haut niveau permet à toutes les personnes de prospérer dans l'économie numérique et le travail, promouvant la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : Aux confins de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous nous trouvons dans les limites de ce qui est possible, créant un avenir dans l'innovation et la capacité humaine si fondatrice dans de nouveaux potentiels et inédits. ### Pourquoi tu vas à nous ? Notre équipe est une puissance de talent mondiale, qui travaille à distance de chaque angle du monde. Si vous êtes passionné de passion pour votre métier dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est votre moment de collaborer avec certains des cerveaux les plus brillants, les plus limités et les plus stables de nouveaux standards. Nous avons crû rapidement, avons maintenu notre structure claire et assuré notre poste de leader dans le cadre. Si vous avez d'excellentes capacités de communication en anglais et si vous contribuez bientôt à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est votre poste pour vous. Vous allez bientôt faire partie du futur ? ### Informations sur le travail Comme Filmmaker AI, utilisez des instruments de génération de photos et de vidéos basés sur l'intelligence artificielle pour concevoir, créer et éditer des cortométries et des vidéos. Cette vidéo sera utilisée pour raconter des histoires, présenter des produits et porter les visions de Tether et de votre société affiliée à la vie. ### Responsabilité - Créer des cortométries et des vidéos en utilisant des instruments de génération de photos et de vidéos basés sur l'intelligence artificielle. - Modifier et perfectionner le contenu généré par l'intelligence artificielle pour produire des visuels de haute qualité et de valeur. - Collaborez avec les collègues de l'équipe marketing pour développer des concepts de vidéo pour Tether et d'autres affiliés du marché. - Assurez-vous que tout le contenu vidéo est en ligne avec le guide de la marque et la communication des messages envoyés de manière efficace. - Restaurer la technologie ultime et les techniques de réalisation de films avec l'IA en intégrant des innovations dans le flux de travail propre. - Gestire plus de projets avec une cadence large, en assurant la tempête. - Expérimentez des formats, des styles et des effets créatifs pour produire du contenu unique et mémorable. ### Requisiti - Expérience vérifiée lors de la production et du montage vidéo, avec un portafoglio di lavoro solido. - Capacité de génération de vidéo avec des instruments AI (par exemple, Runway, Stable Diffusion, MidJourney, DALL-E ou autres). - Esperto dans les logiciels de montage vidéo (par exemple, Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve). - Capacité à raconter des histoires créatives avec un œil attentif à la composition visuelle et aux détails. - Capacité de conception et d'exécution d'idées en utilisant rapidement des instruments d'IA. - Familiarité avec le marketing numérique et capacité à adapter le contenu pour les médias sociaux. - Capacité de projeter des gestes et d'organiser le travail, avec la capacité de travailler indépendamment et de répondre aux délais de livraison. - Passionné par la technologie, le bitcoin et l'innovation (un plus). ### Cosa offriamo - Compensation compétitive. - Possibilités de travailler avec une équipe globale sur les projets d'avant-garde. - Flexibilité du travail à distance. - Accès aux instruments et risques d'IA avancés. - Un environnement collaboratif pour votre créativité aura un impact direct sur la narration de la marque.
