Wenn jemand persönliche finanzielle Informationen oder Zahlungen anfordert, ist es ein Schwindel. Meld es sofort. Wenn du unsicher bist, kontaktiere uns über unsere offizielle Website.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoins Tether et façons le futur de la finance numérique A Tether, nous ne construisons pas seulement des produits, nous révolutionnons le monde financier. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises - des bourses et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques - d'intégrer des jetons de réserve sur blockchain de manière transparente. En utilisant le pouvoir de la technologie blockchain, Tether permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, de manière sécurisée et mondiale, à un coût bien inférieur. La transparence est la pierre angulaire de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance en chaque transaction. Innovons avec Tether Tether Finance : Notre suite de produits innovants comprend la stablecoin la plus fiable au monde, USDT, utilisée par des centaines de millions de personnes partout dans le monde, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais c'est juste le début : Tether Power : Nous guidons le développement durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excessif de puissance pour le minage de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques éco-amicales dans des installations de pointe, géodiversifiées. Tether Data : Nous alimentons les progrès en intelligence artificielle et en technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application d'icône qui redéfinit la partage de données sécurisées et privées. Tether Education : Nous démocratisons l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de prospérer dans les économies numériques et de gig, et nous guidons le développement mondial et les opportunités. Tether Evolution : Au carrefour de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous poussons les limites de ce qui est possible, et nous créons un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines se mélangent de manière puissante et inédite. Pourquoi rejoindre nous ? Notre équipe est une puissance de talents mondiale, travaillant à distance de chaque coin du monde. Si vous êtes passionné de laisser une marque dans le secteur fintech, c'est votre moment de collaborer avec quelques-uns des esprits les plus brillants, de pousser les limites et de fixer de nouveaux standards. Nous avons grandi rapidement, maintenu notre agilité et nous nous sommes établis comme leaders dans le secteur. Si vous avez des compétences de communication en anglais exceptionnelles et que vous êtes prêt à contribuer au plus innovant platform du monde, Tether est le lieu pour vous. Soyez prêt à être partie de l'avenir ? À propos du travail Nous sommes à la recherche de stagiaires motivés MSc ou PhD pour travailler sur la génération de vidéos et les modèles de fondation multimodale vidéo. Les stagiaires se concentreront sur une ou plusieurs composantes du cycle de vie du modèle de fondation et sont encouragés à proposer des idées créatives et guidées par la recherche qui avancent l'état de l'art. Vous contribuerez au développement et à l'amélioration des modèles de fondation vidéo ouverts, analyserez leurs limites et concevrez des solutions scalables. C'est un stage axé sur la recherche avec des opportunités de publication dans des conférences de vision computer et d'apprentissage automatique de haut niveau, et de travailler avec des jeux de données vidéo à pétabyte et des clusters de GPU distribués avec des milliers de GPU. Responsabilités Recherche et amélioration des modèles de fondation vidéo ouverts Concentrez-vous sur une ou plusieurs domaines comme le pré-entraînement, l'entraînement supervisé, le post-entraînement, l'inference, la conception d'architecture ou l'évaluation Évaluez les modèles par rapport à l'état actuel de l'art, identifiez les points faibles et proposez des améliorations innovantes Travaillez avec des jeux de données vidéo importants et des systèmes de formation distribués Collaborez avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs sur des projets avec une claire potentialité de recherche et de publication Requis minimums : Candidat MSc ou PhD en informatique, en apprentissage automatique, en vision computer ou dans un domaine technique connexe Recherche ou expérience en génération d'images, en génération de vidéos ou en apprentissage multimodal Connaissance des modèles de fondation vidéo ouverts et de leurs limites actuelles Compétence avec PyTorch et des flux de travail d'apprentissage profond modernes Compétence analytique forte, créativité et compétence de collaboration Pubblications autore principal corrélées précédentes dans CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS ou ICLR Requis préférés : Travail démontré corrélé, comme un dépôt de code de recherche ou un benchmark publié sur GitHub ou des plateformes similaires Expérience avec un entraînement à grande échelle ou distribué Expérience directe avec des modèles de génération de vidéos basés sur la diffusion, basés sur des transformateurs ou hybrides Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit les points suivants lors de l'application pour un poste : Appliquez uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes tierces ou d'agences de recrutement, à moins que ce ne soit clairement indiqué. Tous les postes ouverts sont listés sur notre page de carrières officielle : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. Si vous êtes incertain, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous n'organisons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute la communication se fait par des e-mails officiels et des plateformes de la société. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute la communication de notre part arrive de mails qui se terminent par @tether.to ou @tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais des informations financières ou des paiements. Si quelqu'un demande des informations financières personnelles ou des paiements à tout moment du processus de recrutement, c'est un escroc. Signalez-le immédiatement. Si vous avez des doutes, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site web officiel.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e plasmiamo il futuro della finanza digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, stiamo rivoluzionando la finanza globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende - dalle borse e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e alle macchine per il denaro - di integrare token garantiti da riserve in modo trasparente e sicuro su blockchain. Sfruttando il potere della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di archiviare, inviare e ricevere token digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, a un costo inferiore del 10%. La trasparenza è il fondamento di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo la fiducia in ogni transazione. Innoviamo con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra suite di prodotti innovativi comprende la stablecoin più affidata al mondo, USDT, utilizzata da centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione di asset digitali pionieristici. Ma è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: La nostra soluzione per la crescita sostenibile ottimizza l'eccesso di potenza per il mining di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecologiche in strutture di ultima generazione e geodiversificate. Tether Data: La nostra soluzione per i breakthrough in AI e tecnologia peer-to-peer riduce i costi di infrastruttura e migliora le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, il nostro app flagship che ridefinisce la condivisione di dati sicuri e privati. Tether Education: Democrazia l'accesso ai migliori apprendimenti digitali, facciamo crescere le persone in economie digitali e gig, guidando la crescita e l'opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: All'intersezione di tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui l'innovazione e le capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e inediti. Perché unirti a noi? La nostra squadra è un potente talento globale, che lavora a distanza da ogni angolo del mondo. Se sei appassionato di lasciare un segno nel settore fintech, questo è il tuo momento per collaborare con alcuni dei migliori talenti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Abbiamo cresciuto rapidamente, mantenuto la nostra flessibilità e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti abilità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire al più innovativo piattaforma del pianeta, Tether è il posto per te. Sei pronto a essere parte del futuro? Sulla posizione del lavoro Stiamo cercando interni motivati MSc o PhD per lavorare su generazione di video e modelli di fondazione multimodale video. Gli interni si concentreranno su uno o più componenti del ciclo di vita del modello di fondazione e sono incoraggiati a proporre idee creative e guidate dalla ricerca che avanzano lo stato dell'arte. Contribuirai al miglioramento e allo sviluppo di modelli di fondazione video aperti, analizzerai le loro limitazioni e progetterai soluzioni scalabili. Questo è un tirocinio di ricerca con opportunità di pubblicare in conferenze di computer vision e apprendimento automatico di alto livello, e di lavorare con dataset di video a petabyte e cluster di GPU distribuiti con migliaia di GPU. Responsabilità Ricerca e migliora modelli di fondazione video e multimodale Si concentri su uno o più aree come pre-allenamento, fine-tuning supervisionato, post-allenamento, inferenza, progettazione di architettura o valutazione Benchmarker modelli contro lo stato dell'arte attuale, identifica i punti di blocco e propone miglioramenti innovativi Lavora con dataset di video a grandi dimensioni e sistemi di addestramento distribuiti Collabora con ricercatori e ingegneri su progetti con chiara potenzialità di ricerca e pubblicazione Requisiti minimi: Candidato MSc o PhD in Informatica, Apprendimento automatico, Visione computazionale o campo tecnico correlato Oggetto di ricerca o esperienza in generazione di immagini, generazione di video o apprendimento multimodale Consapevolezza dei modelli di fondazione video aperti e delle loro attuali limitazioni Abilità con PyTorch e flussi di lavoro di apprendimento profondo moderni Pensiero analitico forte, creatività e abilità di collaborazione Pubblicazioni di primo autore correlate precedenti in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS o ICLR Requisiti preferiti: Lavoro dimostrato correlato, come repository di codice di ricerca o benchmark rilasciati su GitHub o piattaforme simili Esperienza con addestramento a grandi dimensioni o distribuito Esperienza manuale con modelli di generazione di video basati su diffusione, modelli di generazione di video basati su trasformatori o modelli ibridi Informazioni importanti per i candidati I truffe di reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggersi, per favore tenere presente le seguenti informazioni quando si applica per ruoli: Applica solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme terze o agenzie per la reclutamento a meno che non sia stato chiaramente stabilito. Verifica l'identità del recruiter. Tutti i nostri recruiter hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se sei incerto, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. Sii cauto con i metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione viene fatta attraverso email ufficiali e piattaforme della società. Verifica gli indirizzi email. Tutta la comunicazione da parte nostra arriverà da email che terminano con @tether.to o @tether.io Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o pagamenti in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di uno scherzo. Segnala immediatamente. Se hai dubbi, non esitare a contattarci attraverso il nostro sito web ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoins Tether et façons le futur de la finance numérique A Tether, nous ne construisons pas seulement des produits, nous révolutionnons un monde financier global. Nos solutions innovantes permettent aux entreprises - des bourses et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques - d'intégrer des jetons garantis par des réserves de manière transparente et sécurisée dans les blockchain. En utilisant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, de manière sécurisée et mondiale, à un coût inférieur de 10 %. La transparence est la pierre angulaire de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants comprend la stablecoin la plus fiable au monde, USDT , utilisée par des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais c'est juste le début: Tether Power: Notre solution pour la croissance durable optimise l'énergie en excès pour le minage de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data: Nos solutions de pointe réduisent les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorent les communications mondiales avec des solutions comme KEET , notre application d'icône qui redéfinit la partage de données sécurisées et privées. Tether Education: La démocratisation de l'accès aux meilleurs apprentissages numériques, Tether forme les individus pour prospérer dans les économies numériques et gig, et pousse la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution: Au carrefour de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous pouvons pousser les limites de ce qui est possible, et créer un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines se mélangent de manière puissante et inédite. Pourquoi rejoindre nous ? Notre équipe est une puissance de talents mondiale, travaillant à distance de chaque coin du monde. Si vous êtes passionné de laisser une marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est votre moment de collaborer avec quelques-uns des meilleurs esprits, de pousser les limites et de fixer de nouveaux standards. Nous avons grandi rapidement, maintenu notre agilité et sécurisé notre place en tant que leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez des compétences de communication en anglais exceptionnelles et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plus innovante plateforme du monde, Tether est le lieu pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à être partie du futur ? À propos de la fonction Nous recherchons des internes motivés MSc ou PhD pour travailler sur la génération de vidéos et les modèles de fondation multimodales de vidéos. Les internes se concentreront sur un ou plusieurs composants du cycle de vie du modèle de fondation et sont encouragés à proposer des idées créatives et guidées par la recherche qui avancent l'état de l'art. Vous contribuerez au développement et à l'amélioration des modèles de fondation de vidéos ouverts, analyserez leurs limites et concevrez des solutions scalables. C'est un stage de recherche avec des opportunités de publication dans des conférences de vision informatique et de machine learning de haut niveau, et de travailler avec des jeux de données de vidéos à pétabyte et des clusters de GPU distribués avec des milliers de GPU. Responsabilités Recherche et amélioration des modèles de fondation de vidéos et multimodales Concentrez-vous sur un ou plusieurs domaines comme pré-entraînement, entraînement supervisé, post-entraînement, inférence, conception d'architecture ou évaluation Benchmark des modèles contre l'état de l'art actuel, identifiez les points de blocage et proposez des améliorations innovantes Travaillez avec des jeux de données de vidéos importants et des systèmes de formation distribués Collaborer avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs sur des projets avec une claire potentialité de recherche et de publication Requis minimums: Candidat MSc ou PhD en informatique, apprentissage automatique, vision informatique ou domaine technique connexe Thème de recherche ou expérience en génération d'images, génération de vidéos ou apprentissage multimodal Conscience des modèles de fondation de vidéos ouverts et de leurs limites actuelles Compétence en PyTorch et flux de travail de l'apprentissage profond moderne Compétences analytiques fortes, créativité et compétences de collaboration Publications de premier auteur précédentes dans CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS ou ICLR Requis souhaités: Travail dimostré connexe, comme code de base de recherche ou benchmark publié sur GitHub ou plateformes similaires Expérience avec la formation à grande échelle ou distribuée Expérience directe avec des modèles de génération de vidéos basés sur la diffusion, des modèles de génération de vidéos basés sur les transformateurs ou des modèles hybrides Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit les informations suivantes lors de l'application pour des postes: Appliquez uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous ne utilisons pas de plateformes tierces ou d'agences de recrutement, à moins qu'il ne soit clairement indiqué. Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. Si vous êtes incertain, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en contactant nous par notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne conduisons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute la communication se fait par des e-mails officiels et des plateformes de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute la communication de notre part arrivera par des e-mails qui se terminent par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des informations financières personnelles ou des paiements à tout moment du processus de recrutement, il s'agit d'un escroc. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. Lorsque vous êtes incertain, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par notre site web officiel.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Wir treiben nachhaltige Wachstum an, unsere Energie-Lösungen optimieren den Überschuss an Energie für Bitcoin-Mining mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in hochmodernen, geo-diversen Anlagen. Tether Data: Wir fördern Durchbrüche in der KI und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie, reduzieren die Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit fortschrittlichen Lösungen wie KEET, unserem Flaggschiff-App, die die sichere und private Datenübermittlung neu definiert. Tether Education: Wir demokratisieren den Zugang zu hochwertigem digitalen Lernen, ermöglichen es Menschen, sich in der digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaft zu behaupten und treiben globales Wachstum und Möglichkeiten an. Tether Evolution: Am Schnittpunkt von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial drücken wir die Grenzen dessen, was möglich ist, und schaffen einen Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten in mächtigen, unkonventionellen Weisen zusammenfließen. Wir haben schnell gewachsen, geblieben flexibel und sicherten uns unseren Platz als Führer im Bereich. Wenn du hervorragende Englisch-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten hast und bereit bist, zum innovativsten Plattform der Welt beizutragen, bist du bei Tether genau richtig. Über das Job Wir suchen motivierte MSc- oder PhD-Interns, um an der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von offenen Video- und multimodalen Video-Grundmodellen zu arbeiten. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoins Tether et façons le futur de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne créons pas seulement des produits, nous révolutionnons la finance mondiale. Nos solutions innovantes permettent aux entreprises - des bourses et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets - d'intégrer des jetons garanties par des réserves sur des blockchains de manière transparente. En utilisant le pouvoir de la technologie blockchain, Tether permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, de manière sécurisée et mondiale, à un coût inférieur de 10 %. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovons avec Tether Tether Finance : Notre suite de produits innovants comprend la stablecoin la plus fiable au monde, USDT, utilisée par des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numérique pionniers. Mais c'est juste le début : Tether Power : Nous guidons le développement durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excessif de puissance pour le minage du Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : Nous alimentons les progrès en intelligence artificielle et en technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts de l'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions innovantes comme KEET, notre application de référence qui redéfinit la partage de données sécurisées et privées. Tether Education : Nous démocratisons l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de prospérer dans l'économie numérique et de croître globalement. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous poussons les limites de ce qui est possible, créant un futur où l'innovation et les capacités humaines se mélangent en des manières puissantes et inédites. Pourquoi rejoindre notre équipe ? Notre équipe est une puissance de talents mondiale, travaillant à distance de chaque coin du monde. Si vous êtes passionné de laisser une marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est votre moment de collaborer avec quelques-uns des esprits les plus brillants, de pousser les limites et de fixer de nouveaux standards. Nous avons grandi rapidement, resté flexible et nous avons sécurisé notre place en leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez des compétences de communication en anglais exceptionnelles et que vous êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante au monde, Tether est le lieu pour vous. Es-tu prêt à être partie du futur ? Sur le travail Nous recherchons des internes motivés MSc ou PhD pour travailler sur la génération de vidéo et les modèles de fondation multimodale vidéo. Les internes se concentreront sur un ou plusieurs composants du cycle de vie du modèle de fondation et seront encouragés à proposer des idées créatives et guidées par la recherche qui avancent l'état de l'art. Vous contribuerez au développement et à l'amélioration des modèles de fondation vidéo ouverts, analyserez leurs limites et concevrez des solutions scalables. C'est un stage axé sur la recherche avec des opportunités de publication dans des conférences de vision informatique et d'apprentissage automatique de haut niveau et de travailler avec des jeux de données de vidéo à pétabyte et des clusters de GPU distribués avec des milliers de GPU. Responsabilités Recherche et amélioration des modèles de fondation vidéo et multimodale ouverts Concentre-toi sur un ou plusieurs domaines comme pré-formation, formation supervisée, post-formation, inférence, conception d'architecture ou évaluation Benchmarker les modèles contre l'état de l'art actuel, identifie les points de blocage et propose des améliorations innovantes Travail avec des jeux de données de vidéo à grande échelle et des systèmes de formation distribués Collabore avec des chercheurs et des ingénieurs sur des projets avec une claire potentialité de publication Requis minimums : Candidat MSc ou PhD en informatique, apprentissage automatique, vision informatique ou domaine technique connexe Thème de recherche ou expérience en génération d'images, génération de vidéo ou apprentissage multimodal Conscience des modèles de fondation vidéo ouverts et de leurs limites actuelles Compétence en PyTorch et flux de travail de l'apprentissage profond moderne Pensée analytique forte, créativité et compétence de collaboration Publications liées comme premier auteur dans CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS ou ICLR Requis souhaités : Travail lié démontré, comme code de recherche ou benchmark publié sur GitHub ou plateformes similaires Expérience avec la formation à grande échelle ou distribuée Expérience directe avec des modèles de génération de vidéo basés sur la diffusion, basés sur les transformateurs ou hybrides Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont de plus en plus fréquentes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit les points suivants lors de l'application pour des postes : Appliquez uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes tierces ou d'agences de recrutement à moins que ce ne soit clairement indiqué. Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. Si vous êtes incertain, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant par notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication insolites. Nous n'organisons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute la communication se fait par des e-mails officiels et des plateformes. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute la communication de notre part sera envoyée par des e-mails se terminant par @tether.to ou @tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des informations financières personnelles ou des paiements à tout moment pendant le processus de recrutement, c'est un escroc. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. Si vous avez des doutes, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par notre site web officiel.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. L'évolution de l'approche : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du travail Nous recherchons des stagiaires hautement motivés en MSc ou en doctorat pour travailler sur la production vidéo et les modèles de fondation vidéo multimodale. Les stagiaires se concentreront sur une ou plusieurs composantes du cycle de vie du modèle de fondation et sont encouragés à proposer des idées créatives, axées sur la recherche, qui font progresser l'état de l'art. Vous contribuerez au développement et à l'amélioration de modèles de fondation vidéo open-source, analyserez leurs limites et concevoirez des solutions évolutives. Il s'agit d'un stage axé sur la recherche avec des occasions de publier dans des conférences sur la vision informatique et l'apprentissage automatique de haut niveau, et de travailler avec des ensembles de données vidéo à l'échelle des pétaoctets et de grands groupes GPU distribués avec des milliers de GPU. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Bist du bereit, mit Tether die Zukunft der digitalen Finanzen zu gestalten? Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir revolutionieren die globale Finanzwelt. Tether Education: Wir demokratisieren den Zugang zu hochwertigen digitalen Lernangeboten, um Einzelpersonen zu ermöglichen, sich in der digitalen und Gig-Wirtschaft zu behaupten, und globales Wachstum und Chancen zu fördern. Bist du bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu werden? Über das Job Wir suchen motivierte MSc- oder PhD-Praktikanten, um an der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von offenen Video- und multimodalen Video-Grundmodellen zu arbeiten. Die Praktikanten werden sich auf einen oder mehrere Komponenten des Grundmodell-Lebenszyklus konzentrieren und werden ermutigt, kreative und forschungsgetriebene Ideen vorzuschlagen, die den Stand der Technik vorantreiben. Du wirst zum Entwickeln und Verbessern von offenen Video- und multimodalen Video-Grundmodellen beitragen, ihre Einschränkungen analysieren und skalierbare Lösungen entwerfen. Dies ist ein forschungsorientiertes Praktikum mit Möglichkeiten, an Top-Tier-Computer-Vision- und -Machine-Learning-Konferenzen zu publizieren und mit Petabyte-Scale-Video-Datasets und großen verteilten GPU-Clustern mit Tausenden von GPUs zu arbeiten. Verantwortung Forschung und Verbesserung offener Video- und multimodaler Video-Grundmodelle Konzentriere dich auf einen oder mehrere Bereiche wie Vorbereitung, supervisierter Feinjustierung, Nachbereitung, Inferenz, Architekturdesign oder Bewertung Bewerte Modelle gegen den aktuellen Stand der Technik, identifiziere Engpässe und schlage innovative Verbesserungen vor Arbeite mit großen Video-Datasets und verteilten Trainingsystemen Kooperiere mit Forschern und Ingenieuren an Projekten mit klarem Publikationspotenzial Mindestanforderungen: MSc- oder PhD-Kandidat in Informatik, Maschinellem Lernen, Computer-Vision oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet Forschungsprojekt oder Erfahrung in Bildgenerierung, Videogenerierung oder multimodalem Lernen Kenntnis offener Video-Grundmodelle und ihrer aktuellen Einschränkungen Fähigkeit in Tiefe mit PyTorch und modernen Deep-Learning-Workflows Analytisches Denken, Kreativität und Kooperationsfähigkeit Erstautor-Veröffentlichungen in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS oder ICLR Wünschenswerte Anforderungen: Nachgewiesenes korreliertes Werk, wie Forschungscode-Repository oder Benchmark auf GitHub oder ähnlichen Plattformen Erfahrung mit großskaligen oder verteilten Trainings Direkte Erfahrung mit diffusionsbasierten, transformerbasierten oder hybriden Video-Generierungsmodellen Hinweis für Kandidaten Rekrutierungs-Schwindel sind immer häufiger geworden. Um dich zu schützen, beachte die folgenden Dinge, wenn du dich für einen Job bewirbst: Bewirb dich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wenn du unsicher bist, kannst du die Identität des Rekrutierers überprüfen, indem du seinen Profil oder uns über unser Website kontaktierst. Sei vorsichtig mit ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoins Tether et façons la future de la finance numérique A Tether, nous ne construisons pas seulement des produits, nous révolutionnons le monde financier. Nos solutions innovantes permettent aux entreprises - des bourses et des portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets - d'intégrer des jetons garanties par des réserves de manière transparente dans les réseaux de blockchain. Tether Data: Nous alimentons les progrès en intelligence artificielle et en technologie peer-to-peer, en réduisant les coûts d'infrastructure et en améliorant les communications mondiales avec des solutions innovantes comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit la partage de données sécurisées et privées. Tether Evolution: Au carrefour de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous pouvons pousser les limites de ce qui est possible, créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines se mélangent de manière puissante et inédite. Les stagiaires se concentreront sur un ou plusieurs composants du cycle de vie du modèle de fondation et seront encouragés à proposer des idées créatives et guidées par la recherche qui avancent l'état de l'art. Vous contribuerez au développement et à l'amélioration des modèles de fondation de vidéos ouverts, analyserez leurs limites et concevrez des solutions scalables. C'est un stage axé sur la recherche avec des opportunités de publication dans des conférences de vision par ordinateur et d'apprentissage automatique de haut niveau et de travailler avec des jeux de données de vidéos pétaoctets et des clusters de GPU distribués avec des milliers de GPU. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit les points suivants lors de l'application pour un poste: Appliquez uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plateformes tierces ou d'agences de recrutement à moins que cela ne soit spécifié. Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont des profils LinkedIn vérifiés. Si vous êtes incertain, vous pouvez confirmer l'identité du recruteur en contrôlant son profil ou en nous contactant par notre site web. Soyez prudent avec les méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entretiens par WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute la communication se fait par des e-mails officiels et des plateformes de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute la communication de notre part se terminera par @tether.to ou @tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si vous avez des doutes, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par notre site web officiel.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. About the job We are seeking highly motivated MSc or PhD interns to work on video generation and multimodal video foundation models. Interns will focus on one or more components of the foundation model lifecycle and are encouraged to propose creative, research-driven ideas that advance the state of the art. You will contribute to the development and improvement of open-source video foundation models, analyze their limitations, and design scalable solutions. This is a research-focused internship with opportunities to publish at top-tier computer vision and machine learning conferences, and to work with petabyte-scale video datasets and large distributed GPU clusters with thousands of GPUs. Responsibilities Research and improve open-source video and multimodal video generation foundation models Focus on one or more areas such as pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, post-training, inference, architecture design, or evaluation Benchmark models against current state-of-the-art, identify bottlenecks, and propose novel improvements Work with large-scale video datasets and distributed training systems Collaborate with researchers and engineers on projects with clear research and publication potential Minimum Qualifications: MSc or PhD candidate in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field Research topic or experience in image generation, video generation, or multimodal learning Awareness of open-source video foundation models and their current limitations Proficiency with PyTorch and modern deep learning workflows Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and collaboration skills Prior first-author related publications in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, or ICLR Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated related work, such as research codebase or benchmarks released on GitHub or similar platforms Experience with large-scale or distributed training Hands-on experience with diffusion-based, transformer-based, or hybrid video generation models Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common.
