Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Contribuirai a QVAC, il nostro stack AI locale costruito per portare AI veloce e privato direttamente ai dispositivi utente. Questo ruolo si adatta agli ingegneri che prosperano in un ambiente JS full-stack e godono di lavorare vicino a prodotto e piattaforma per trasformare potenti funzionalità AI in applicazioni reali. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms Contributions to open-source projects in descriptionByLocale.de: Tether und Shape the Future of Digital Finance Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Pionier einer globalen Finanzrevolution. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Vous contribuerez à QVAC, notre pile d'IA locale conçue pour apporter une IA rapide et privée directement aux appareils des utilisateurs. Connaissance de la gestion des ressources GPU et de l'infrastructure du framework ML. Compréhension des paradigmes WebAssembly ou Edge Computing. descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e Forma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly in strutture geo-diverse all'avanguardia. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? A seconda del progetto, si potrebbe costruire applicazioni di interfaccia utente (mobile o desktop) o contribuire allo strato della piattaforma che collega i nostri motori di inferenza C++ con l'ecosistema app. Che tu stia realizzando esperienze di prodotto lucidate o costruendo gli SDK e i binding su cui gli altri sviluppatori si affidano, ti aiuterai a rendere l'IA locale veramente utilizzabile. Contribuirai a QVAC, il nostro stack AI locale costruito per portare AI veloce e privato direttamente ai dispositivi utente. Questo ruolo si adatta agli ingegneri che prosperano in un ambiente JS full-stack e godono di lavorare vicino a prodotto e piattaforma per trasformare potenti funzionalità AI in applicazioni reali. Responsabilities Own React (Expo/Electron) applicazione sviluppo con architettura pulita e modulare costruire UI utilizzando moderno stack React (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Integrare le app mobili con sistemi distribuiti, inferenza locale e livelli p2p Esperienza forte con REST/WebSockets, flussi asincroni e memorizzazione sicura dei dati Capacità di costruire moduli nativi (iOS/Android) quando necessario (con qualche aiuto) Buona comprensione dei sistemi offline-primo, cache e prestazioni Confortevole integrazione SDKs (pagamenti, cripto, modelli AI, ecc.) Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms Contributions to open-source projects in relevant domains Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. descriptionByLocale.de: Tether und Shape the Future of Digital Finance Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Pionier einer globalen Finanzrevolution. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste : Vous travaillerez sur les couches JavaScript et TypeScript de notre pile d'IA locale. Selon le projet, vous pouvez créer des applications destinées aux utilisateurs (mobiles ou de bureau) ou contribuer à la couche de plate-forme qui relie nos moteurs d'inférence C++ à l'écosystème d'applications. Que vous créiez des expériences produit raffinées ou que vous construisiez les SDK et les liaisons sur lesquels s'appuient d'autres développeurs, vous contribuerez à rendre l'IA locale réellement utilisable. Vous contribuerez à QVAC, notre pile d'IA locale conçue pour apporter une IA rapide et privée directement aux appareils des utilisateurs. Ce rôle convient aux ingénieurs qui s'épanouissent dans un environnement JS full-stack et aiment travailler à proximité du produit et de la plate-forme pour transformer de puissantes capacités d'IA en applications réelles. Connaissance de la gestion des ressources GPU et de l'infrastructure du framework ML. Compréhension des paradigmes WebAssembly ou Edge Computing. descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e Forma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Ma questo è solo l'inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l'eccesso di potenza per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly in strutture geo-diverse all'avanguardia. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? A seconda del progetto, si potrebbe costruire applicazioni di interfaccia utente (mobile o desktop) o contribuire allo strato della piattaforma che collega i nostri motori di inferenza C++ con l'ecosistema app. Che tu stia realizzando esperienze di prodotto lucidate o costruendo gli SDK e i binding su cui gli altri sviluppatori si affidano, ti aiuterai a rendere l'IA locale veramente utilizzabile. Contribuirai a QVAC, il nostro stack AI locale costruito per portare AI veloce e privato direttamente ai dispositivi utente. Questo ruolo si adatta agli ingegneri che prosperano in un ambiente JS full-stack e godono di lavorare vicino a prodotto e piattaforma per trasformare potenti funzionalità AI in applicazioni reali. Responsabilities Own React (Expo/Electron) applicazione sviluppo con architettura pulita e modulare costruire UI utilizzando moderno stack React (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Integrare le app mobili con sistemi distribuiti, inferenza locale e livelli p2p Esperienza forte con REST/WebSockets, flussi asincroni e memorizzazione sicura dei dati Capacità di costruire moduli nativi (iOS/Android) quando necessario (con qualche aiuto) Buona comprensione dei sistemi offline-primo, cache e prestazioni Confortevole integrazione SDKs (pagamenti, cripto, modelli AI, ecc.) Scrivere codice affidabile: test unità, test E2E (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Esperienza con TypeScript attraverso stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: esperienza con API distribuite/P2P, on-device ML, crittografia 5+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di Fullstack Proficienza a livello di esperti in Node.js/JavaScript per lo sviluppo backend e React frontend framework Esperienza con la gestione dei dati esecutivi su dispositivi constrained (via SQLite o similar) Esperienza comprovata costruzione e scaling sistemi distribuiti o architetture orientate agli eventi Esperienza con tecnologie di containerizzazione (Docker) e piattaforme di orchestrazione (Kubernetes) Proficienza con i database, e una profonda comprensione della modellazione e ottimizzazione dei dati La solida comprensione del networking, dei principi di sicurezza e delle migliori pratiche per i sistemi di produzione Esperienza con lo streaming di dati in tempo reale e le implementazioni RPC Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente remoto e comunicare efficacemente attraverso le fusi orari Nizza ad avere: Esperienza con le tecnologie di peer-to-peer (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) o simili protocolli di comunicazione distribuiti Per proteggersi, si prega di tenere a mente il seguente quando si applica per i ruoli: Applicare solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms Contributions to open-source projects in relevant domains Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Tether und Shape the Future of Digital Finance Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Pionier einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen befähigen Unternehmen – von Börsen und Geldbörsen bis zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten –, über Blockchains lückenlos recycelte Token zu integrieren. Transparenz ist der Grundstein für alles, was wir tun, um Vertrauen in jede Transaktion zu gewährleisten. Innovate mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produkt-Suite verfügt über das weltweit vertrauenswürdigste Stallcoin, USDT, das von Hunderten von Millionen weltweit begehrt wird, sowie wegweisende digitale Asset-Tokenization-Dienste. Tether Data: Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie reduzieren wir die Infrastrukturkosten und erhöhen die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Warum bei uns? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von jeder Ecke der Welt entfernt arbeitet. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran sind, eine Marke im Fintech-Raum zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der hellsten Köpfe zu kooperieren, Grenzen zu drängen und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, blieben schlank und sicherten unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche. Wenn Sie hervorragende englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten haben und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform auf dem Planeten beizutragen, ist Tether der Ort für Sie. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e Forma il Futuro della Finanza Digitale A Tether, non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e dai portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare senza soluzione di continuità i gettoni di riserva in blockchains. Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: Guidare la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano il potere in eccesso per l'estrazione mineraria di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche eco-friendly nelle strutture all'avanguardia e geo-diverse. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. Tether Education: Democratizzazione dell'accesso all'apprendimento digitale di alto livello, forniamo agli individui di prosperare nelle economie digitali e di gig, guidando la crescita globale e l'opportunità. Tether Evolution: All'incrocio tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, realizzando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza di talento globale, lavorando da remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se siete appassionati di fare un segno nello spazio fintech, questa è la vostra opportunità di collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti veloci, siamo stati magra, e assicurato il nostro posto come leader nel settore. Se avete eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese e siete pronti a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto per voi. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Riguardo al lavoro: lavorerai attraverso lo strato JavaScript e TypeScript del nostro stack AI locale. A seconda del progetto, è possibile costruire applicazioni di interfaccia utente (mobile o desktop) o contribuire allo strato della piattaforma che collega i nostri motori di inferenza C++ con l'ecosistema app. Che tu stia realizzando esperienze di prodotto lucidate o costruendo gli SDK e gli binding su cui gli altri sviluppatori si affidano, ti aiuterai a rendere l'IA locale veramente utilizzabile. Contribuirai a QVAC, il nostro stack AI locale costruito per portare AI veloce e privato direttamente ai dispositivi utente. Questo ruolo si adatta agli ingegneri che prosperano in un ambiente JS full-stack e godono di lavorare vicino a prodotto e piattaforma per trasformare potenti capacità AI in applicazioni reali. Responsabilities Own React (Expo/Electron) applicazione sviluppo con architettura pulita e modulare costruire UI utilizzando moderno stack React (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Integrare le app mobili con sistemi distribuiti, inferenza locale e livelli p2p Esperienza forte con REST/WebSockets, flussi asincroni e archiviazione dati sicura Capacità di costruire moduli nativi (iOS/Android) quando necessario (con qualche aiuto) Buona comprensione dei sistemi offline-primo, cache e prestazioni Confortevole integrazione SDK (pagamenti, cripto, modelli AI, ecc.) Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno verificato i profili LinkedIn. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci attraverso il nostro sito web. Siate cauti di metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste su WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutta la comunicazione avviene tramite e-mail e piattaforme aziendali ufficiali. Doppio indirizzo email. Tutte le comunicazioni da noi verranno da e-mail che terminano in @ tether. a o @ tether.io Non chiederemo mai il pagamento o i dettagli finanziari. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innover avec Tether Tether Finance : Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT , sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde entier, ainsi que des services de tokenisation numériques pionniers. Mais c'est juste le début: Tether Power: Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans les installations géo-divers de pointe. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance mondiale et des opportunités. Tether Evolution : A l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est votre occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du travail : Vous travaillerez sur la couche JavaScript et TypeScript de notre pile locale d'IA. Selon le projet, vous pouvez construire des applications orientées utilisateur (mobile ou bureau) ou contribuer à la couche de plate-forme qui relie nos moteurs d'inférence C++ à l'écosystème de l'application. Que vous fabriquiez des expériences de produits polis ou que vous construisiez les SDK et les fixations sur lesquelles les autres développeurs comptent, vous aiderez à rendre l'IA locale vraiment utilisable. Vous allez contribuer à QVAC, notre pile locale d'IA construite pour apporter une AI rapide et privée directement aux appareils utilisateurs. Ce rôle convient aux ingénieurs qui prospèrent dans un environnement JS complet et qui aiment travailler à proximité du produit et de la plate-forme pour transformer de puissantes capacités d'IA en applications réelles. Responsabilités Propre Réaction (Expo/Electron) développement d'applications avec une architecture propre et modulaire Construire l'interface utilisateur en utilisant la pile React moderne (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implémenter des applications locales premières / locales seulement Intégrer les applications mobiles avec des systèmes distribués, l'inférence locale et les couches p2p Forte expérience avec REST/WebSockets, flux asynchrones et stockage sécurisé des données Capacité de construire des modules natifs (iOS/Android) au besoin (avec une certaine aide) Bonne compréhension des systèmes hors ligne, de la mise en cache et des performances Confortable intégration SDK (paiements, crypto, modèles d'IA, etc.) Écrire un code fiable : tests unitaires, tests E2E (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Expérience avec TypeScript sur la pile (frontend + backend) Bonus: expérience avec les API distribuées/P2P, sur les appareils ML, cryptographie 5+ ans d'expérience en développement Fullstack Compétence de niveau expert en nœud. js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with perforant data handling on restricted devices (via SQLite ou similaire) Experience éprouvée building and scaled systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Connaissance des bases de données et compréhension approfondie de la modélisation et de l'optimisation des données Compréhension solide du réseautage, des principes de sécurité et des meilleures pratiques pour les systèmes de production Expérience de la diffusion en temps réel des données et des implémentations RPC Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante dans un environnement éloigné et de communiquer efficacement entre les fuseaux horaires Bonne à avoir: Expérience avec les technologies peer-to-peer (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) ou des protocoles de communication distribués similaires Familiarité avec les API d'inférence AI/ML et les paramètres compatibles OpenAI Expérience précédente construction de plateformes AI SaaS ou PaaS Connaissance de la gestion des ressources GPU et de l'infrastructure du cadre ML Compréhension des paradigmes WebAssembly ou de ledge computing Contributions à des projets open-source dans des domaines pertinents Informations importantes pour les candidats Les arnaques de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Tous les rôles ouverts sont listés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifier l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Faites attention aux méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait par le biais de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ sether. à ou @ tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms Contributions to open-source projects in descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT , sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais ce n'est que le début : Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance mondiale et des opportunités. L'évolution de l'approche : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du travail : Vous travaillerez sur la couche JavaScript et TypeScript de notre pile locale d'IA. Selon le projet, vous pouvez construire des applications orientées utilisateur (mobile ou bureau) ou contribuer à la couche de plate-forme qui relie nos moteurs d'inférence C++ avec l'écosystème de l'application. Que vous fabriquiez des expériences de produits polis ou que vous construisiez les SDK et les fixations sur lesquelles les autres développeurs comptent, vous aiderez à rendre l'IA locale vraiment utilisable. Vous allez contribuer à QVAC, notre pile locale d'IA conçue pour apporter une AI rapide et privée directement aux appareils utilisateurs. Ce rôle convient aux ingénieurs qui prospèrent dans un environnement JS complet et qui aiment travailler à proximité du produit et de la plateforme pour transformer de puissantes capacités d'IA en applications réelles. Responsabilités propre Réaction (Expo/Electron) développement d'applications avec une architecture propre et modulaire Construire l'interface utilisateur en utilisant la pile React moderne (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implémenter des applications locales premières / locales seulement Intégrer les applications mobiles avec les systèmes distribués, l'inférence locale et les couches p2p Forte expérience avec REST/WebSockets, flux asynchrones et stockage sécurisé des données Capacité de construire des modules natifs (iOS/Android) au besoin (avec une certaine aide) Bonne compréhension des systèmes hors ligne, de la mise en cache et des performances Intégration confortable des SDK (paiements, crypto, modèles d'IA, etc.) Écrire un code fiable: tests unitaires, tests E2E (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Expérience avec TypeScript à travers la pile (frontend + backend) Bonus: expérience avec les API distribuées/P2P, sur les appareils ML, cryptographie 5+ ans d'expérience dans le développement Fullstack Compétence de niveau expert dans Node.js/JavaScript pour le développement de backend et le cadre React frontend Expérience avec la gestion de données performante sur les appareils limités (via SQLite ou similaire) Expérience éprouvée de la construction et de la mise à niveau de systèmes distribués ou d'architectures animées par des événements Expérience des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker) et des plates-formes d'orchestration (Kubernetes) Connaissance des bases de données et compréhension approfondie de la modélisation et de l'optimisation des données Connaissance approfondie du réseautage, des principes de sécurité et des meilleures pratiques pour les systèmes de production Expérience de la diffusion des données en temps réel et des implémentations de CPR Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante dans un environnement éloigné et de communiquer efficacement dans les fuseaux horaires Nice to have: Expérience avec les technologies pair-to-peer (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) ou des protocoles de communication distribués similaires Familiarité avec les API d'inférence AI/ML et les terminaux compatibles OpenAI Expérience antérieure construction de plateformes AI SaaS ou PaaS Connaissance de la gestion des ressources GPU et de l'infrastructure cadre ML Compréhension des paradigmes WebAssembly ou de l'informatique de pointe Contributions à des projets open-source dans des domaines pertinents Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries de recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles : Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement à moins d'indication claire. Si vous n'êtes pas sûr, vous pouvez confirmer leur identité en vérifiant leur profil ou en nous contactant via notre site Web. Méfiez-vous des méthodes de communication inhabituelles. Nous ne menons pas d'entrevues sur WhatsApp, Telegram ou SMS. Toute communication se fait au moyen de courriels et de plateformes officiels de l'entreprise. Vérifiez les adresses e-mail. Toute communication de nous viendra de courriels se terminant par @ tether.to ou @ tether.io Nous ne demanderons jamais de paiement ou de détails financiers. Si quelqu'un demande des renseignements financiers personnels ou un paiement à tout moment pendant le processus d'embauche, c'est une escroquerie. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à contacter notre site officiel.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talent, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est votre occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job: You'll work across the JavaScript and TypeScript layer of our local AI stack. Depending on the project, you might build user-facing applications (mobile or desktop) or contribute to the platform layer that bridges our C++ inference engines with the app ecosystem. Whether you're crafting polished product experiences or building the SDKs and bindings that other developers rely on, you'll be helping make local AI truly usable. You’ll be contributing to QVAC, our local AI stack built to bring fast, private AI directly to user devices. This role suits engineers who thrive in a full-stack JS environment and enjoy working close to both product and platform to turn powerful AI capabilities into real-world applications. Responsibilities Own React (Expo/Electron) app development with clean, modular architecture Build UI using modern React stack (TypeScript, RN Navigation, Zustand/Recoil/Jotai) Implement local first / local only apps Integrate mobile apps with distributed systems, local inference, and p2p layers Strong experience with REST/WebSockets, async flows, and secure data storage Ability to build native modules (iOS/Android) when needed (with some help) Good understanding of offline-first systems, caching, and performance Comfortable integrating SDKs (payments, crypto, AI models, etc.) Write reliable code: unit tests, E2E tests (Maestro/Appium/Playwright) Experience with TypeScript across stack (frontend + backend) Bonus: experience with distributed/P2P APIs, on-device ML, cryptography 5+ years of experience in Fullstack development Expert-level proficiency in Node.js/JavaScript for backend development and React frontend framework Experience with performant data handling on constrained devices (via SQLite or similar) Proven experience building and scaling distributed systems or event-driven architectures Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) Proficiency with databases, and a deep understanding of data modeling and optimization Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best practices for production systems Experience with real-time data streaming and RPC implementations Ability to work independently in a remote environment and communicate effectively across time zones Nice to have: Experience with peer-to-peer technologies (Hyperswarm, libp2p, WebRTC) or similar distributed communication protocols Familiarity with AI/ML inference APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints Previous experience building AI SaaS or PaaS platforms Knowledge of GPU resource management and ML framework infrastructure Understanding of WebAssembly or edge computing paradigms Contributions to open-source projects in relevant domains Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common.
