Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o il pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, è una truffa. Si prega di segnalare immediatamente. Quando in dubbio, non esitate a raggiungere il nostro sito ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The Senior Technical Product Manager will be responsible for the overall product leadership of Hadron, including product vision, roadmap definition, and delivery execution. The role serves as the single point of accountability for the platform to serve institutional client needs, engineering delivery, and regulatory/compliance requirements. Unlike a traditional Product Manager role, this position requires clear decision-making authority to: Set and enforce roadmap priorities, including pushing back on non-essential requests. Coordinate with external engineering partners and maintain scope discipline. Resolve conflicts between client requests, technical feasibility, and compliance constraints. Make go/no-go decisions on integrations, product features, and releases. Ensure product development aligns with the long-term architecture and scalability of the Hadron platform. Critical Context Hadron serves institutional clients globally with diverse and often conflicting tokenization requirements, including different asset classes, blockchain networks, compliance frameworks, and distribution models. The Product Manager must manage this complexity by maintaining a clear product strategy, prioritizing ruthlessly, and preventing scope creep. The role requires strong ownership and the ability to make difficult prioritization decisions in a fast-moving institutional environment. Reporting & Collaboration Reports to: VP Product The Product Manager works in close partnership with the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron to ensure strong alignment between institutional client demand, market opportunities, and the Hadron product roadmap. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor provides continuous market feedback based on institutional client engagements and strategic partnerships, ensuring that product development reflects real market demand. The Product Manager is responsible for translating these inputs into product priorities, roadmap decisions, and engineering execution. Major roadmap initiatives, client-driven feature requests, and new integrations are expected to be aligned between the Product Manager and the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor before implementation. The Ideal Candidate We are specifically looking for candidates who have operated at a senior level and can demonstrate deep, hands-on exposure to tokenization and traditional financial infrastructure. You should be able to recognise yourself in most of the following: Tokenization, end-to-end You have personally built, shipped, or owned a tokenization product — from asset onboarding and smart contract specification through to custody integration, investor cap table management, and secondary transfer mechanics. You can walk through the full token lifecycle (issuance, transfer, redemption, corporate actions, burn) without needing to look anything up, and you understand the tradeoffs between different implementation approaches. You understand custody models: the difference between self-custody, qualified custodian models, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures, and what each means for compliance and operational risk. You have practical knowledge of on-chain settlement mechanics and how they interact with traditional T+1/T+2 settlement rails (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT). You are fluent in token standards across multiple chains and understand when to reach for ERC-20, ERC-1400, or proprietary structures, and why. TradFi depth You have a strong grasp of how institutional financial infrastructure works: how funds are structured and administered, how broker-dealers clear and settle, how banks manage trust and custody relationships, and how prime brokerage operates. You understand the instruments being tokenized: money market funds, bonds, structured credit, equities, real estate, commodities including how each is priced, transferred, and serviced in the traditional world. You are comfortable with regulatory frameworks relevant to tokenized assets such as MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA and can identify the compliance constraints that must be encoded into product design. You can read and rapidly interpret institutional documents: RFPs, term sheets, custody agreements, and due diligence questionnaires, and translate them into product requirements without extensive hand-holding. Institutional demand, rapid translation You have worked directly with institutional clients such as asset managers, banks, sovereign funds, family offices as the primary product owner, and you know how to manage their expectations and extract signals from noise. You can hear a new institutional use case or a complex integration requirement and rapidly assess feasibility, scope, and priority, without needing days to research the basics. You have experience distinguishing between requests that reveal genuine product gaps and those that are bespoke client customisations and you know how to handle both without derailing the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap Define and maintain the Hadron product roadmap. Prioritize product initiatives based on market demand, technical feasibility, and business impact. Maintain a clear product vision for Hadron across multiple asset classes and blockchain networks. Ensure long-term platform scalability and product coherence. Product Development & Delivery Translate business and market needs into clear product requirements. Maintain the product backlog and development priorities. Coordinate development cycles and feature releases. Ensure timely delivery of roadmap milestones. Engineering Coordination Act as the primary interface between product and engineering. Coordinate development work with internal engineers and external technology partners. Maintain clear documentation of product features, APIs, and platform capabilities. Track platform performance, bugs, and technical improvements. Client & Integration Feedback Collect and structure feedback from institutional clients and internal teams. Identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into product improvements. Improve onboarding workflows and developer experience. 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with at least 3 years in digital assets, tokenization, or financial infrastructure. Demonstrated hands-on experience shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with accountability for the full token lifecycle. Deep, working knowledge of TradFi capital markets infrastructure including settlement, custody, clearing, fund structures. Proven ability to rapidly parse institutional requirements and translate them into actionable product decisions. Experience managing external engineering partners and enforcing scope discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder programmes. Regulatory literacy across at least two major tokenization frameworks (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, or equivalent). Excellent written and spoken English. Able to author crisp product specs, client-facing documentation, and executive summaries. Nice to have: Prior experience at a bank, asset manager, custodian, or regulated fintech in a product, technology, or markets role. Hands-on experience with multiple token standards and blockchain networks in a production context. Experience designing or integrating with custody APIs, transfer agent systems, or fund administration platforms. Understanding of on-chain compliance mechanisms: whitelisting, transfer restrictions, KYC/AML hooks at the smart contract level. Exposure to multi-chain deployment strategies and the tradeoffs between L1, L2, and permissioned chain environments. Experience with institutional client onboarding workflows in a regulated context. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Tether und Shape the Future of Digital Finance Bei Tether bauen wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Pionier einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen befähigen Unternehmen – von Börsen und Geldbörsen bis zu Zahlungsprozessoren und Geldautomaten –, über Blockchains lückenlos recycelte Token zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Leistung der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Tether, digitale Token sofort, sicher und global zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten zu speichern, zu senden und zu empfangen. Transparenz ist der Grundstein für alles, was wir tun, um Vertrauen in jede Transaktion zu gewährleisten. Innovativ mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produkt-Suite verfügt über die weltweit vertrauenswürdigste Stallmünze, USDT, die von Hunderten von Millionen weltweit, zusammen mit Pionieren der digitalen Asset-Tokenization-Services. Aber das ist nur der Anfang: Tether Power: Mit umweltfreundlichen Praktiken in modernsten, geodiversen Anlagen optimieren unsere Energielösungen überschüssige Leistung für den Bitcoin-Mining. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digitales Lernen, wir befähigen Einzelpersonen, in den digitalen und gig-Wirtschaften zu leben, das globale Wachstum und die Chance zu treiben. Warum bei uns? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von jeder Ecke der Welt entfernt arbeitet. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, blieben schlank und sicherten unseren Platz als Marktführer in der Branche. Wenn Sie hervorragende englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten haben und bereit sind, zur innovativsten Plattform auf dem Planeten beizutragen, ist Tether der Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über den Job Der Senior Technical Product Manager ist verantwortlich für die gesamte Produktführerschaft von Hadron, einschließlich Produktvision, Roadmap Definition und Lieferung Ausführung. Die Rolle dient als einziger Punkt der Rechenschaftspflicht für die Plattform, um institutionelle Kundenbedürfnisse, technische Lieferung und regulatorische/konforme Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Im Gegensatz zu einer traditionellen Produktmanager-Rolle erfordert diese Position eine klare Entscheidungsbefugnis: Festlegung und Durchsetzung von Fahrplanprioritäten, einschließlich Zurückschieben auf nicht wesentlicher Anfragen. Koordinieren Sie mit externen Engineering-Partnern und pflegen Sie die Fachdisziplin. Konflikte zwischen Kundenanfragen, technischer Machbarkeit und Compliance-Zwängen lösen. Machen Sie Entscheidungen über Integrationen, Produktmerkmale und Releases. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Produktentwicklung auf die langfristige Architektur und Skalierbarkeit der Hadron-Plattform ausgerichtet ist. Critical Context Hadron bedient institutionelle Kunden weltweit mit vielfältigen und oft widersprüchlichen Tokenisierungsanforderungen, darunter verschiedene Assetklassen, Blockchain-Netzwerke, Compliance-Rahmen und Distributionsmodelle. Der Product Manager muss diese Komplexität verwalten, indem eine klare Produktstrategie beibehalten wird, rücksichtslos priorisiert und die Reichweitenkriechen verhindert wird. Die Rolle erfordert ein starkes Eigentum und die Fähigkeit, schwierige Priorisierungsentscheidungen in einem schnelllebigen institutionellen Umfeld zu treffen. Berichterstattung und Zusammenarbeit Berichte an: VP Produkt Der Product Manager arbeitet in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron, um eine starke Ausrichtung zwischen institutioneller Kundennachfrage, Marktchancen und der Hadron Produktfahrkarte sicherzustellen. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor bietet kontinuierliche Markt-Feedback basierend auf institutionellen Kundenengagements und strategischen Partnerschaften, um sicherzustellen, dass die Produktentwicklung die reale Marktnachfrage widerspiegelt. Der Product Manager ist verantwortlich für die Übersetzung dieser Inputs in Produktprioritäten, Roadmap-Entscheidungen und technische Ausführung. Wichtige Roadmap-Initiativen, kundengesteuerte Feature-Anfragen und neue Integrationen sollen vor der Implementierung zwischen dem Product Manager und dem Head of Expansion & Product Advisor ausgerichtet werden. Der ideale Termin Wir sind speziell auf der Suche nach Kandidaten, die auf einem höheren Niveau betrieben haben und können tiefe, praktische Exposition gegenüber der Tokenisierung und traditionellen Finanzinfrastruktur demonstrieren. Sie sollten in der Lage sein, sich in den meisten der folgenden zu erkennen: Tokenization, end-to-end Sie haben persönlich ein Tokenization-Produkt gebaut, versendet oder besaßen – von Asset Onboarding und Smart Contract Spezifikation bis hin zu Inhaftierung Integration, Investor Cap Table Management und Sekundär Transfer Mechanik. Sie können durch den vollen Token-Lebenszyklus (Auftrag, Transfer, Erlösung, Corporate Actions, Verbrennung) gehen, ohne etwas nach oben zu suchen, und Sie verstehen die Kompromisse zwischen verschiedenen Implementierungsansätzen. Sie verstehen Gewahrsamsmodelle: der Unterschied zwischen Selbst-Krankheit, qualifizierten Gewahrsamsmodellen, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures und was jede für Compliance und operationelles Risiko bedeutet. Sie haben praktische Kenntnisse über die On-Ketten-Besiedlungsmechanik und wie sie mit traditionellen T+1/T+2-Besiedlungsschienen (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT) interagieren. Sie sind fließend in Token-Standards über mehrere Ketten und verstehen, wann man für ERC-20, ERC-1400 oder proprietäre Strukturen zu erreichen, und warum. TranFi Tiefe Sie haben ein starkes Verständnis dafür, wie die institutionelle Finanzinfrastruktur funktioniert: wie Fonds strukturiert und verwaltet werden, wie Broker-Dealer klar und begleichen, wie Banken Vertrauens- und Sorgebeziehungen verwalten und wie Prime Brokerage funktioniert. Sie verstehen die Instrumente, die tokenisiert werden: Geldmarktfonds, Anleihen, strukturierte Kredite, Aktien, Immobilien, Waren einschließlich der Preise, übertragen und in der traditionellen Welt. Sie sind mit regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen, die für tokenisierte Aktiva relevant sind, wie MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS-Anmerkung, VARA und können die Compliance-Zwänge identifizieren, die in Produktdesign kodiert werden müssen. Sie können institutionelle Dokumente lesen und schnell interpretieren: RFPs, Termine, Haftpflichtvereinbarungen und Due Diligence-Fragebogen und übersetzen sie in Produktanforderungen ohne umfangreiche Handhaltung. Institutionelle Nachfrage, schnelle Übersetzung Sie haben direkt mit institutionellen Kunden wie Asset Managern, Banken, Souveränen Geldern, Familienbüros als primären Produktbesitzer gearbeitet, und Sie wissen, wie Sie ihre Erwartungen zu verwalten und Signale aus Lärm zu extrahieren. Sie können einen neuen institutionellen Anwendungsfall oder eine komplexe Integrationsvoraussetzung hören und die Machbarkeit, den Umfang und die Priorität schnell beurteilen, ohne dass Tage zur Erforschung der Grundlagen benötigt werden. Sie haben Erfahrung, zwischen Anträgen zu unterscheiden, die echte Produktlücken und diejenigen, die maßgeschneiderte Kunden Anpassungen sind, und Sie wissen, wie man beide ohne die Roadmap zu verlassen. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten Produktstrategie & Roadmap Definieren und pflegen Sie die Hadron Produkt Roadmap. Vorrangige Produktinitiativen auf der Grundlage der Marktnachfrage, der technischen Machbarkeit und der geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Bewahren Sie eine klare Produktvision für Hadron über mehrere Assetklassen und Blockchain-Netzwerke. Gewährleistung einer langfristigen Plattformskalierbarkeit und Produktkohärenz. Produktentwicklung & Lieferung übersetzen Geschäfts- und Marktbedürfnisse in klare Produktanforderungen. Bewahren Sie die Produkt-Backlog- und Entwicklungsprioritäten auf. Koordinierte Entwicklungszyklen und Feature Releases. Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Lieferung von Roadmap-Meilen. Technische Koordination Aktivieren Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt und Engineering. Koordinierte Entwicklungsarbeit mit internen Ingenieuren und externen Technologiepartnern. Erhalten Sie klare Dokumentation der Produktfunktionen, APIs und Plattformfunktionen. Verfolgen Sie die Plattformleistung, Bugs und technische Verbesserungen. Client & Integration Feedback Sammeln und Struktur Feedback von institutionellen Kunden und internen Teams. Erkennen Sie wiederkehrende Integrationsherausforderungen und übersetzen sie in Produktverbesserungen. Verbesserung der Workflows und Entwicklererfahrung. 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Produktbesitz, mit mindestens 3 Jahren in digitalen Vermögenswerten, Tokenisierung oder Finanzinfrastruktur. Demonstrated Hand-on-Erfahrung Versand einer Tokenisierung oder RWA-Produkt, mit Rechenschaft für den vollen Token-Lebenszyklus. Tiefe, Arbeitswissen über die Infrastruktur der TradFi-Kapitalmärkte einschließlich Siedlung, Sorge, Clearing, Fondsstrukturen. Bewiesene Fähigkeit, die institutionellen Anforderungen rasch zu parsieren und sie in handlungsfähige Produktentscheidungen zu übersetzen. Erleben Sie die Verwaltung externer Engineering-Partner und forcieren Sie die Fachdisziplin über komplexe Multistakeholder-Programme. Regelmäßige Alphabetisierung in mindestens zwei großen Tokenisierungs-Frames (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA oder gleichwertig). Ausgezeichnet geschrieben und gesprochen Englisch. Erlauben Sie, Produktspezifikationen, Dokumentationen und Zusammenfassungen der Kunden zu dokumentieren. Nice to have: Vorherige Erfahrungen bei einer Bank, einem Asset Manager, einem Verwahrer oder regulierten Fintech in einer Produkt-, Technologie- oder Marktrolle. Hands-on Erfahrung mit mehreren Token Standards und Blockchain-Netzwerken in einem Produktionskontext. Erleben Sie die Gestaltung oder Integration mit Haft-APIs, Transfer-Agent-Systemen oder Fonds-Administration-Plattformen. Verstehen von on-chain-Compliance-Mechanismen: Whitelisting, Transfer-Restriktionen, KYC/AML Haken auf Smart Contract-Ebene. Exposition gegenüber Multi-Ketten-Bereitstellungsstrategien und den Kompromissen zwischen L1, L2 und zugelassenen Kettenumgebungen. Erfahrung mit institutionellen Client onboarding Workflows in einem geregelten Kontext. Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten Recruitment Betrug sind immer häufiger geworden. Um sich zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte folgendes bei der Beantragung von Rollen: Bewerben Sie sich nur über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir verwenden keine Plattformen oder Agenturen von Drittanbietern zur Rekrutierung, sofern nicht klar angegeben. Alle offenen Rollen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Rekrutierers. Alle unsere Rekruten haben LinkedIn-Profile überprüft. Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, können Sie Ihre Identität bestätigen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren. Seien Sie vorsichtig mit ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Alle Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle Firmen-E-Mails und Plattformen. Doppel-Check-E-Mail Adressen. Alle Kommunikation von uns wird von E-Mails kommen, die in @ tether enden. oder @ tether.io Wir werden keine Zahlungs- oder Finanzdaten verlangen. Wenn jemand während des Einstellungsprozesses persönliche Finanzinformationen oder Zahlung an jedem Punkt verlangt, ist es ein Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es sofort. Wenn im Zweifel, fühlen Sie sich frei, durch unsere offizielle Website zu erreichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance Chez Tether, nous ne sommes pas seulement des produits de construction, nous sommes pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises, depuis les échanges et les portefeuilles jusqu'aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques de billets, d'intégrer de façon transparente les jetons à l'aide de réserves dans toutes les chaînes de blocs. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et globalement, le tout à une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, assurant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance: Notre suite de produits innovants dispose de la plus fiable écurie du monde, USDT , sur laquelle s'appuient des centaines de millions de monde, ainsi que des services de tokenisation d'actifs numériques pionniers. Mais ce n'est que le début : Tether Power : Pour une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l'excès de puissance pour l'exploitation minière Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques écologiques dans des installations géo-diverses à la fine pointe de la technologie. Tether Data: En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie pair à pair, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET , notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : Démocratiser l'accès à l'apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous autonomisons les individus à prospérer dans les économies numériques et de concerts, moteur de la croissance mondiale et des opportunités. L'évolution de l'approche : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, écrivant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une puissance mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance de tous les coins du monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la marque dans l'espace fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les frontières et de fixer de nouvelles normes. Nous avons grandi rapidement, sommes restés maigres et nous avons obtenu notre place de leader dans l'industrie. Si vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication anglaise et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est l'endroit pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du travail Le gestionnaire principal des produits techniques sera responsable de la direction générale des produits de Hadron, y compris la vision des produits, la définition de la feuille de route et l'exécution de la livraison. Ce rôle sert de point de responsabilisation unique pour la plate-forme afin de répondre aux besoins des clients institutionnels, à la prestation de services techniques et aux exigences en matière de réglementation et de conformité. Contrairement à un rôle traditionnel de gestionnaire de produits, ce poste exige un pouvoir décisionnel clair pour : établir et faire respecter les priorités de la feuille de route, y compris repousser les demandes non essentielles. Coordonner avec des partenaires d'ingénierie externes et maintenir la discipline de portée. Résoudre les conflits entre les demandes des clients, la faisabilité technique et les contraintes de conformité. Prendre des décisions sur les intégrations, les caractéristiques des produits et les rejets. Veiller à ce que le développement des produits s'harmonise avec l'architecture à long terme et l'évolutivité de la plateforme Hadron. Contexte critique Hadron sert les clients institutionnels à l'échelle mondiale avec des exigences de tokenisation diverses et souvent contradictoires, y compris différentes classes d'actifs, réseaux de blockchain, cadres de conformité et modèles de distribution. Le gestionnaire de produits doit gérer cette complexité en maintenant une stratégie de produit claire, en priorisant impitoyablement et en prévenant le fluage de la portée. Ce rôle exige une forte prise en charge et la capacité de prendre des décisions difficiles en matière de hiérarchisation dans un environnement institutionnel en évolution rapide. Rapports et collaboration Rapports à : VP Product Le gestionnaire de produits travaille en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'expansion et conseiller en produits pour Hadron afin d'assurer une forte harmonisation entre la demande des clients institutionnels, les débouchés commerciaux et la feuille de route pour les produits Hadron. Chef, Expansion & Product Advisor fournit une rétroaction continue sur le marché fondée sur les engagements des clients institutionnels et les partenariats stratégiques, en veillant à ce que le développement des produits reflète la demande réelle du marché. Le gestionnaire des produits est chargé de traduire ces intrants en priorités de produits, en décisions de feuille de route et en exécution technique. Les principales initiatives de feuille de route, les demandes de fonctionnalités axées sur les clients et les nouvelles intégrations devraient être alignées entre le gestionnaire de produits et le chef de l'Expansion et conseiller produit avant la mise en oeuvre. Le candidat idéal Nous cherchons particulièrement des candidats qui ont travaillé à un niveau supérieur et peuvent démontrer une exposition profonde et pratique à la tokenisation et à l'infrastructure financière traditionnelle. Vous devriez être en mesure de vous reconnaître dans la plupart des suivants: Tokenisation, bout à bout Vous avez personnellement construit, expédié ou possédé un produit de tokenization — de l'actif à l'embarquement et aux spécifications de contrat intelligentes jusqu'à l'intégration de la garde, la gestion de table de plafonnement des investisseurs et la mécanique de transfert secondaire. Vous pouvez parcourir le cycle de vie complet (émission, transfert, rédemption, actions d'entreprise, brûlure) sans avoir besoin de chercher quoi que ce soit, et vous comprenez les compromis entre différentes approches de mise en œuvre. Vous comprenez les modèles de garde : la différence entre l'auto-garde, les modèles de gardien qualifié, les structures omnibus vs. portefeuille séparé, et ce que chaque signifie pour la conformité et le risque opérationnel. Vous avez une connaissance pratique de la mécanique de règlement sur la chaîne et de la façon dont ils interagissent avec les rails traditionnels de règlement T+1/T+2 (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT). Vous maîtrisez couramment les normes de jeton à travers plusieurs chaînes et comprenez quand atteindre pour ERC-20, ERC-1400, ou les structures propriétaires, et pourquoi. Profondeur TradFi Vous avez une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement de l'infrastructure financière institutionnelle : la façon dont les fonds sont structurés et administrés, la façon dont les courtiers-négociants sont clairs et réglés, la façon dont les banques gèrent les relations de fiducie et de garde, et le fonctionnement du courtage principal. Vous comprenez les instruments qui sont tokenisés : les fonds du marché monétaire, les obligations, le crédit structuré, les actions, l'immobilier, les marchandises, y compris la façon dont chacun est évalué, transféré et servi dans le monde traditionnel. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les cadres réglementaires pertinents aux actifs tokenisés tels que MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS avis, VARA et pouvez identifier les contraintes de conformité qui doivent être codées dans la conception du produit. Vous pouvez lire et interpréter rapidement les documents institutionnels : les DP, les feuilles de termes, les ententes de garde et les questionnaires de diligence raisonnable, et les traduire en exigences de produit sans tenir compte de la main. Demande institutionnelle, traduction rapide Vous avez travaillé directement avec des clients institutionnels tels que les gestionnaires d'actifs, les banques, les fonds souverains, les bureaux familiaux en tant que principal propriétaire de produit, et vous savez comment gérer leurs attentes et extraire des signaux du bruit. Vous pouvez entendre un nouveau cas d'utilisation institutionnelle ou une exigence d'intégration complexe et évaluer rapidement la faisabilité, la portée et la priorité, sans avoir besoin de jours pour étudier les bases. Vous avez l'expérience de distinguer entre les demandes qui révèlent de véritables lacunes de produits et celles qui sont sur mesure personnalisations client et vous savez comment gérer les deux sans dérailler la feuille de route. Principales responsabilités Stratégie et feuille de route des produits Définir et maintenir la feuille de route des produits Hadron. Privilégier les initiatives de produits en fonction de la demande du marché, de la faisabilité technique et de l'impact sur les entreprises. Maintenir une vision de produit claire pour Hadron sur plusieurs classes d'actifs et réseaux de blockchain. Assurer l'évolutivité à long terme de la plateforme et la cohérence des produits. Développement et livraison des produits Traduire les besoins des entreprises et du marché en exigences de produit claires. Maintenir l'arriéré de produits et les priorités de développement. Coordonner les cycles de développement et les versions des fonctionnalités. Veiller à ce que les jalons de la feuille de route soient atteints en temps opportun. La loi sur la coordination de l'ingénierie est la principale interface entre le produit et l'ingénierie. Coordonner le travail de développement avec les ingénieurs internes et les partenaires technologiques externes. Maintenir une documentation claire des caractéristiques des produits, des API et des capacités de la plate-forme. Suivez les performances de la plateforme, les bogues et les améliorations techniques. Commentaires des clients et de l'intégration Recueillir et structurer les commentaires des clients institutionnels et des équipes internes. Identifier les défis récurrents d'intégration et les traduire en améliorations de produits. Améliorer les flux de travail et l'expérience du développeur. 5+ ans d'expérience en gestion de produits ou en propriété de produits, avec au moins 3 ans en actifs numériques, en tokenisation ou en infrastructure financière. Expérience pratique démontrée shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with responsability for the full token lifecycle. Connaissance approfondie et pratique de l'infrastructure des marchés de capitaux TradFi, y compris le règlement, la garde, la compensation et les structures de fonds. Capacité éprouvée d'analyser rapidement les exigences institutionnelles et de les traduire en décisions de produits réalisables. Expérience de la gestion de partenaires extérieurs du génie et de l'application de la discipline de portée dans le cadre de programmes complexes et multipartites. Connaissance de la réglementation dans au moins deux grands cadres de tokenisation (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, ou l'équivalent). Excellent anglais écrit et parlé. Capable d'écrire des spécifications de produits croustillants, de la documentation destinée aux clients et des résumés exécutifs. Bon d'avoir: Expérience antérieure dans une banque, gestionnaire d'actifs, gardien ou fintech réglementée dans un rôle de produit, de technologie ou de marché. Expérience pratique avec plusieurs standards de jetons et réseaux de blockchain dans un contexte de production. Expérience de conception ou d'intégration avec des API de garde, des systèmes d'agents de transfert ou des plateformes d'administration de fonds. Compréhension des mécanismes de conformité sur la chaîne : liste blanche, restrictions de transfert, crochets KYC/AML au niveau du contrat intelligent. Exposition aux stratégies de déploiement multichaînes et aux compromis entre L1, L2 et les environnements de chaîne autorisés. Expérience des flux de travail des clients institutionnels dans un contexte réglementé. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder à l'esprit ce qui suit au moment de postuler pour des rôles : Appliquer uniquement par nos canaux officiels. Nous n'utilisons pas de plates-formes ou d'agences tierces pour le recrutement à moins d'indication claire. Tous les rôles ouverts sont énumérés sur notre page officielle des carrières : https://tether.recruitee.com/ Vérifiez l'identité du recruteur. Tous nos recruteurs ont vérifié les profils LinkedIn. descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a Tether e dai forma al futuro della finanza digitale In Tether non stiamo solo costruendo prodotti, siamo pionieri di una rivoluzione finanziaria globale. Le nostre soluzioni all'avanguardia consentono alle aziende, dagli scambi e portafogli ai processori di pagamento e agli sportelli bancomat, di integrare perfettamente token garantiti da riserve attraverso blockchain. Sfruttando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether ti consente di archiviare, inviare e ricevere token digitali in modo istantaneo, sicuro e globale, il tutto a una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è il fondamento di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innova con Tether Tether Finance: la nostra suite di prodotti innovativa comprende la stablecoin più affidabile al mondo, USDT, su cui fanno affidamento centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme a servizi pionieristici di tokenizzazione delle risorse digitali. Ma questo è solo l’inizio: Tether Power: guidando la crescita sostenibile, le nostre soluzioni energetiche ottimizzano l’energia in eccesso per l’estrazione di Bitcoin utilizzando pratiche ecocompatibili in strutture all’avanguardia e geodiversificate. Tether Data: alimentando innovazioni nell'intelligenza artificiale e nella tecnologia peer-to-peer, riduciamo i costi dell'infrastruttura e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET, la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione sicura e privata dei dati. Tether Education: democratizzando l’accesso all’apprendimento digitale di alto livello, consentiamo alle persone di prosperare nelle economie digitali e gig economy, guidando la crescita e le opportunità globali. Tether Evolution: all'intersezione tra tecnologia e potenziale umano, stiamo spingendo i confini di ciò che è possibile, creando un futuro in cui innovazione e capacità umane si fondono in modi potenti e senza precedenti. Perché unirsi a noi? Il nostro team è una potenza globale di talenti, che lavora in remoto da ogni angolo del mondo. Se la tua passione è lasciare il segno nel settore fintech, questa è la tua occasione per collaborare con alcune delle menti più brillanti, spingendo oltre i confini e stabilendo nuovi standard. Siamo cresciuti rapidamente, siamo rimasti snelli e ci siamo assicurati il ​​posto di leader nel settore. Se hai eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e sei pronto a contribuire alla piattaforma più innovativa del pianeta, Tether è il posto che fa per te. Sei pronto a far parte del futuro? Informazioni sul lavoro Il Senior Technical Product Manager sarà responsabile della leadership complessiva del prodotto Hadron, inclusa la visione del prodotto, la definizione della roadmap e l'esecuzione della consegna. Il ruolo funge da unico punto di responsabilità per la piattaforma per soddisfare le esigenze dei clienti istituzionali, la fornitura di ingegneria e i requisiti normativi/di conformità. A differenza del tradizionale ruolo di Product Manager, questa posizione richiede una chiara autorità decisionale per: Stabilire e far rispettare le priorità della roadmap, incluso respingere le richieste non essenziali. Coordinarsi con partner tecnici esterni e mantenere la disciplina dell'ambito. Risolvere i conflitti tra richieste del cliente, fattibilità tecnica e vincoli di conformità. Prendi decisioni positive o negative su integrazioni, funzionalità del prodotto e rilasci. Garantire che lo sviluppo del prodotto sia in linea con l'architettura e la scalabilità a lungo termine della piattaforma Hadron. Contesto critico Hadron serve clienti istituzionali a livello globale con requisiti di tokenizzazione diversi e spesso contrastanti, tra cui diverse classi di asset, reti blockchain, quadri di conformità e modelli di distribuzione. Il Product Manager deve gestire questa complessità mantenendo una chiara strategia di prodotto, definendo spietatamente le priorità e prevenendo lo spostamento dell'ambito. Il ruolo richiede una forte titolarità e la capacità di prendere difficili decisioni sulla definizione delle priorità in un ambiente istituzionale in rapida evoluzione. Reporting e collaborazione Riporta a: VP Prodotto Il Product Manager lavora in stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'espansione e del consulente di prodotto per Hadron per garantire un forte allineamento tra la domanda dei clienti istituzionali, le opportunità di mercato e la roadmap del prodotto Hadron. Il responsabile dell'espansione e del consulente del prodotto fornisce un feedback continuo sul mercato basato sugli impegni di clienti istituzionali e sulle partnership strategiche, garantendo che lo sviluppo del prodotto rifletta la reale domanda del mercato. Il Product Manager è responsabile della traduzione di questi input in priorità di prodotto, decisioni sulla roadmap ed esecuzione della progettazione. Si prevede che le principali iniziative della roadmap, le richieste di funzionalità guidate dal cliente e le nuove integrazioni vengano allineate tra il Product Manager e il responsabile dell'espansione e del consulente del prodotto prima dell'implementazione. Il candidato ideale Cerchiamo specificamente candidati che abbiano operato a livello senior e possano dimostrare un'esposizione pratica e approfondita alla tokenizzazione e alle infrastrutture finanziarie tradizionali. Dovresti essere in grado di riconoscerti nella maggior parte dei seguenti aspetti: Tokenizzazione, end-to-end Hai creato, spedito o posseduto personalmente un prodotto di tokenizzazione: dall'onboarding delle risorse e dalla specifica del contratto intelligente fino all'integrazione della custodia, alla gestione della tabella dei limiti degli investitori e ai meccanismi di trasferimento secondari. Puoi percorrere l'intero ciclo di vita del token (emissione, trasferimento, riscatto, azioni societarie, masterizzazione) senza dover cercare nulla e comprendi i compromessi tra i diversi approcci di implementazione. Comprendi i modelli di custodia: la differenza tra autocustodia, modelli di custodia qualificata, omnibus vs. strutture di portafoglio segregate e cosa significa ciascuna di esse per la conformità e il rischio operativo. Hai una conoscenza pratica dei meccanismi di regolamento on-chain e di come interagiscono con i tradizionali binari di regolamento T+1/T+2 (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT). Hai familiarità con gli standard dei token su più catene e capisci quando raggiungere ERC-20, ERC-1400 o strutture proprietarie e perché. Profondità TradFi Hai una conoscenza approfondita di come funziona l'infrastruttura finanziaria istituzionale: come i fondi sono strutturati e amministrati, come i broker-dealer liquidano e regolano, come le banche gestiscono i rapporti fiduciari e di custodia e come opera il prime brokerage. Comprendi gli strumenti che vengono tokenizzati: fondi del mercato monetario, obbligazioni, credito strutturato, azioni, immobili, materie prime, compreso il modo in cui ciascuno viene prezzato, trasferito e servito nel mondo tradizionale. Hai dimestichezza con i quadri normativi relativi alle risorse tokenizzate come MiCA, Reg D/S, avviso MAS MAS, VARA e sei in grado di identificare i vincoli di conformità che devono essere codificati nella progettazione del prodotto. Puoi leggere e interpretare rapidamente documenti istituzionali: RFP, term sheet, accordi di custodia e questionari di due diligence e tradurli in requisiti di prodotto senza lunghe manovre. Domanda istituzionale, traduzione rapida Hai lavorato direttamente con clienti istituzionali come gestori patrimoniali, banche, fondi sovrani, family office come primario proprietario del prodotto, e sai come gestire le loro aspettative ed estrarre segnali dal rumore. Puoi ascoltare un nuovo caso d'uso istituzionale o un requisito di integrazione complesso e valutare rapidamente fattibilità, portata e priorità, senza bisogno di giorni per ricercare le nozioni di base. Hai esperienza nel distinguere tra richieste che rivelano autentiche lacune del prodotto e quelle che sono personalizzazioni su misura del cliente e sai come gestire entrambe senza deragliare la tabella di marcia. Responsabilità chiave Strategia di prodotto e roadmap Definire e mantenere la roadmap del prodotto Hadron. Assegnare priorità alle iniziative di prodotto in base alla domanda del mercato, alla fattibilità tecnica e all'impatto aziendale. Mantieni una chiara visione del prodotto per Hadron su più classi di asset e reti blockchain. Garantire la scalabilità della piattaforma e la coerenza del prodotto a lungo termine. Sviluppo e consegna del prodotto Traduci le esigenze aziendali e del mercato in chiari requisiti di prodotto. Mantenere il backlog del prodotto e le priorità di sviluppo. Coordinare i cicli di sviluppo e i rilasci delle funzionalità. Garantire la consegna tempestiva delle tappe fondamentali della roadmap. Coordinamento ingegneristico Agire come interfaccia principale tra prodotto e ingegneria. Coordinare il lavoro di sviluppo con ingegneri interni e partner tecnologici esterni. Mantieni una documentazione chiara delle funzionalità del prodotto, delle API e delle funzionalità della piattaforma. Tieni traccia delle prestazioni della piattaforma, dei bug e dei miglioramenti tecnici. Feedback sui clienti e sull'integrazione Raccogliere e strutturare il feedback dei clienti istituzionali e dei team interni. Identificare le sfide ricorrenti dell'integrazione e tradurle in miglioramenti del prodotto. Migliora i flussi di lavoro di onboarding e l'esperienza degli sviluppatori. Oltre 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione o nella proprietà del prodotto, con almeno 3 anni in risorse digitali, tokenizzazione o infrastruttura finanziaria. Esperienza pratica dimostrata nella spedizione di un prodotto di tokenizzazione o RWA, con responsabilità per l'intero ciclo di vita del token. Conoscenza approfondita e operativa dell'infrastruttura dei mercati dei capitali TradFi, inclusi regolamento, custodia, compensazione e strutture dei fondi. Comprovata capacità di analizzare rapidamente i requisiti istituzionali e di tradurli in decisioni di prodotto attuabili. Esperienza nella gestione di partner tecnici esterni e nell'applicazione della disciplina dell'ambito in programmi complessi e multi-stakeholder. Competenza normativa in almeno due principali framework di tokenizzazione (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA o equivalente). Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato. In grado di creare specifiche di prodotto nitide, documentazione rivolta al cliente e riepiloghi esecutivi. Bello da avere: esperienza precedente presso una banca, un gestore patrimoniale, un custode o una fintech regolamentata in un ruolo di prodotto, tecnologia o mercato. Esperienza pratica con più standard di token e reti blockchain in un contesto di produzione. Esperienza nella progettazione o integrazione con API di custodia, sistemi di agenti di trasferimento o piattaforme di amministrazione di fondi. Comprensione dei meccanismi di conformità on-chain: whitelist, restrizioni al trasferimento, hook KYC/AML a livello di contratto intelligente. Esposizione a strategie di distribuzione multicatena e compromessi tra ambienti L1, L2 e catene autorizzate. Esperienza con flussi di lavoro di onboarding di clienti istituzionali in un contesto regolamentato. Informazioni importanti per i candidati Le truffe nel reclutamento sono diventate sempre più comuni. Per proteggerti, tieni presente quanto segue quando fai domanda per un ruolo: fai domanda solo attraverso i nostri canali ufficiali. Non utilizziamo piattaforme o agenzie di terze parti per il reclutamento se non chiaramente indicato. Tutti i ruoli aperti sono elencati nella nostra pagina ufficiale delle carriere: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verifica l'identità del reclutatore. Tutti i nostri reclutatori hanno profili LinkedIn verificati. Se non sei sicuro, puoi confermare la loro identità controllando il loro profilo o contattandoci tramite il nostro sito web. Fai attenzione ai metodi di comunicazione insoliti. Non conduciamo interviste tramite WhatsApp, Telegram o SMS. Tutte le comunicazioni avvengono tramite e-mail e piattaforme ufficiali dell'azienda. Ricontrolla gli indirizzi email. Tutte le nostre comunicazioni arriveranno da e-mail che terminano con @ tether.to o @ tether.io Non richiederemo mai pagamenti o dettagli finanziari. Se qualcuno chiede informazioni finanziarie personali o un pagamento in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di assunzione, si tratta di una truffa. Per favore segnalatelo immediatamente. In caso di dubbi, non esitate a contattarci tramite il nostro sito Web ufficiale.
descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The Senior Technical Product Manager will be responsible for the overall product leadership of Hadron, including product vision, roadmap definition, and delivery execution. The role serves as the single point of accountability for the platform to serve institutional client needs, engineering delivery, and regulatory/compliance requirements. Unlike a traditional Product Manager role, this position requires clear decision-making authority to: Set and enforce roadmap priorities, including pushing back on non-essential requests. Coordinate with external engineering partners and maintain scope discipline. Resolve conflicts between client requests, technical feasibility, and compliance constraints. Make go/no-go decisions on integrations, product features, and releases. Ensure product development aligns with the long-term architecture and scalability of the Hadron platform. Critical Context Hadron serves institutional clients globally with diverse and often conflicting tokenization requirements, including different asset classes, blockchain networks, compliance frameworks, and distribution models. The Product Manager must manage this complexity by maintaining a clear product strategy, prioritizing ruthlessly, and preventing scope creep. The role requires strong ownership and the ability to make difficult prioritization decisions in a fast-moving institutional environment. Reporting & Collaboration Reports to: VP Product The Product Manager works in close partnership with the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor for Hadron to ensure strong alignment between institutional client demand, market opportunities, and the Hadron product roadmap. Head of Expansion & Product Advisor provides continuous market feedback based on institutional client engagements and strategic partnerships, ensuring that product development reflects real market demand. The Product Manager is responsible for translating these inputs into product priorities, roadmap decisions, and engineering execution. Major roadmap initiatives, client-driven feature requests, and new integrations are expected to be aligned between the Product Manager and the Head of Expansion & Product Advisor before implementation. The Ideal Candidate We are specifically looking for candidates who have operated at a senior level and can demonstrate deep, hands-on exposure to tokenization and traditional financial infrastructure. You should be able to recognise yourself in most of the following: Tokenization, end-to-end You have personally built, shipped, or owned a tokenization product — from asset onboarding and smart contract specification through to custody integration, investor cap table management, and secondary transfer mechanics. You can walk through the full token lifecycle (issuance, transfer, redemption, corporate actions, burn) without needing to look anything up, and you understand the tradeoffs between different implementation approaches. You understand custody models: the difference between self-custody, qualified custodian models, omnibus vs. segregated wallet structures, and what each means for compliance and operational risk. You have practical knowledge of on-chain settlement mechanics and how they interact with traditional T+1/T+2 settlement rails (DTCC, Euroclear, SWIFT). You are fluent in token standards across multiple chains and understand when to reach for ERC-20, ERC-1400, or proprietary structures, and why. TradFi depth You have a strong grasp of how institutional financial infrastructure works: how funds are structured and administered, how broker-dealers clear and settle, how banks manage trust and custody relationships, and how prime brokerage operates. You understand the instruments being tokenized: money market funds, bonds, structured credit, equities, real estate, commodities including how each is priced, transferred, and serviced in the traditional world. You are comfortable with regulatory frameworks relevant to tokenized assets such as MiCA, Reg D/S, MAS MAS notice, VARA and can identify the compliance constraints that must be encoded into product design. You can read and rapidly interpret institutional documents: RFPs, term sheets, custody agreements, and due diligence questionnaires, and translate them into product requirements without extensive hand-holding. Institutional demand, rapid translation You have worked directly with institutional clients such as asset managers, banks, sovereign funds, family offices as the primary product owner, and you know how to manage their expectations and extract signals from noise. You can hear a new institutional use case or a complex integration requirement and rapidly assess feasibility, scope, and priority, without needing days to research the basics. You have experience distinguishing between requests that reveal genuine product gaps and those that are bespoke client customisations and you know how to handle both without derailing the roadmap. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap Define and maintain the Hadron product roadmap. Prioritize product initiatives based on market demand, technical feasibility, and business impact. Maintain a clear product vision for Hadron across multiple asset classes and blockchain networks. Ensure long-term platform scalability and product coherence. Product Development & Delivery Translate business and market needs into clear product requirements. Maintain the product backlog and development priorities. Coordinate development cycles and feature releases. Ensure timely delivery of roadmap milestones. Engineering Coordination Act as the primary interface between product and engineering. Coordinate development work with internal engineers and external technology partners. Maintain clear documentation of product features, APIs, and platform capabilities. Track platform performance, bugs, and technical improvements. Client & Integration Feedback Collect and structure feedback from institutional clients and internal teams. Identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into product improvements. Improve onboarding workflows and developer experience. 5+ years of experience in product management or product ownership, with at least 3 years in digital assets, tokenization, or financial infrastructure. Demonstrated hands-on experience shipping a tokenization or RWA product, with accountability for the full token lifecycle. Deep, working knowledge of TradFi capital markets infrastructure including settlement, custody, clearing, fund structures. Proven ability to rapidly parse institutional requirements and translate them into actionable product decisions. Experience managing external engineering partners and enforcing scope discipline across complex, multi-stakeholder programmes. Regulatory literacy across at least two major tokenization frameworks (MiCA, MAS, SEC, VARA, or equivalent). Excellent written and spoken English. Able to author crisp product specs, client-facing documentation, and executive summaries. Nice to have: Prior experience at a bank, asset manager, custodian, or regulated fintech in a product, technology, or markets role. Hands-on experience with multiple token standards and blockchain networks in a production context. Experience designing or integrating with custody APIs, transfer agent systems, or fund administration platforms. Understanding of on-chain compliance mechanisms: whitelisting, transfer restrictions, KYC/AML hooks at the smart contract level. Exposure to multi-chain deployment strategies and the tradeoffs between L1, L2, and permissioned chain environments. Experience with institutional client onboarding workflows in a regulated context. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles.
