Innovation mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite umfasst den vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin der Welt, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte Millionen Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen, sowie bahnbrechende Dienste zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssigen Strom für das Bitcoin-Mining durch umweltfreundliche Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch vielfältigen Anlagen. Tether Data: Wir treiben Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie voran, senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen ermöglichen wir Einzelpersonen, in der Digital- und Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von überall auf der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn es Ihnen am Herzen liegt, sich im Fintech-Bereich einen Namen zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Branchenführer gesichert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, einen Beitrag zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt zu leisten, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über die Stelle: Wir suchen einen Social-Media-Manager mit umfassender Erfahrung in der Förderung von KI-Produkten und -Technologien, insbesondere in aufstrebenden Sektoren wie dezentraler KI, Infrastruktur-KI und Entwicklertools. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Positionierung von QVAC AI als kategoriedefinierende Plattform im dezentralen KI-Bereich. Sie übersetzen komplexe KI- und Infrastrukturkonzepte in überzeugende Erzählungen für Entwickler und Endbenutzer. Der ideale Kandidat verfügt über praktische Erfahrung in der Vermarktung von KI-gesteuerten Produkten, versteht die KI-Terminologie und Ökosystemdynamik und weiß, wie man bei technischen Zielgruppen Glaubwürdigkeit aufbaut. Verantwortlichkeiten: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Social-Media-Strategie mit Schwerpunkt auf dem QVAC-KI-Ökosystem für die Entwickler-Community und ein breiteres Publikum. Übersetzen Sie komplexe KI-Konzepte und technische Dokumentation in klare, ansprechende Inhalte. Führen Sie Go-to-Market-Kampagnen, wandeln Sie Produktaktualisierungen und Änderungsprotokolle in klare Inhalte für Entwickler und ein breiteres Publikum um. Arbeiten Sie eng mit KI-Ingenieuren und Produktteams zusammen, um Inhalte auf sozialen Kanälen zu erstellen und zu teilen. Verfolgen Sie Leistungskennzahlen und optimieren Sie Inhalte auf der Grundlage von Datenerkenntnissen. Drei bis sechs oder mehr Jahre Erfahrung in sozialen Medien oder Wachstumsmarketing. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Förderung von KI-Produkten, KI Infrastruktur, SaaS-KI-Tools oder entwicklerorientierte Technologie. Starkes Verständnis von KI- und maschinellen Lernkonzepten, großen Sprachmodell-Ökosystemen, KI-Infrastrukturtrends und idealerweise dezentraler oder Open-Source-KI. Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit technischem Publikum, einschließlich Entwicklern, Forschern und Ingenieuren. Ausgezeichnete englische Schreibfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen zu vereinfachen, ohne an Tiefe zu verlieren. Bequeme Zusammenarbeit mit hochtechnischen Teams. Starke analytische Denkweise mit datengesteuerter Inhaltsoptimierung. Selbststarter mit Erfahrung in der Arbeit aus der Ferne über Zeitzonen hinweg. Wichtige Informationen für Kandidaten. Rekrutierungsbetrug kommt immer häufiger vor. Um sich selbst zu schützen, beachten Sie bitte Folgendes, wenn Sie sich auf Stellen bewerben: Bewerben Sie sich ausschließlich über unsere offiziellen Kanäle. Wir nutzen für die Rekrutierung keine Plattformen oder Agenturen Dritter, sofern dies nicht ausdrücklich angegeben ist. Alle offenen Stellen sind auf unserer offiziellen Karriereseite aufgeführt: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Überprüfen Sie die Identität des Personalvermittlers. Alle unsere Personalvermittler verfügen über verifizierte LinkedIn-Profile. Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, können Sie ihre Identität bestätigen, indem Sie ihr Profil überprüfen oder uns über unsere Website kontaktieren. Seien Sie vorsichtig bei ungewöhnlichen Kommunikationsmethoden. Wir führen keine Interviews über WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS durch. Die gesamte Kommunikation erfolgt über offizielle E-Mails und Plattformen des Unternehmens. Überprüfen Sie die E-Mail-Adressen noch einmal. Die gesamte Kommunikation von uns erfolgt über E-Mails mit der Endung @ tether.to oder @ tether.io. Wir werden niemals nach Zahlungs- oder Finanzdaten fragen. Wenn jemand zu irgendeinem Zeitpunkt während des Einstellungsprozesses nach persönlichen Finanzinformationen oder Zahlungen fragt, handelt es sich um Betrug. Bitte melden Sie es umgehend. Im Zweifelsfall können Sie sich gerne über unsere offizielle Website an uns wenden.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft des digitalen Finanzwesens. Bei Tether entwickeln wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen – von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten –, rücklagegesicherte Token nahtlos über Blockchains hinweg zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Leistungsfähigkeit der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Ihnen Tether das sofortige, sichere und globale Speichern, Senden und Empfangen digitaler Token – und das alles zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten. Transparenz ist die Grundlage unseres Handelns und gewährleistet Vertrauen bei jeder Transaktion. Innovation mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite umfasst den vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin der Welt, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte Millionen Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen, sowie bahnbrechende Dienste zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssigen Strom für das Bitcoin-Mining durch umweltfreundliche Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch vielfältigen Anlagen. Tether Data: Wir treiben Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie voran, senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen ermöglichen wir Einzelpersonen, in der Digital- und Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von überall auf der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn es Ihnen am Herzen liegt, sich im Fintech-Bereich einen Namen zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Branchenführer gesichert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, einen Beitrag zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt zu leisten, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über die Stelle Wir suchen einen technischen Leiter, der unsere Entwicklungsbemühungen beim Aufbau plattformübergreifender Peer-to-Peer-Anwendungen unter Verwendung der Pear Runtime und des breiteren Ökosystems von Holepunch leitet. Sie legen die technische Richtung fest, unterstützen Ingenieure bei der täglichen Entwicklung und fungieren als Hauptverbindungsmann zu den Holepunch-Ingenieuren – indem Sie vorgelagerte Entwicklungen in umsetzbare Arbeit umsetzen, Releases koordinieren und zur Entwicklung unseres Peer-to-Peer-Ökosystems beitragen. Woran Sie arbeiten werden: Sie fungieren als primäre technische Verbindung zwischen unserem Entwicklerteam und den Holepunch-Ingenieuren. Leiten Sie Wissensaustauschsitzungen zwischen den Teams, damit alle auf dem Laufenden bleiben. Erstellen und pflegen Sie Flaggschiff-Desktop- (Electron) und mobile (React Native) Anwendungen, die vollständig Peer-to-Peer ohne zentrale Server laufen. Entwerfen Sie schöne, leistungsstarke plattformübergreifende UX für Dateifreigabe, Messaging, Videoanrufe und Tools für die Zusammenarbeit. Integrieren und erweitern Sie den Pear Runtime/Holepunch-Stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm usw.). Liefern Sie schnell neue Funktionen, nehmen Sie an Codeüberprüfungen teil, schreiben Sie Tests und optimieren Sie die Leistung. Helfen Sie externen Partnern und der Open-Source-Community beim Aufbau der Plattform. Tragen Sie gelegentlich Verbesserungen und Fehlerbehebungen zu den zugrunde liegenden Open-Source-Modulen bei. Verantwortlichkeiten: Sie fungieren als primäre technische Verbindung zwischen unserem Entwicklungsteam und den Holepunch-Ingenieuren. Leiten Sie Wissensaustauschsitzungen zwischen den Teams, damit alle auf dem Laufenden bleiben. Übersetzen Sie Produktanforderungen in klare technische Pläne und Architekturen, die auf den Holepunch-Stack abgestimmt sind. Stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Anwendungen einem modularen Ansatz folgen und nach Best Practices entwickelt werden. Koordinieren Sie interne und externe Dokumentations- und Schulungspläne. Koordinieren Sie das konsolidierte Feedback unseres Entwicklerteams und externer Projekte an das Holepunch-Team. Leiten und betreuen Sie die verschiedenen Entwicklungsteams. Umfangreiche Produktionserfahrung mit React Native und/oder Electron (Versand von Apps, die echte Benutzer lieben). Ein fundierter Hintergrund im Aufbau und der Verwaltung modularer Codebasen und der Erstellung wiederverwendbarer NPM-Module. Mehr als 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Software-Engineering. Sehr vertraut mit Node.js und modernen JavaScript/TypeScript-Ökosystemen. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Entwerfen und Erstellen von Local-First-Anwendungen, bei denen das lokale Datenmodell die primäre Quelle der Wahrheit ist. Praktische Erfahrung mit Local-First-Datentechnologien (Speicherung, Konfliktlösung, Event-Sourcing usw.). Vertrautheit mit plattformübergreifender Paketierung und Bereitstellung. Vertrautheit mit Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung und sicherer lokaler Speicherung. Solide Kenntnisse der asynchronen Programmier-, Netzwerk- und Datensynchronisierungskonzepte. Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD und kollaborativen Open-Source-Workflows. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste Nous recherchons un responsable technique pour diriger nos efforts de développement dans la création d'applications peer-to-peer multiplateformes à l'aide de Pear Runtime et de l'écosystème plus large créé par Holepunch. Vous définirez la direction technique, soutiendrez les ingénieurs dans le développement quotidien et agirez en tant qu'intermédiaire principal avec les ingénieurs Holepunch - traduisant les développements en amont en travaux exploitables, coordonnant les versions et contribuant à l'évolution de notre écosystème peer-to-peer. Ce sur quoi vous travaillerez Agir en tant que principal agent de liaison technique entre notre équipe de développement et les ingénieurs Holepunch. Animer des sessions de partage de connaissances entre les équipes pour que chacun reste informé. Créez et maintenez des applications phares de bureau (Electron) et mobiles (React Native) qui fonctionnent entièrement en peer-to-peer sans aucun serveur central. Concevez une UX multiplateforme belle et performante pour le partage de fichiers, la messagerie, les appels vidéo et les outils collaboratifs. Intégrer et étendre la stack Pear Runtime / Holepunch (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Expédiez rapidement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, participez aux révisions de code, rédigez des tests et optimisez les performances. Aidez les partenaires externes et la communauté open source à s’appuyer sur la plateforme. Contribuez occasionnellement à des améliorations et à des corrections de bugs aux modules open source sous-jacents. Responsabilités Agir en tant que principal agent de liaison technique entre notre équipe de développement et les ingénieurs Holepunch. Animer des sessions de partage de connaissances entre les équipes pour que chacun reste informé. Traduisez les exigences du produit en plans techniques clairs et en architectures alignées sur la pile Holepunch. Assurez-vous que nos applications suivent une approche modulaire et sont conçues selon les meilleures pratiques. Coordonner la documentation interne et externe et les plans de formation. Coordonner les commentaires consolidés de notre équipe de développement et des projets externes vers l'équipe Holepunch. Guider et encadrer les différentes équipes d'ingénierie. Solide expérience de production avec React Native et/ou Electron (applications de livraison que les vrais utilisateurs adorent) Une solide expérience dans la création et la gestion de bases de code modulaires et dans la création de modules NPM réutilisables. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en génie logiciel. Expérience de la direction de petites équipes de développement et de la coordination avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Expérience avec les magasins d'applications mobiles, les magasins de navigateurs ou les magasins de bureau. Très à l'aise avec Node.js et les écosystèmes JavaScript/TypeScript modernes. Expérience avérée dans la conception et la création d'applications locales où le modèle de données local est la principale source de vérité. Expérience pratique des technologies de données locales (stockage, résolution de conflits, sourcing d'événements, etc.) Familiarité avec le packaging et le déploiement multiplateformes Familiarité avec le cryptage de bout en bout et le stockage local sécurisé. Solide maîtrise des concepts de programmation asynchrone, de mise en réseau et de synchronisation de données. Maîtrise de Git, CI/CD et des flux de travail collaboratifs open source. Excellentes compétences en communication (équipe mondiale entièrement à distance) Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Pour vous protéger, veuillez garder les points suivants à l'esprit lorsque vous postulez à des postes : postulez uniquement via nos canaux officiels. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, oltre a servizi di tokenizzazione digitale di asset. Tether Data: Riduciamo i costi delle infrastrutture e miglioriamo le comunicazioni globali con soluzioni all'avanguardia come KEET , la nostra app di punta che ridefinisce la condivisione dei dati sicura e privata. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de: Treten Sie Tether bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft des digitalen Finanzwesens. Bei Tether entwickeln wir nicht nur Produkte, wir sind Vorreiter einer globalen Finanzrevolution. Unsere hochmodernen Lösungen ermöglichen es Unternehmen – von Börsen und Wallets bis hin zu Zahlungsabwicklern und Geldautomaten –, rücklagegesicherte Token nahtlos über Blockchains hinweg zu integrieren. Durch die Nutzung der Leistungsfähigkeit der Blockchain-Technologie ermöglicht Ihnen Tether das sofortige, sichere und globale Speichern, Senden und Empfangen digitaler Token – und das alles zu einem Bruchteil der Kosten. Transparenz ist die Grundlage unseres Handelns und gewährleistet Vertrauen bei jeder Transaktion. Innovation mit Tether Tether Finance: Unsere innovative Produktsuite umfasst den vertrauenswürdigsten Stablecoin der Welt, USDT, auf den sich Hunderte Millionen Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen, sowie bahnbrechende Dienste zur Tokenisierung digitaler Vermögenswerte. Aber das ist erst der Anfang: Tether Power: Unsere Energielösungen fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum und optimieren überschüssigen Strom für das Bitcoin-Mining durch umweltfreundliche Praktiken in hochmodernen, geografisch vielfältigen Anlagen. Tether Data: Wir treiben Durchbrüche in der KI- und Peer-to-Peer-Technologie voran, senken Infrastrukturkosten und verbessern die globale Kommunikation mit modernsten Lösungen wie KEET, unserer Flaggschiff-App, die den sicheren und privaten Datenaustausch neu definiert. Tether Education: Durch die Demokratisierung des Zugangs zu erstklassigem digitalen Lernen ermöglichen wir Einzelpersonen, in der Digital- und Gig-Wirtschaft erfolgreich zu sein und so globales Wachstum und Chancen voranzutreiben. Tether Evolution: An der Schnittstelle von Technologie und menschlichem Potenzial verschieben wir die Grenzen des Möglichen und gestalten eine Zukunft, in der Innovation und menschliche Fähigkeiten auf kraftvolle, beispiellose Weise verschmelzen. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Unser Team ist ein globales Talent-Powerhouse, das von überall auf der Welt aus arbeitet. Wenn es Ihnen am Herzen liegt, sich im Fintech-Bereich einen Namen zu machen, ist dies Ihre Gelegenheit, mit einigen der klügsten Köpfe zusammenzuarbeiten, Grenzen zu überschreiten und neue Standards zu setzen. Wir sind schnell gewachsen, schlank geblieben und haben uns unseren Platz als Branchenführer gesichert. Wenn Sie über ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse verfügen und bereit sind, einen Beitrag zur innovativsten Plattform der Welt zu leisten, ist Tether der richtige Ort für Sie. Sind Sie bereit, Teil der Zukunft zu sein? Über die Stelle Wir suchen einen technischen Leiter, der unsere Entwicklungsbemühungen beim Aufbau plattformübergreifender Peer-to-Peer-Anwendungen unter Verwendung der Pear Runtime und des breiteren Ökosystems von Holepunch leitet. Sie legen die technische Richtung fest, unterstützen Ingenieure bei der täglichen Entwicklung und fungieren als Hauptverbindungsmann zu den Holepunch-Ingenieuren – indem Sie vorgelagerte Entwicklungen in umsetzbare Arbeit umsetzen, Releases koordinieren und zur Entwicklung unseres Peer-to-Peer-Ökosystems beitragen. Woran Sie arbeiten werden: Sie fungieren als primäre technische Verbindung zwischen unserem Entwicklerteam und den Holepunch-Ingenieuren. Leiten Sie Wissensaustauschsitzungen zwischen den Teams, damit alle auf dem Laufenden bleiben. Erstellen und pflegen Sie Flaggschiff-Desktop- (Electron) und mobile (React Native) Anwendungen, die vollständig Peer-to-Peer ohne zentrale Server laufen. Entwerfen Sie schöne, leistungsstarke plattformübergreifende UX für Dateifreigabe, Messaging, Videoanrufe und Tools für die Zusammenarbeit. Integrieren und erweitern Sie den Pear Runtime/Holepunch-Stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm usw.). Liefern Sie schnell neue Funktionen, nehmen Sie an Codeüberprüfungen teil, schreiben Sie Tests und optimieren Sie die Leistung. Helfen Sie externen Partnern und der Open-Source-Community beim Aufbau der Plattform. Tragen Sie gelegentlich Verbesserungen und Fehlerbehebungen zu den zugrunde liegenden Open-Source-Modulen bei. Verantwortlichkeiten: Sie fungieren als primäre technische Verbindung zwischen unserem Entwicklungsteam und den Holepunch-Ingenieuren. Leiten Sie Wissensaustauschsitzungen zwischen den Teams, damit alle auf dem Laufenden bleiben. Übersetzen Sie Produktanforderungen in klare technische Pläne und Architekturen, die auf den Holepunch-Stack abgestimmt sind. Stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Anwendungen einem modularen Ansatz folgen und nach Best Practices entwickelt werden. Koordinieren Sie interne und externe Dokumentations- und Schulungspläne. Koordinieren Sie das konsolidierte Feedback unseres Entwicklerteams und externer Projekte an das Holepunch-Team. Leiten und betreuen Sie die verschiedenen Entwicklungsteams. Umfangreiche Produktionserfahrung mit React Native und/oder Electron (Versand von Apps, die echte Benutzer lieben). Vertrautheit mit Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung und sicherer lokaler Speicherung. Solide Kenntnisse der asynchronen Programmier-, Netzwerk- und Datensynchronisierungskonzepte. Kenntnisse in Git, CI/CD und kollaborativen Open-Source-Workflows. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez Tether et façonnez l'avenir de la finance numérique Chez Tether, nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des produits, nous sommes les pionniers d'une révolution financière mondiale. Nos solutions de pointe permettent aux entreprises (des bourses et portefeuilles aux processeurs de paiement et aux distributeurs automatiques) d'intégrer de manière transparente les jetons adossés à des réserves dans les blockchains. En exploitant la puissance de la technologie blockchain, Tether vous permet de stocker, d'envoyer et de recevoir des jetons numériques instantanément, en toute sécurité et à l'échelle mondiale, le tout pour une fraction du coût. La transparence est le fondement de tout ce que nous faisons, garantissant la confiance dans chaque transaction. Innovez avec Tether Tether Finance : notre suite de produits innovants comprend le stablecoin le plus fiable au monde, l'USDT, sur lequel s'appuient des centaines de millions de personnes dans le monde, ainsi que des services pionniers de tokenisation d'actifs numériques. Mais ce n’est qu’un début : Tether Power : favorisant une croissance durable, nos solutions énergétiques optimisent l’énergie excédentaire pour l’extraction de Bitcoin en utilisant des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement dans des installations de pointe et géodiverses. Tether Data : En alimentant les percées dans l'IA et la technologie peer-to-peer, nous réduisons les coûts d'infrastructure et améliorons les communications mondiales avec des solutions de pointe comme KEET, notre application phare qui redéfinit le partage de données sécurisé et privé. Tether Education : en démocratisant l'accès à un apprentissage numérique de haut niveau, nous permettons aux individus de s'épanouir dans l'économie numérique et des petits boulots, stimulant ainsi la croissance et les opportunités mondiales. Tether Evolution : À l'intersection de la technologie et du potentiel humain, nous repoussons les limites de ce qui est possible, en créant un avenir où l'innovation et les capacités humaines fusionnent de manière puissante et sans précédent. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Notre équipe est une centrale mondiale de talents, travaillant à distance depuis tous les coins du monde. Si vous souhaitez vous démarquer dans le domaine de la fintech, c'est l'occasion de collaborer avec certains des esprits les plus brillants, de repousser les limites et d'établir de nouvelles normes. Nous avons connu une croissance rapide, sommes restés minces et avons assuré notre place de leader du secteur. Si vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication en anglais et êtes prêt à contribuer à la plateforme la plus innovante de la planète, Tether est fait pour vous. Êtes-vous prêt à faire partie du futur ? À propos du poste Nous recherchons un responsable technique pour diriger nos efforts de développement dans la création d'applications peer-to-peer multiplateformes à l'aide de Pear Runtime et de l'écosystème plus large créé par Holepunch. Vous définirez la direction technique, soutiendrez les ingénieurs dans le développement quotidien et agirez en tant qu'intermédiaire principal avec les ingénieurs Holepunch - traduisant les développements en amont en travaux exploitables, coordonnant les versions et contribuant à l'évolution de notre écosystème peer-to-peer. Ce sur quoi vous travaillerez Agir en tant que principal agent de liaison technique entre notre équipe de développement et les ingénieurs Holepunch. Animer des sessions de partage de connaissances entre les équipes pour que chacun reste informé. Créez et maintenez des applications phares de bureau (Electron) et mobiles (React Native) qui fonctionnent entièrement en peer-to-peer sans aucun serveur central. Concevez une UX multiplateforme belle et performante pour le partage de fichiers, la messagerie, les appels vidéo et les outils collaboratifs. Intégrer et étendre la stack Pear Runtime / Holepunch (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Expédiez rapidement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, participez aux révisions de code, rédigez des tests et optimisez les performances. Aidez les partenaires externes et la communauté open source à s’appuyer sur la plateforme. Contribuez occasionnellement à des améliorations et à des corrections de bugs aux modules open source sous-jacents. Responsabilités Agir en tant que principal agent de liaison technique entre notre équipe de développement et les ingénieurs Holepunch. Animer des sessions de partage de connaissances entre les équipes pour que chacun reste informé. Traduisez les exigences du produit en plans techniques clairs et en architectures alignées sur la pile Holepunch. Assurez-vous que nos applications suivent une approche modulaire et sont conçues selon les meilleures pratiques. Coordonner la documentation interne et externe et les plans de formation. Coordonner les commentaires consolidés de notre équipe de développement et des projets externes vers l'équipe Holepunch. Guider et encadrer les différentes équipes d'ingénierie. Solide expérience de production avec React Native et/ou Electron (applications de livraison que les vrais utilisateurs adorent) Une solide expérience dans la création et la gestion de bases de code modulaires et dans la création de modules NPM réutilisables. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en génie logiciel. Expérience de la direction de petites équipes de développement et de la coordination avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Expérience avec les magasins d'applications mobiles, les magasins de navigateurs ou les magasins de bureau. Très à l'aise avec Node.js et les écosystèmes JavaScript/TypeScript modernes. Expérience avérée dans la conception et la création d'applications locales où le modèle de données local est la principale source de vérité. Expérience pratique des technologies de données locales (stockage, résolution de conflits, sourcing d'événements, etc.) Familiarité avec le packaging et le déploiement multiplateformes Familiarité avec le cryptage de bout en bout et le stockage local sécurisé. Solide maîtrise des concepts de programmation asynchrone, de mise en réseau et de synchronisation de données. Maîtrise de Git, CI/CD et des flux de travail collaboratifs open source. Excellentes compétences en communication (équipe mondiale entièrement à distance) Informations importantes pour les candidats Les escroqueries au recrutement sont devenues de plus en plus courantes. Si quelqu’un demande des informations financières personnelles ou un paiement à tout moment du processus d’embauche, il s’agit d’une arnaque. Veuillez le signaler immédiatement. En cas de doute, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter via notre site officiel.

Imbragando la potenza della tecnologia blockchain, Tether consente di memorizzare, inviare e ricevere i gettoni digitali istantaneamente, in modo sicuro e globale, il tutto ad una frazione del costo. La trasparenza è la base di tutto ciò che facciamo, garantendo fiducia in ogni transazione. Innovare con Tether Tether Finance: La nostra innovativa suite di prodotti presenta il più affidabile stablecoin al mondo, USDT , basato su centinaia di milioni di persone in tutto il mondo, insieme ai servizi di tokenizzazione degli asset digitali. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. descriptionByLocale.en: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We’re looking for a Technical Lead to lead our development efforts in building cross platform peer-to-peer applications using the Pear Runtime and the broader ecosystem created by Holepunch. You’ll define technical direction, support engineers in day-to-day development, and act as the main liaison with Holepunch engineers - translating upstream developments into actionable work, coordinating releases, and contributing to the evolution of our peer-to-peer ecosystem. What you’ll work on Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Build and maintain flagship desktop (Electron) and mobile (React Native) applications that run fully peer-to-peer with zero central servers. Design beautiful, performant cross-platform UX for file sharing, messaging, video calls, and collaborative tools. Integrate and extend the Pear Runtime / Holepunch stack (Hypercore, Hyperdrive, Hyperswarm, etc.). Ship new features rapidly, participate in code reviews, write tests, and optimize performance. Help external partners and the open-source community build on the platform. Occasionally contribute improvements and bug fixes back to the underlying open-source modules. Responsibilities Act as the primary technical liaison between our dev team and the Holepunch engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions between the teams for everyone to stay up-to-date. Translate product requirements into clear technical plans and architectures aligned with the Holepunch stack. Ensure our applications follow a modular approach and are designed according to best practices. Coordinate internal and external documentation and training plans. Coordinate consolidated feedback from our dev team and external projects to the Holepunch team Guide and mentor the different engineering teams. Strong production experience with React Native and/or Electron (shipping apps that real users love) A strong background in building and managing modular codebases and creating reusable npm modules. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience Experience leading small development teams and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders. Experience with mobile application stores, browser stores or Desktop stores. Very comfortable with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems Proven experience designing and building local-first applications where the local data model is the primary source of truth. Hands-on experience with local-first data technologies (storage, conflict resolution, event sourcing, etc.) Familiarity with cross-platform packaging & deployment Familiarity with end-to-end encryption and secure local storage. Solid grasp of asynchronous programming, networking, and data synchronization concepts Proficiency with Git, CI/CD and collaborative open-source workflows. Excellent communication skills (fully remote, global team) Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
