If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job The Engagement Manager will lead the implementation journey of tokenization projects based on Hadron for institutional clients, acting as the primary technical and business point of contact throughout onboarding and early operations. This role is pivotal in ensuring a seamless transition from contract signature through the first production token issuance and continuous monitoring of the initiative, maintaining alignment across stakeholders, and coordinating execution across internal teams, client counterparts, and external partners. As Engagement Manager, you can expect to work with global institutional clients across multiple geographies and asset classes on complex tokenization initiatives involving digital asset issuance, custody frameworks, and integration into existing financial infrastructures within a regulated and rapidly evolving environment. This role offers the opportunity to actively shape how institutions adopt tokenized assets, operating in a fully remote setup with flexible global collaboration. As the scope and volume of implementations grow, there is a clear path to evolve into broader technical strategy or client success leadership roles. Responsibilities Before the engagement (pre-sales) Assist Expansion Managers in preparing and conducting demos As consultant, propose solutions during pre-sales phase of the engagement Assist in defining the engagement scope, ensuring it’s correctly reflected in the Client agreement Onboarding & Integration Lead project kickoffs and define the integration roadmap with clients Guide clients through API documentation, sandbox testing, and UAT Diagnose and troubleshoot client integration issues Coordinate between clients, engineering teams, and external infrastructure partners during integrations Track onboarding progress, milestones, and dependencies to ensure clients reach production within expected timelines Prepare clients for production launch and conduct monitoring and hyper-care after launch Maintain an enterprise-grade, consulting-like knowledge base around implementation use cases Create integration documentation and operational runbooks and adapt them as needed to tailor each client implementation Client Communication & Problem-Solving Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the execution of the engagement Translate technical complexity for non-technical stakeholders Identify integration pain points and escalate product feedback Proactively communicate timelines, blockers, and dependencies Support transition clients to self-service with comprehensive documentation Proactively identify up- and cross-sell opportunities, to be passed on to Expansion Managers What You Won’t Do Write or audit smart contracts (clients own their tokenomics) Perform regulatory or legal structuring Build custom features or bespoke integrations Core skills 3–6 years of experience in technical account management , solutions engineering, technical consulting, project management of technical implementations or integrations, or client success management Strong understanding of APIs and system integrations Comfort diagnosing and resolving integration issues Excellent communication skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders Experience coordinating across multiple teams and external partners Ability to track and manage technical project timelines English proficiency is mandatory Nice to Have Familiarity with blockchain infrastructure or digital assets Experience with fintech or institutional financial infrastructure Familiarity with token standards (ERC-20, ERC-1400) or Ethereum basics Background in fin-tech, supporting financial institutions or complex B2B integrations Basic programming knowledge ( Python, JavaScript ) or API tools Who You Are Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, global environment Self-directed and able to own integration workflows end-to-end Detail-oriented, documenting decisions and learnings as you go Collaborative, able to work effectively with engineering teams and demanding clients Interested in the intersection of financial infrastructure and blockchain technology Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

This role offers the opportunity to actively shape how institutions adopt tokenized assets, operating in a fully remote setup with flexible global collaboration. Excellent communication skills , with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders Experience coordinating across multiple teams and external partners Ability to track and À propos du poste Le responsable de l'engagement dirigera le parcours de mise en œuvre des projets de tokenisation basés sur Hadron pour les clients institutionnels, agissant en tant que principal point de contact technique et commercial tout au long de l'intégration et des premières opérations. Ce rôle est essentiel pour assurer une transition transparente depuis la signature du contrat jusqu'à l'émission du premier jeton de production et la surveillance continue de l'initiative, en maintenant l'alignement entre les parties prenantes et en coordonnant l'exécution entre les équipes internes, les homologues des clients et les partenaires externes. En tant que responsable de l'engagement, vous pouvez vous attendre à travailler avec des clients institutionnels mondiaux dans plusieurs zones géographiques et classes d'actifs sur des initiatives complexes de tokenisation impliquant l'émission d'actifs numériques, les cadres de conservation et l'intégration dans les infrastructures financières existantes dans un environnement réglementé et en évolution rapide. Ce rôle offre la possibilité de façonner activement la manière dont les institutions adoptent les actifs tokenisés, en opérant dans une configuration entièrement à distance avec une collaboration mondiale flexible. À mesure que la portée et le volume des mises en œuvre augmentent, il existe une voie claire pour évoluer vers des rôles de leadership en matière de stratégie technique ou de réussite client plus larges.
